title: Compliance Operations Specialist 1
description_html: Twilio’s next Compliance Operations Specialist 1 About the job At Twilio, our mission is to power the future of communications. We believe that communication should be at the heart of every product and customer experience. In this role you will be monitoring the use of Twilio products, voice, SMS and email, to ensure that the traffic on Twilio’s platform is legal, compliant, and wanted. To do this you will also ensure that all traffic is following Twilio’s Voice Policy, Messaging Policy, Acceptable Use policy and meets CTIA requirements. We are looking for someone that is passionate about preventing fraud and abuse. The ideal candidate has some experience in research and investigation skills and enjoys challenging and complex case work.

title: DevOps Engineer (Observability)
description_html: our next Software Engineer on Twilio’s platform engineering observability team. About the job This position is needed to help our platform engineering observability team. Twilio is undergoing a large-scale observability transformation—and you can help shape the foundation. Observability is a strategic pillar and a key enabler for faster incident response, deeper customer-centric insights, and more cost-effective platform operations. As a Software Engineer on the Platform Observability team, you’ll play a critical role in re-architecting how telemetry flows and is utilized through Twilio—making it structured, accessible, affordable, and actionable. Over the next 3 years, Twilio is rebuilding nearly every component of our observability platform, from data collection to real-time analytics.

title: Director, Revenue & CoGS Accounting
description_html: Twilio’s next Director, Revenue & CoGS Accounting. About the job In this role, you will be the visionary leader of Twilio’s global revenue and CoGS accounting operations and play a critical role in shaping a global revenue recognition framework that is as agile as it is accurate, ensuring our financial reporting scales seamlessly with our product innovation. You will bridge the gap between complex technical accounting and high-velocity business operations, and partner with GTM, Product, and IT leaders to ensure our commercial strategies are not only ambitious but operationally sound and compliant. The successful candidate possesses a rare blend of executive presence, technical mastery, and deep operational experience.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description_html: Twilio’s next Enterprise Account Executive UK/I/Northern Europe. About the job This position is needed to sell into high value Enterprise prospects and existing customers with ARR under $50k. You will play a key role in further growing Twilio’s Communication business across UK/I/Northern Europe. You will be responsible for sourcing new, high value customers as well as driving the sales process from internal leads to qualifying new prospects and handling deals to closure. Responsibilities In this role, you’ll: Be responsible for new customer acquisition and driving ACV for a specific set of accounts while maintaining the highest levels of customer satisfaction. Master creating pricing proposals, negotiating terms and managing the contract process.

title: Field Marketing Manager, Japan
description_html: our next Field Marketing Manager in Japan About the job As the Field Marketing Manager for Japan, you will report to Twilio's VP of Marketing, APJ, and own the end-to-end field marketing motion for one of our most strategically important growth markets in the region. You will be responsible for designing and executing a brand-to-revenue GTM strategy that spans the full funnel, from building market presence and brand credibility through PR and executive engagement, through to driving pipeline creation, acceleration, and deal closure in close partnership with our Japan sales team. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role suited to an experienced field marketer who is equally comfortable shaping strategy and rolling up their sleeves to execute.

title: Global Security Operations Center Operator
description_html: Twilio’s next Operator, Global Security Operations Center (GSOC). About the job This position is needed to maintain a broad situational awareness over internal and external physical events that could impact employee safety or pose a threat to business assets or operations across Twilio’s global footprint. GSOC Operators monitor a variety of data sources including internal access control systems, external incident aggregators, travel safety applications, and general open source reporting materials. GSOC Operators serve as the primary contact for employees with physical safety and security questions or concerns.

title: Incident Commander
description_html: Twilio’s next Incident Commander About the job This position is needed to help own and strategically evolve Twilio's incident response function as one of the company's most senior Incident Commanders, working alongside other senior ICs on the team. You will be capable of facilitating incidents across the full range of severities, including our highest-severity incidents. You will orchestrate response across a wide range of business functions, not just engineering. You'll be one of the senior voices VPs and C-suite leaders turn to for a clear, accurate read on what's happening and what's next.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description_html: Twilio’s next Machine Learning Engineer. About the job This position is to design and engineer AI powered features that makes every customer conversation smarter. As a Machine Learning Engineer on the Conversation Intelligence team, you'll develop and deploy solutions that extract meaning from voice and messaging data at Twilio scale. You'll work alongside experienced ML practitioners to ship real features - from model pipelines to production inference - that directly shape how businesses understand their customers. Responsibilities In this role, you’ll: Design and development of machine learning solutions, ensuring accuracy, performance, security, and scalability.

title: Care Coach
description_html: About the Role: We are looking for a mission-driven health coach to join our team to provide world-class care delivery services to Maven members. Our Care Delivery team consists of care coaches and care advocates who help our members navigate digital care and access the tools to unlock their best experience and outcomes. Our team works to continuously learn more about members and ourselves, and you’ll move fast to adapt and grow as we implement data-driven strategies for improving the lives of our members through a shared coaching model. As a Care Coach, you’ll coordinate care for our members beyond the digital space. Through goal setting and program opt-in, you’ll drive behavior change and improved outcomes for higher risk members.

title: Design Lead, Consumer
description_html: About the role We have recently launched our direct-to-consumer platform that gives women access to GLP-1 care, hormone care, and 30+ healthcare specialties, connecting metabolic, hormonal, reproductive, mental, and physical health in one care experience. We are building for women who are tired of fragmented care, unclear pricing, limited follow-up, and healthcare experiences that treat each symptom or life stage in isolation. What You'll Do: We’re looking for a founding Product Design Lead to help build and scale Maven’s direct-to-consumer healthcare experiences. This role sits at the intersection of consumer growth, healthcare access, product craft, AI-native ways of working, and trust-sensitive design. It is a hands-on player-coach role with formal line management responsibility.

title: Group Product Manager, Client Services
description_html: About the role Maven's enterprise business runs on client trust. This role sits at the intersection of client needs and core product: working closely with Client Services and Growth to understand what clients need, identify when custom work is warranted, and own the build from decision through delivery. You are the connective tissue between Maven's market-facing teams and core product. You spend meaningful time on client calls, embedded with client-facing teams, and in RFP processes where product depth matters. You also manage one or more PMs. The right person is deeply fluent in benefits and eligibility systems, comfortable with external stakeholders, and knows how to build a principled framework for what gets built, when, and by whom.

title: Head of East Coast Sales, Taft-Hartley & Labor
description_html: About the Role: Maven is looking for a Head of East Coast Sales, Taft-Hartley & Labor who will spearhead Maven's expansion into the Taft-Hartley market. In this individual contributor role, you will be responsible for generating net-new pipeline, building relationships with key Labor stakeholders, and closing complex multi-employer deals — all in service of bringing Maven's industry-leading women's and family health platform to union members and their families who need it most. You will report to the VP of Sales and work cross-functionally with Client Success, Marketing, and Product to position Maven as the go-to women's and family health partner for Labor funds across the country.

title: Product Designer, Maternity Experience
description_html: About The Role: The Maternity team designs the journeys, tools, and guidance that help members navigate pregnancy, birth, and the fourth trimester with confidence across content, coaching, clinical touch points, and community. We’re looking for an AI-forward Product Designer to own member-facing maternity experiences from 0→1 concepts through shipped features. You will use AI as a core part of how you think, design, and build not as an add-on. What You'll Do: Design key maternity journeys and features end-to-end, using AI to compress timelines and explore more options faster. Build functional, high-fidelity prototypes using AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) moving beyond static mockups.
location: New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)

title: Product Marketing Manager (Contractor)
description_html: About the Role We're looking for a contract Product Marketing Manager to cover a leave on Maven's Product Marketing team during a critical stretch — product launches, sales enablement build-out, and sales kickoff prep. This is a hands-on execution role for someone who can hit the ground running, work cross-functionally, and produce high-quality marketing materials independently. This is a 4-month contract position for 40 hours per week. The contract term is from September 2026 through January 2027.

title: Revenue Operations Manager (Payments and Reconciliation)
description_html: Maven is seeking a Revenue Operations Manager (Payments and Reconciliation) to lead the end-to-end financial operations and reconciliation framework for our client-funded benefit programs. Reporting into the Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) team, you will move beyond simple oversight to architect a robust, scalable payment integrity program. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of benefit funding, from accurate invoicing and money movement oversight to complex account reconciliation, while partnering with Product/Engineering to build automated financial controls that ensure operational excellence at scale.
location: New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)

As Senior Designer, you will be a key player in the development and execution of high-impact performance marketing campaigns across various digital channels, with a proven track record of designing high-performing creative that drives measurable ROI. You will also be responsible for leading the evolution of our visual identity across all areas of the brand, including, web, digital, and social. This role will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to develop creative strategies and visually compelling designs that resonate with our target audience.
location: New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)

description_html: Maven is looking for a commercially-minded and strategic Senior Client Success Manager to join our Client Success team, to own relationships with our highest-value employer accounts. In this role, you will manage relationships with large employer clients introduced through Maven’s health plan channel partnerships, working in close coordination with the health plan team who co-owns the broader strategic relationship. The Senior Client Success Manager will be the main point of contact for some of our larger accounts - driving enrollment and engagement while taking direct accountability for net revenue retention, renewal health, and expansion readiness.

description_html: Maven Clinic is looking for an Sr. HRBP to support our business through people partnership and talent program delivery. This role will partner closely with managers and leaders on team engagement, performance management and employee relations. The ideal candidate is a proactive and collaborative people partner who is comfortable navigating ambiguity, solving problems thoughtfully, and building strong relationships across the organization. As an Sr. HRBP at Maven, you will: Partner with the HRBP team, managers and functional leaders to support employee engagement, team performance, and organizational effectiveness Advise managers on employee relations, performance management, development conversations, and team dynamics Manage employee relations issues and investigations for the teams you…

description_html: About the Role As a senior level software engineer at Maven Clinic, you will lead the design, development, and maintenance of highly scalable, performant, and reliable systems that support the growing opportunities in our product and platform systems. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the delivery of high-quality products and features that meet the needs of our customers and adhere to Maven's quality standards. As a Senior Software Engineer at Maven, you will: Lead the design, development, and maintenance of highly scalable, performant, and reliable systems that support the growing needs of Maven's platform and backend teams. Propose, design, develop and implement cloud-based solutions that ensure the agility, flexibility, and scalability of our systems.
location: New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)

title: Senior Software Engineer, Frontend Engineering
description_html: About the team: You will join a full-stack product engineering team focused on driving product impact by creating thoughtful, engaging, human-centered experiences through enrollment, and product adoption. We build user experiences with compelling content that drives member action to onboard onto the Maven Clinic app and to start reaping the benefits of our product. What you’ll do: Developing and implementing responsive, accessible, and optimized web or mobile applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React and other relevant frontend technologies. Use Node.js to support front-end architecture, tooling, and server-side rendering for scalable web applications. Working with backend developers to integrate frontend components with backend APIs and services.
location: New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)

title: Senior Staff Product Designer, Care Delivery
description_html: About The Role: We are seeking a Senior Staff Product Designer to completely own our virtual care and provider-facing experiences while driving the evolution of AI-native design at Maven. This role is focused on designing our provider tooling that our virtual care network of clinicians and other providers use during appointments. It's about identifying the right problems, setting and fully owning the design vision for multiple complex areas, making strategic calls under ambiguity, and leading high-impact initiatives that raise the bar for the team around you. You'll bring deep AI fluency and use it to move faster, explore more broadly, and build more intelligently, while also mentoring others on how to work that way.
location: New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)

title: Customer Success Manager
description_html: Team The core function of the Customer Success team is to ensure our clients have a seamless experience and get the most out of the Findigs platform. We are the voice of the customer internally, and the face of Findigs externally. Beyond day-to-day support, our team’s insights are the foundation for customer retention, product strategy, and long-term growth. This role will touch all parts of the customer lifecycle and collaborate closely with our Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to build a best-in-class customer experience. The Role We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to own the post-sale relationship for a portfolio of accounts.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description_html: Role We are investing in and expanding our sales team to further our growth in the multi-family and single family rentals market, and are looking for a talented Enterprise Account Executive with a track record of success to scale the Findigs platform across the largest accounts in the market – Property Managers and Real Estate Owners with more than 10,000 units under management. You will work with executives across target accounts to diagnose their screening challenges and identify opportunities of how Findings can create value for their business. We are looking for talented individuals who can work with multiple executive stakeholders and build consensus on the Findigs solution acting as a trusted executive advisor.

title: Manager, Sales Development
description_html: Team Our Sales Development team is the first point of contact with prospective Findigs customers, and one of the most important growth levers in the business as they work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to generate high-quality pipeline from property management companies across the country. This is a team that runs hard, wins together, and builds the foundation for how Findigs grows. The Role We're looking for a metrics-driven, hands-on Manager to lead, coach, and scale our Sales Development team. This is a high-impact role where you'll own the team's performance end-to-end — from hiring and ramping new reps to refining the outbound playbook and partnering cross-functionally to keep pipeline generation sharp and consistent.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description_html: Team The core function of the Customer Success team is to ensure our clients have a seamless experience and get the most out of the Findigs platform. title: Client Delivery Director
description_html: Hybrid Work Policy & Hub Locations BetterUp is a hybrid company that values in-person collaboration. Our US hub locations include: Austin, TX; New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA; and the Arlington, VA. Hybrid Expectation: You will be expected to work from your local office at least 2 days per week (or 8 days per month) and should be able to realistically commit to this structure before applying. This hybrid role will require travel up to 25% of the time for client engagements. If you are not located near a hub: You will work as a fully remote employee. This remote role will require travel up to 50% of the time for client engagements and internal BetterUp purposes. This role is open to candidates across the US.

title: Account Director, EMEA
description_html: We are a hybrid company with a focus on in-person collaboration when necessary. Employees are expected to be available to work from one of our office hubs at least two days per week, or eight days per month. Our Europe hub location is London, UK. Please ensure you can realistically commit to this structure before applying. The Account Director is a pivotal role, responsible for orchestrating and driving the entire sales ecosystem of our most strategic accounts. This role is not just about achieving sales targets but encompasses a holistic approach, combining new sales, account management, and customer success under a unified strategy. What you’ll do: Drive Account Strategy and Growth Develop account strategy in close conversation with customer executives and BetterUp leadership.

title: Principal Product Designer, Core
description_html: The Opportunity BetterUp is looking for a Principal Product Designer to join our Design team and shape the future of human transformation at scale. This is a rare opportunity to work at the highest individual contributor level in Design—owning domain-level craft, strategy, and systems thinking across BetterUp’s core product experiences. Reporting to the VP of Product Design, you will set the bar for design excellence, influence cross-functional direction, and help define what it means to build a world-class human-AI product.

description_html: About the Team & Your Impact BetterUp is looking for a Staff Product Designer, Design Systems to own, evolve, and scale our design system across web and mobile platforms. This role sits at the intersection of craft, systems thinking, and AI-powered design—ensuring our product experiences are consistent, accessible, and built for velocity. You’ll define how our design system leverages AI for implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement, positioning BetterUp at the forefront of AI-augmented product design.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description_html: While this is a fully remote role, candidates in the Washington, D.C. metro area are strongly preferred. Proximity to our team and business partners helps support in-person collaboration when needed. We're seeking a Lead Software Engineer to manage a team within our API Engineering group. This team owns the services at the core of Fundrise’s investor application: the APIs that drive authentication, investing, account management, and more, and it drives everything underneath our flagship investor web, iOS, and Android applications. As a Lead Software Engineer, you'll be measured on the output, quality, and growth of your team.

title: Assistant Security Manager
description_html: THE ROLE To assist the Senior Security Manager in providing the Company and its clients with consistently high standards of Security, Risk Management and Client Service. Ensuring Sotheby’s procedural rules and regulations are enforced; maintaining the highest level of personal safety for staff, visitors and property. Responsibilities are primarily Hong Kong based, with involvement with other Sotheby’s Asia offices as required. RESPONSIBILITIES Security Control Room: Oversight of the day to day operations and administration of the Security Department. To manage and operate the security system including access control, CCTV and alarm systems.

title: Associate Cataloguer, Chinese Works of Art
description_html: THE ROLE This Associate Cataloguer role will provide overall support to the Chinese Works of Art Department, including but not limited to sales, customer relations, catalogue production and administration while improving technical expertise in the field of Chinese Works of Art. The Associate Cataloguer shall gradually develop skills to undertake new business generation and for the sourcing, authentication, evaluation and sale of property over time. RESPONSIBILITIES Assisting in cataloguing and researching items for sale: Supporting the members of the Chinese Works of Art Department with the research and cataloguing of items to the highest standard according to scheduled deadlines Corresponding with external experts Assisting with physical cataloguing and arranging photography of works…

description_html: THE ROLE The Associate HRBP role will provide support to the VP, Global HR Business Partner on a range of matters including Performance Management, Employee Relations, Reporting, Talent Programs, Onboarding & Offboarding, and Administration. Key Client Groups are Operations, Product & Technology, Finance, and Communications . RESPONSIBILITIES Partner with VP, HRBP to assist with the Annual Performance Review Process, inclusive of Goal-Setting, Performance Reviews, Compensation Planning, and Continuous Feedback. Handle Employee Relations cases by conducting investigations as needed, and offering practical solutions. Assist with org design strategy and implementation for key client groups, such as departmental restructuring, to best align with business goals.

title: Associate Specialist, African & Oceanic Art, Europe
description_html: THE ROLE This person will lead research and cataloguing for all Paris-based sales that include Arts of Africa, Oceania, and the Americas, ensuring accuracy, depth of scholarship, and consistency with Sotheby’s standards. They will take responsibility for the operational execution of auctions, including cataloguing, photography coordination, and sale processing. The ideal candidate brings a genuine passion for the art and objects, wants to be a part of a teams, upholds the highest ethical standards, and serves as an ambassador for Sotheby’s, helping to maintain and enhance the company’s reputation in Paris and around the world.

title: Associate Specialist, Fine Wine Sales
description_html: THE ROLE The Associate Specialist, Fine Wine Sales is responsible for building a network of clients through new recruitments and cultivating existing relationships they have with Sotheby’s overall, for sales of fixed price bottles of wine (and spirits). The primary goal is to meet and exceed sales goals to contribute towards the achievement of overall business plan through lead generation, data analysis, marketing coordination, and in ‑ store support. This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their career with a strong knowledge of fine wine and capable of delivering excellent client service experience. RESPONSIBILITIES Sales & Marketing Support Sales of fine wine (and spirits) through email, telephone and in-person.

title: AVP, Head of Client Experience, Asia
description_html: THE ROLE The Associate Vice President, Regional Head of Client Experience – Asia is a senior leader accountable for building client experience into a clear and durable competitive advantage for the business. This role owns how clients are supported, engaged, and retained across the full lifecycle—from initial interaction through post‑sale support—across contact centers, in‑person touchpoints, and digital channels. With a strong background in contact center operations, hospitality‑driven service models, and digital journey optimization, this leader translates elevated client expectations into scalable, high‑performing service delivery.

title: Client Advisor, Wine Retail
description_html: THE ROLE As a Client Advisor, you will be responsible for achieving sales targets defined by the management and proactively developing a portfolio of local and international clients. You will ensure a seamless and unique luxurious experience for every client, through memorable storytelling, product expertise and state-of-the art retail hospitality. You will be an active member in the daily operations of the store and support the Manager in complying with all companies’ policies and procedures.

title: Client Experience Representative
description_html: THE ROLE Stationed in the Maison in Central the Client Experience Representative should have a passionate approach with a desire to exceed client needs. You should maintain the highest professional standard to ensure client experience is consistent with Sotheby’s global standard across all locations. You will ensure a seamless and unique luxurious experience for every client and partner closely with other teams and salons including Client Advisors, Registrar, Galleries, etc. to ensure smooth daily operations.

title: Client Liaison
description_html: THE ROLE We are looking for a highly motivated, proactive and productive Client Liaison with impeccable organizational skills to provide mature, discrete, professional assistance. As the Executive Assistant, you will be responsible for providing full business and administrative support, in a one to three working relationship. RESPONSIBILITIES Acting as liaison with; all levels of staff globally including executives and senior experts, high profile clients, and external stakeholders from all aspects of the art business Responsible for coordinating certain meetings; planning the agenda with input, arranging speakers, organizing materials, tracking attendance, following up on actions Assisting with diverse projects, initiatives and roll outs, carrying out research, gathering, analyzing and…

title: Client Strategist
description_html: THE ROLE Sotheby’s Client Strategy team develops and implements strategies around existing clients and gathers intelligence on key high net worth individuals in order to generate commercial opportunities. Partnering with areas of the business including Specialist Departments, Regional Offices, Marketing, Business Intelligence, Special Events, and other key business units, this team is responsible for spearheading initiatives to maximize Sotheby’s reach within its existing and prospective client base. The primary responsibility of this role is close collaboration with client strategy colleagues and specialist teams to devise and execute strategic plans for key clients to maximize transactions for specific divisions and the company.

title: Director, Lending Specialist
description_html: Sotheby’s Financial Services (SFS) enables clients to unlock the liquidity in their fine art and collectible assets through technology and innovation. With the spirit of a fintech startup, the stability of a large established organization, and its position at the center of the art ecosystem, the SFS team unites around the goal of leading the future of art financial services. We have a bold and exciting journey ahead, and we can't wait to make it happen together. THE ROLE You will be a core member of the SFS team responsible for loans originated in the UK and EMEA, promoting the SFS value proposition internally with colleagues and externally with clients.

title: Engineering Manager
description_html: THE ROLE Established in 1744, Sotheby’s is the world’s premier destination for art and luxury. The engineering that powers it today reflects that same ambition, built on modern technologies and modern practices. Auctions are the most visible part of what we do, but every sale that runs through Sotheby’s is backed by the entire engineering organisation. The work starts months before a lot crosses the block, from the systems that support how we acquire and value inventory, through to the platforms our clients and specialists interact with daily, the identity and compliance infrastructure that keeps it all trustworthy, and the services that make the live event itself possible. That breadth is what makes the engineering here different.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description_html: About Kasada Join us in stopping bad bots, for good! Kasada protects millions of online users everyday. Founded to stop automated bot attacks, we believe the internet should be a safe place for everyone. Bad bots are highly destructive. They take over accounts, steal content, overload systems and infrastructure and cause billions of dollars in damages every year. Seeking to restore trust in the internet, Kasada stops bots at the very first request including those that have never been seen before. We’ve grown from a few friends working out of a shipping container under the Sydney Harbour Bridge to now operating globally, we’re spread across the world protecting some of the most well-known brands on the face of the earth.

title: Data Analyst (Azar)
description_html: Product Analytics Team Product Analytics Team은 Business Operations & Analytics 조직의 일원으로, 아자르의 제품 성장을 데이터로 뒷받침합니다. 매일 수천만 건의 글로벌 매칭이 만들어내는 데이터를 기반으로 다국적 유저 데이터의 공통점과 차이를 분석합니다. 실험 설계부터 결과 해석까지 분석가가 주도합니다. 대규모 트래픽에서 A/B 테스트를 직접 분석하여 제품 의사결정에 직접 기여합니다. A/B 테스트를 직접 설계하고, 결과를 다양한 이해관계자에게 커뮤니케이션합니다. 유저 행동 데이터를 분석하여 문제를 정의하고, 제품 핵심 지표의 변화 원인을 파악하여 실행 가능한 액션 아이템을 제안합니다. 신규 기능에 대한 이벤트 로그를 직접 설계하고, 유저 행동이 정확히 측정될 수 있는 데이터 구조를 관리합니다. This individual will also be responsible for implementing and ensuring documentation of standard operating procedures to maintain accurate financial records; evaluating inefficiencies and opportunities for cost savings or process improvement and relaying conclusions to management. description_html: Job Description The Technical Trainer I is responsible for developing and delivering technical course material on the various aspects of the Ignition software, as well as maintaining Ignition certification. The Technical Trainer I also provides technical help throughout the company and may help other divisions through various training tasks. This is a full time position with in-person, hybrid or remote opportunities available. Travel for this position is required. Must be able to deliver uninterrupted 5 day courses both locally and at customer sites, and be able to travel for scheduled off-site courses.

description_html: Job Description The Industry Principal – Life Sciences (Strategic Industries Manager - Life Sciences) operates as a market Principal, owning Inductive Automation’s end-to-end strategy and execution for the vertical, including but not limited to the pharma, biotech, and medical device industry operators and the engineering, construction, and systems integration partners that serve them. The role is responsible for the full lifecycle of the vertical: market definition, pipeline development, partner and customer relationships, sales enablement, product input, and external presence at industry events.

Working closely with engineering and product leadership, you'll help define and evolve technical direction and lead the design processes that turn ambiguous needs into shipped, operable systems. You'll contribute meaningfully across the full delivery lifecycle, evaluation and trade-off analysis, domain and data modeling, architectural design, implementation planning, hands-on implementation, deployment, and operational ownership, and raise the level of the engineers around you as you do it.

This role may be required to interact with customers to troubleshoot products or obtain requirements. Note: This is a full-time, hybrid position with regular in-office collaboration, typically two days per week on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We need smart engineers who can pick up and understand complex technical areas quickly – and who are enthusiastic about building new technologies! AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL: Design, develop, and support a petabyte-scale cloud database that is highly parallel and fault-tolerant. Build high-quality and highly reliable software to meet the needs of some of the largest companies on the planet. Analyze and understand performance and scalability bottlenecks in the system and solve them.

title: Software Engineer - Backend
description_html: We’re at the forefront of the data revolution, committed to building the world’s greatest data and applications platform. Data Cloud allows sharing live data in governed and secure ways so our customers can solve their business problems. title: Principal Software Engineer I - Metadata
description_html: We are the Snowflake Metadata team. We own Snowflake’s metadata systems that make it easy for customers to query, modify and manage their petabyte-scale data. We develop distributed systems that store and maintain metadata, transaction frameworks that power Snowflake’s query and DML capabilities, asynchronous systems that provide time travel and lifecycle management capabilities and entity metadata supporting DDL capabilities. We also build foundational capabilities that deliver global features like cross-region replication (Snowgrid), data sharing, and data marketplace. AS A PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL: Solve real business needs at large scale by applying your software engineering and analytical problem solving skills.

You'll act as a trusted technical advisor, ensuring customers achieve significant business value and success with Snowflake.

A dynamic Context Graph and chat-based AI SRE provide rich context and automated workflows so teams can move from detection to root cause and resolution 10x faster. Leading engineering teams at companies like Capital One, Topgolf, and Dialpad rely on Observe to troubleshoot hundreds of terabytes of telemetry daily while maintaining reliability at enterprise scale.

We’re looking for dedicated students who share our passion for ground-breaking technology and want to create a lasting future for you and Snowflake.

We are seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to own and drive the effort to build core database capabilities to serve agentic workloads. You'll set the technical direction, build and grow the team behind it, and shape how the core engine and the SQL language evolve to serve this new class of workload.

description_html: The Snowhouse Foundation team builds our globally distributed data warehouse. Snowhouse powers all of Snowflake’s core business, engineering and data science needs and provides customers with full visibility into their account activities, usage, and resource consumption from all their global environments. The team is investing in multiple critical areas, including a pipeline authoring platform, high performance/high efficiency data export, ingestion and data layout.

Joining Secureframe means becoming part of a team dedicated to professional excellence and continuous learning in an environment that values creativity and forward-thinking. Secureframe is backed by top VCs including Kleiner Perkins, Accomplice, Gradient Ventures (Google’s AI Fund), BoxGroup, Village Global, and many more. Join Secureframe and help shape the future of compliance automation. Read the role details below to see if it's a fit. Secureframe highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture.

title: Head of Information Security
description_html: MOO is seeking an experienced Head of Information Security to review and re-build our security, privacy and resilience capabilities from the ground up and, in the first 12 months, to act as build lead for the digital and security aspects of a company-wide Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery and Incident Response programme. This is a standalone role, reporting to the Head of Legal It is not a caretaker or compliance-only position. You will operate as a hands-on builder defining strategy, establishing governance, writing playbooks, and directly influencing Engineering's roadmap and delivery practices to embed security, privacy and resilience by design.

title: Inbound Phone Representative
description_html: At MOO, we don’t just print business cards; we help people make their mark on the world. We believe great design is for everyone and our goal is to help customers achieve that! We are looking for an Inbound Call Specialist who is part problem-solver, part design-enthusiast, and 100% dedicated to the customer experience. As the literal voice of our brand, you will be the first point of contact for our customers when they call in. Whether they need help choosing the perfect paper stock, tracking down a delayed package, or fixing a design that didn't print quite right, you’ll be their hero. We don't believe in rigid, robotic call centers here—we believe in keeping it human, having real conversations, and delivering absolute delight on every single call.

title: People Coordinator
description_html: You will be joining a close-knit, global People Team that is passionate about high-quality employee experiences and driving a high-performance culture. Based in our Camden, UK office, you will report to the Head of People while collaborating deeply with our US, UK, and South African based partners to ensure a unified global strategy. We are huge advocates for our "MOOsters" and act as a bridge between business needs and employee delight. We’re looking for someone who is organised, proactive and genuinely passionate about creating great employee experiences! The Role You’ll play a key role in shaping the day-to-day employee experience at MOO.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description_html: We're a team of data engineers and analytics engineers running the platform that brings together data from our e-commerce, manufacturing, fulfilment, and finance systems. We build on a modern, warehouse-native stack — Snowflake, dbt, and Dagster — and we're working towards a governed semantic layer so trusted metrics are defined once and consumed everywhere: dashboards, self-service tools, and AI assistants. This role exists to own analytical domains end-to-end. Defining their metrics in the semantic layer with stakeholders, data modelling in dbt, and making sure a KPI resolves to the same trusted answer wherever it's consumed. The person we want You're an analytics engineer or data analyst with a rounded experience in data modelling and engineering practice.

title: Senior Strategy, Planning & Insight Analyst
description_html: Team Intro The Pricing & Commercial Performance team exists to help MOO make smarter commercial decisions. We sit across pricing, customer economics, acquisition, CRM, category management, forecasting, and commercial strategy. We help the business understand not just what is happening, but why, what matters, and what we should do next. We are not a reporting factory. We are a commercial thinking function. Our work spans everything from customer lifetime value modelling and pricing strategy to board-level storytelling, experimentation, forecasting, and strategic planning. We partner closely with team across Commercial, Finance, Product, Operations, and Technology to challenge assumptions, surface opportunities, and improve decision-making across the business.

title: Senior Procurement Specialist
description_html: Your Responsibilities Identify, evaluate, and select vendors and negotiate contracts , ensuring competitive pricing, quality, and timely delivery. Manage the full end to end procurement cycle from gathering requirements, identifying and appraising suppliers, negotiating contracts, and SRM activities, focussing on SaaS. Partner with various teams such as IT, Security, Finance, and Legal to streamline the process and ensure contracts are fully compliant and aligned with business needs and best practices. Procurement Process & Transformation Support the evolution of procurement from an IT-only focus to a company-wide function. Implement efficient procurement processes, including purchase requisition, order placement, and invoice reconciliation, leveraging technology tools and systems.

title: Senior Manager, Customer Success
description_html: The Opportunity We are seeking a seasoned, strategic, and team empowering leader to manage and grow our Customer Success team in APJ. This leadership role is pivotal in driving customer value, retention, and growth across our largest and most complex accounts as well as our growing customers. As the Senior Manager of Customer Success APJ, you will lead a team of experienced Customer Success Managers, ensuring they deliver best-in-class customer engagement across onboarding, adoption, expansion, and renewal. You will be instrumental in scaling the team through our next phase of growth, driving operational rigor, strategic account planning, and cross-functional collaboration.

title: Sales Enablement Manager - APJ
description_html: Meet the team behind this journey We are looking for a senior enablement business partner to drive and deliver GTM enablement impact focused on the APJ region with focus on Japan. The role holder will ensure tight alignment with our Sales, Presales and SDR leadership in the region, ensuring their needs and those of their teams are understood and recognised in the programmes and activities that the Enablement team delivers. You will work alongside the rest of the Enablement team to ensure a dynamic programme of enablement is planned spanning skills, product, tools, processes and programmes, working cross-functionally to ensure key learning, programme and productivity outcomes are realised.

title: Senior Financial Analyst - P2P
description_html: About DeepL DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing, and real-time voice translation. Founded in 2017, DeepL is backed by world-renowned investors and continues to grow rapidly as we build the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology. Meet the team behind this journey You'll join the Finance Operations team within P2P (Procure-to-Pay), working directly with our P2P lead and a close-knit Procurement, Accounts Payable and Travel & Expenses team.

title: Inbound Business Development Representative | DACH | German Speaking
description_html: Meet the team behind this journey In this role, you'll convert high-intent inbound interest into a qualified pipeline for the business. You'll work closely with our Marketing team to maximise the return on events(webinars, trade shows, DeepL Connect, virtual events) and always-on campaigns (contact forms, trials, white papers, content downloads). As often the first person a prospect speaks to, you'll shape their entire experience with DeepL from the very first touch. We're looking for an energetic, curious, and team-oriented people. You should have a passion for communication and languages, and a desire to be part of a hyper-growth scale-up!

title: Senior Software Engineer | Language Products | Full-Stack
description_html: Meet the team behind this journey DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication . We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 100 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally. You will join the Language Products Track . This is the heart of DeepL. You will be building and expanding our flagship translation products, the core engines that power everything from our consumer web translator to our Enterprise Customization Hub (Glossaries, Translation Memory, and Style Rules) and complex multimedia localization flows.

title: Senior Software Engineer | API
description_html: Meet the team behind this journey DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication . We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally. You will join the API Core team. For us, the API is the product. We are the bridge connecting DeepL's bleeding-edge AI capabilities to developers worldwide. We focus on Developer Experience (DevEx), API platform infrastructure, and enabling our internal product teams to launch world-class APIs quickly and independently.

title: Product GTM Specialist - DeepL Voice
description_html: About DeepL Voice DeepL Voice is shaping the future of real-time multilingual communication. Built on DeepL's world-leading translation quality, the Voice product line brings together Research, Engineering, Product, and GTM teams to deliver real-time speech-to-speech interpretation for meetings, live conversations, and developer integrations. In just two years, DeepL Voice has launched its first customer-facing products and built reliable, low-latency real-time systems. We are now scaling globally—expanding adoption, opening new use cases, and defining a new product category in multilingual communication. The Role As a Voice Product GTM Specialist, you will help bring DeepL Voice to market at scale.

title: Senior Software Engineer | Full-Stack
description_html: Meet the team behind this journey DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication . We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally. We are shifting gears. We are moving from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to just close tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire Missionaries—builders who obsess over the Why before the How. As a Senior Engineer at DeepL, you will operate with the agency of a founder.

title: Senior Information Security Manager (GRC)
description_html: Meet the team behind this journey DeepL is looking for a Senior Information Security Manager to strengthen our Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) function. You'll own the day-to-day operation of our information security and compliance program, with a strong focus on ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II, and a bonus if you bring HIPAA or BSI C5 experience to the table. This isn't a "gatekeeper" role. We're a SaaS scale-up, and our product teams move fast. We need someone who understands risk well enough to take calculated ones, someone who can say "yes, and here's how we do it safely" instead of defaulting to "no." You'll be the person who keeps compliance moving at the speed of the business, not the person who slows it down.

title: Head of Product Growth
description_html: Meet the team behind this journey DeepL runs product-led growth alongside our sales-led motion, with media translation as the strategic wedge. This role is responsible for turning DeepL into the default platform for translation worldwide driving adoption through product usage, and converting that usage into strong Product Qualified Leads (PQLs) tha convert into revenues and strengthen our sales pipeline. This role drives adoption of our core DeepL Translate features (e.g. Customization Hub, TQE) and cross-sell into adjacent products like DeepL Voice. You will start with a focus on Media Translation.

title: Renewal Success Manager - Japan
description_html: Meet the team behind this journey As we scale and mature as an organisation, we want to ensure that we don't just renew contracts but that we solidify partnerships with our customers. As a Renewal Success Manager at DeepL, you will be the commercial architect managing the most critical phase of the customer lifecycle, ensuring that the value realised by our customers translates into long-term commercial commitment. Your responsibilities Strategically lead the renewals process for some of our most critical and most complex customer engagements aligning customer health and usage with our pricing models and growth oriented contracts. Design pricing models and multi-year agreement that reward adoption and pave the way for future expansion.

title: Account Executive | in Österreich (m/w/d)
description_html: Meet the team behind this journey At DeepL, we're on an exciting adventure to expand our operations to match our ambitious growth plans. At the heart of this journey is our Sales team, a cornerstone of DeepL's market expansion and customer engagement strategy. Our mission is clear: to build and develop high-performing sales teams that embody DeepL's innovative spirit and commitment to excellence. As a member of our Sales team, you will play a central role in growing our business and expanding our global reach into new markets. Working in close partnership with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams, you will collaborate to deliver tailored solutions that genuinely meet our clients' needs.

title: Account Manager
description_html: The Role As an Account Manager, you will be the primary relationship owner for a portfolio of clients, responsible for ensuring they have an exceptional customer experience that drives successful renewals and expansion opportunities. You'll build strong relationships with key stakeholders, proactively address their needs, and serve as their trusted advisor throughout their journey with Hightouch. Your success will be measured by your ability to retain clients, grow their accounts, and position our solutions as essential to their business goals.

title: AI Strategy Consultant
description_html: The Role At its core, the AI Strategy Consultant role centers around driving marketing strategy and transformation in enterprise organizations. Today, most marketing communications are planned weeks in advance on a calendar based on dates and internal priorities. Each email, push, campaign takes 3-5 people and dozens of steps to create. Our customers come to us looking to transform the way they do marketing: using AI agents to rapidly learn about consumer preferences and deliver highly effective marketing and product experiences to each customer 1:1. As an AI Strategy Consultant, you are the trusted technical–strategic partner for our AI Decisioning customers.

title: Application Security Lead
description_html: the Role This is our first dedicated security hire, and it's a rare chance to define the function from the ground up. You'll own Hightouch's application security posture end-to-end. We have strong engineering fundamentals and a solid foundation; now you'll shape what security looks like here as we scale from 70 to 140+ engineers. This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role. You'll spend most of your time in the codebase, not in meetings. You’ll be solving hard problems at the intersection of security and distributed systems: Multi-tenant isolation on a system running ~1M data syncs per day and ingesting 100K+ events/sec Sub-tenant access control - for multi-team and multi-brand use cases, requiring differentiated access to configuration and data Security architecture - Build and refine our…

title: Customer Success Engineer
description_html: the Role The Customer Success Engineering role is demanding and requires strong organizational skills and an ability to multitask. You’ll work directly with all users to ensure they can get the most value from the platform. This may include answering questions in Intercom, Slack, on the phone, or through email. The nature of the work is technical and requires an understanding of how to read API documentation, how the standard suite of SaaS tools work (e.g. CRMs, ESPs, ERPs, etc...), and the basic building blocks of customers use data. The Customer Success Engineering role is also designed to provide broad exposure across the organization, including tight collaboration with Technical Account Managers, Solutions Engineers, Marketing, Engineering, and Operations.

title: Deployment Architect
description_html: The Role As an Deployment Architect, you will be the force behind successful deployments at Hightouch. Working in close partnership with an account team and the Hightouch product team, you will own the full deployment and enablement lifecycle for Hightouch customers. You will be primarily point of contact for customers during deployment phase and are responsible for executing the technical aspects of customer onboarding, ensuring seamless integration of Hightouch into customers' existing data infrastructure. In this role, you will be the product expert who translates complex customer requirements into actionable implementation plans. You should have a natural ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both data engineering teams and business stakeholders.

title: Developer Productivity Engineer
description_html: the Role We are looking for a developer productivity engineer to take responsibility for our monorepo and the “path to production” for over 50 engineers pushing over 75 commits a day with continuous deployment to production. This presents an exciting challenge where you can apply your expertise in helping teams ship fast and safe to meaningfully improve the productivity of our engineering team. This role also provides a unique opportunity to work on a multi-cloud and multi-region infrastructure that supports a global customer base. Our monorepo is primarily Javascript/Typescript with some Go and Python.

title: Engineering Manager, Agents
description_html: the Role We are looking for an engineering leader to work on our Agentic Marketing Platform, which allows marketers to run programs end-to-end rather than organize teams of specialists and agencies. The product has grown extremely quickly, and we’re continuing to invest aggressively in this area. There are a lot of exciting projects and challenges ahead, which also gives this role the potential to have significant impact. At Hightouch, our engineering leaders serve as both active technical voices and strong people managers. The key outcomes we are looking for from this role include: Product Development: Lead the team in roadmapping and executing successful development of significant features and products as required to drive the business forward.

title: Engineering Manager, Customer Studios
description_html: the Role We are looking for an engineering leader to work on Customer Studio, Hightouch’s second major product that provides a purpose-built no-code suite of features that enables anyone, regardless of their SQL experience, to activate data directly from their warehouse. The product has grown extremely quickly, now accounting for half of our revenue, and we’re continuing to invest aggressively in this area. There are still a ton of exciting projects and challenges ahead, which also gives this role the potential to have significant impact. At Hightouch, our engineering leaders serve as both active technical voices and strong people managers.

title: Engineering Manager, Destinations
description_html: the Role We’re looking for a talented, curious, and motivated engineering manager to lead our engineering team that manages our 300+ destination integrations. This role would involve a mix of leadership and hands-on engineering. Destination integrations are at the heart of Hightouch’s products. Every single Hightouch customer, from early adopters of our Agentic Marking Platform to customers running tens of thousands of syncs a day at scale, rely on these integrations to send their data to destinations like CRMs, advertising platforms, analytics engines, and more. We believe in enabling our engineers to do their best work for our customers by giving them extremely high levels of ownership and autonomy.

title: Enterprise Account Executive, APAC (Japan)
description_html: the Role We're building the infrastructure that lets companies actually activate their data, not just store it. As the first Account Executive selling into Japan you'll help define how we bring Hightouch to a region where data infrastructure is evolving fast, and enterprises are hungry for modern solutions. You'll be building a pipeline from scratch, running full sales cycles with enterprise accounts, and testing what resonates in APAC markets. You'll work directly with founders to shape our regional go-to-market strategy, influence product priorities based on what you're hearing in the field, and close deals that move the needle. This isn't about executing someone else's playbook—it's about writing it.

title: Enterprise Account Executive, DACH
description_html: Hightouch Hightouch’s mission is to empower everyone to take action on their data. We’ve pioneered the Composable Customer Data Platform (CDP), which helps companies use their own data warehouse to collect, prepare, and activate customer data for marketing personalization and busisness operations. Traditionally, acting on data has required engineering time and bandwidth, and left most business users stuck with charts and reports that are unable to take automated action on their data. With Hightouch, every business user, without writing any code, can activate data to streamline critical processes, improve marketing performance, and scale operations. Our team operates with a focus on making a meaningful impact for our customers.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - East
description_html: Hightouch Hightouch’s mission is to empower everyone to take action on their data. Hundreds of companies, including Autotrader, Calendly, Cars.com, Monday.com, and PetSmart, trust Hightouch to power their growth. We pioneered the Composable Customer Data Platform (CDP), which lets companies use their own data warehouse to collect, prepare, and activate customer data for marketing personalization and business operations. Our new AI Decisioning platform goes a step further, allowing marketers to set goals and guardrails that AI agents can then use to personalize 1:1 customer interactions. Traditionally, only technical teams had the skills to access and use customer data.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Mountain West
description_html: The Role Hightouch is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to join our fast-growing team. As a pivotal part of a small but dynamic sales organization, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of our product offering and contribute directly to our success. This is an exciting opportunity for a driven individual with significant enterprise sales experience, a passion for technology, and a talent for building meaningful relationships with clients. We’re seeking a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, has a strong track record in sales, and is eager to take the next step in their career with a rapidly scaling startup. The ideal candidate will possess a blend of sales expertise, entrepreneurial spirit, and a commitment to continuous learning.

title: Enterprise Account Executive, Paris
description_html: The Role Hightouch is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to join our Southern Europe team, based out of our beautiful Paris office. As part of our small but growing EMEA team, you'll play a key role in expanding our presence across the region. We're a small, high-impact team looking for someone with at least 4 years of enterprise sales experience who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments. The right candidate is someone with a proven track record of closing complex deals who's excited to build their career with a fast-growing startup. You're coachable, bring a strong work ethic and entrepreneurial mindset, and are energised by the opportunity to shape our go-to-market strategy in South EMEA.

title: Senior Accountant
description_html: As a Senior Accountant, you will play an important role in supporting Grow Therapy's accounting operations and financial close process. Reporting to the Head of Accounting, this role will own key close processes, support external audit and tax compliance, and partner cross-functionally to strengthen financial controls and build scalable processes. This role offers the opportunity to own and scale core accounting workstreams, including revenue/accounts receivable, cost of sales/provider payouts, intercompany, and treasury. What You’ll Be Doing: Own core accounting processes across Revenue and Accounts Receivable, Cost of Services and Provider Payouts, Intercompany, and Treasury, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with US GAAP.

title: Senior/Staff Product Designer
description_html: The Opportunity: We're looking for a Senior or Staff Product Designer to join our Product Growth team. This role will shape how clients discover and navigate early parts of their experience with Grow Therapy. The Product Growth team is within our Match Success org, one of Grow's highest-priority areas where we help clients identify their needs, evaluate potential providers, and get them started on their therapy journey. You'll lead 0→1 design work — from strategy through launch — impacting millions of people looking for mental health support, and set the craft bar for how growth-focused design gets done at Grow. You’ll stand out as an applicant if you’ve worked on a consumer-focused growth team (B2C).

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
description_html: The Opportunity We're hiring a Software Engineer to help build and evolve the backend systems that power Grow Therapy's platform. In this role, you'll design, implement, and ship server-side features and services that directly impact how clients and providers connect, communicate, and access care. You'll join a collaborative, product-focused engineering organization where technical work is closely tied to reliability, scalability, and real-world outcomes. This role is ideal for an engineer who takes pride in writing clean, well-tested code, thinks carefully about system design and data integrity, and is energized by the opportunity to grow alongside a fast-moving team.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack
description_html: The Opportunity We're hiring a Full Stack Senior Software Engineer to help build and evolve the systems that power Grow Therapy's platform. In this role, you'll work across the stack to design, implement, and ship features that directly impact how clients and providers connect, communicate, and access care. You'll join a collaborative, product-focused engineering organization where technical work is closely tied to learning, iteration, and real-world outcomes. This role is ideal for an engineer who takes pride in writing clean, maintainable code, thinks deeply about system behavior, and is energized by the opportunity to grow alongside a fast-moving team.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Developer Experience & AI Enablement
description_html: The Opportunity: We are looking for a Senior AI Enablement Engineer to join the Product Infrastructure team at Grow Therapy and help define how AI transforms the way we work across the entire organization. You will design and build the foundational AI infrastructure, tooling, and workflows that enable every department to operate more efficiently and effectively. You will be part of a hub-based team in San Francisco. Your responsibilities will include building scalable AI systems, partnering cross-functionally with Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and People teams, and driving measurable adoption of AI-powered workflows company-wide.

title: Staff Product Manager, Patient Experience (Payments)
description_html: About the Role: One of the biggest barriers to accessing mental health care today is cost uncertainty and financial constraints. As the Product Manager for Grow’s new Billing Experience team, you will own a charter focused on building a best-in-class experience that gives clients confidence to start and continue care. You will define the product vision and lead a roadmap that transforms one of the most frustrating aspects of healthcare into a meaningful differentiator for Grow. This is an opportunity to turn complexity into clarity and create an experience that clients trust. Working closely with engineering, design, data, and operations, you will have the strategic ownership to define what best-in-class truly means in a space where no competitor has fully solved the problem.

title: Senior Platform Reliability Engineer
description_html: About the Role We’re hiring a Senior Platform Reliability Engineer to help define and scale reliability as a first-class capability at Grow. In this role you’ll operate horizontally across the organization, shaping how reliability is understood, measured, and built into the developer experience. You’ll work closely with other members of the platform team as well as our product engineering teams to establish standards around observability, SLOs/SLAs, and incident response—while also helping translate those standards into self-service tooling and “golden paths” that make it easy for teams to adopt them. This is a high-impact, highly autonomous role where you’ll drive both cultural and technical change, ultimately enabling teams to independently build and operate reliable systems at scale.

title: Staff Engineer, Security
description_html: The Opportunity This is a Senior or Staff level role owning detection and incident response at Grow. The core of the job is: catching threats early through strong detection engineering, moving fast on unfamiliar systems when something does happen, and having a real point of view on where the architecture is exposed before it becomes a problem. It's cross functional by design, working closely with infrastructure, engineering, and compliance. What You'll Be Doing Share security judgment and standards with teams across the company, raising the bar beyond the security org itself Investigate and resolve security incidents across endpoint, network, and cloud, understanding unfamiliar systems well enough to respond with confidence Research the threats and attack methods most relevant to a…

title: Staff Software Engineer - Developer Experience & Ai Enablement
description_html: The Opportunity: Grow Therapy's Developer Experience team exists to make our ~120 engineers (and growing) measurably faster and happier. We treat developer tools as a product: our customers are engineers, and everything we ship, from CI/CD and test infrastructure to build tooling and AI-native development workflows, is judged by whether it makes their day better. We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to set technical direction for this work across the engineering organization. The team is small, fully senior, and largely greenfield: the goals are set at the org level and tracked by our most senior technology leaders, but the project list is yours to discover. Today, improvements to how teams build, test, and review code live in pockets.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Data Infrastructure
description_html: The Opportunity You'll build and mature our cloud security posture, working closely with infrastructure, engineering, and compliance to deliver secure products for the providers and patients on our platform. You'll also be in a rare position to shape how AI gets used in security here, not just adopting tools yourself, but designing agents that take on real security work. What You'll Be Doing Design and build the security foundation for Grow's infrastructure as it scales Research the threats and attack methods most relevant to Grow's applications and infrastructure, and turn that research into real solutions Improve our cloud security posture in close partnership with infrastructure, engineering, and compliance Respond to security incidents, from critical to routine, and participate in an…

title: Senior Planner
description_html: We’re looking for a Senior Planner to join the Brand Planning team and lead marketing strategy and execution for an emerging side of our growing business: Enterprise, Payor, and Partnerships. In this role, you’ll lead development of a marketing strategy for B2B audiences in close partnership with cross-functional leaders, including positioning and messaging, audience insights, channel planning, roadmaps and creative executions. You’ll be the owner of insights and marketing initiatives related to these audiences, and act as the connective tissue between relevant product, creative, research, data, and other teams to ensure consistency and alignment to the overall company and brand strategy.

title: Engineering Manager, iOS and Android
description_html: About the role The Momentum team builds experiences that support our clients in their mental health journey outside of active care — the 167 hours a week they're not in a session. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a full-stack, product-focused team through the next phase of that work: taking us from 0 to 1 as we learn what clients actually need, then from 1 to 100 as we build out the capabilities that serve those needs. This is a build-from-the-ground-up role. You'll drive the early architecture decisions for a team that's still defining its shape, lead a mix of backend and mobile engineers, and partner closely with product and design to shape what we build.

title: Senior Business Data Analyst, Business Analytics
description_html: We’re looking for a Senior Business Data Analyst, Business Analytics to play a critical role in enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. You will partner with business leaders to scope, design, and build the appropriate analytical tools and metrics to answer strategic and operational questions. This will include defining and operationalizing key performance indicators (KPIs), uncovering insights through rigorous analysis, developing scalable dashboards and reporting frameworks, and ultimately translating data into business value. Success in this role is measured by the impact of insights on strategic and operational decisions, clarity of metrics delivered, and measurable improvements in business outcomes such as growth, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

title: Director, Revenue Cycle Management Operations
description_html: The Opportunity: Grow's RCM org is at an inflection point — scaling operational maturity, integrating AI-driven automation, and preparing for increasingly complex payor partnerships. This role builds the operational foundation that makes that evolution possible. It's right for you if you're energized by building systems that didn't exist before, leading managers and teams through transformation, and owning the operational levers that directly drive a company's financial performance. What You’ll Be Doing: Own end-to-end RCM operational performance across eligibility, claim submission, follow-up, denials, contracts, and authorizations, translating department strategy into execution across your team.

title: Director, Lifecycle & Retention
description_html: About the Role We are looking for a Director of Lifecycle & Retention to lead the delivery of an excellent customer experience across our multi-sided marketplace. In this role, you’ll own retention and lifecycle marketing - accountable for both strategy and execution. You will develop learning agendas, partner on advanced measurement approaches, and ensure that every initiative delivers clear, measurable impact and business growth through excellent experiences. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Customer service, Finance, and Creative to build strategies with alignment, accelerate performance outcomes, and bring the right message to the right customer at the right time.

As an Accounts Payable Accountant , you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, efficiency and compliance of our Accounts Payable processes.

title: Technical Product Manager
description_html: The Opportunity The hardest and most interesting problem in enterprise right now is making AI actually useful inside real, messy workflows. Most enterprises are failing at exactly that step, and it is the single biggest bottleneck standing between them and an AI transformation that works. At Within you’ll own the product surfaces where that gets decided: turning complex AI capabilities into experiences customers love, and doing it fast. This is a full-stack builder role. You’ll own meaningful product areas end to end, from discovery through delivery, working directly with our CTO , engineering and design leads, and GTM, with the autonomy to define a problem, prototype the answer yourself, and ship it.

title: Staff Technical Product Manager
description_html: The Opportunity Enterprises are trying to transform themselves with AI, and most are failing at the same step: making AI actually useful inside real, messy workflows. That is the problem Within exists to solve, and it is the single biggest bottleneck in enterprise today. As our product org scales, the constraint is no longer ideas. It's orchestration: getting the right context to every pod, measuring what we ship, and keeping GTM, Value Delivery, and customers moving in lockstep with engineering. This role owns that connective layer. Your job is to make the entire product org faster, better informed, and more decisive. What You'll Own The agentic operating system for product and engineering.

title: Staff Product Designer
description_html: About the role We're looking for a Staff Product Designer — a senior individual contributor who acts as a force multiplier across Within's product. You'll lead multiple complex, ambiguous design efforts end to end, set the bar for craft and for how design and code work together, and shape how our AI-native enterprise product holds together as one coherent system. Designer first, you bring your designs to life in working prototypes and into the product itself, with engineering alongside you. We care about your systems thinking, and your track record of shipping — not your degree. Enterprise software has a reputation for being clunky and hard to trust. Our bet is the opposite: that the most powerful Enterprise AI product can also be the most intuitive. Design is how we win that bet.

title: AI Backend Engineer
description_html: AI Backend Engineer @ Within Experience: 1-3 years shipping production code (or exceptional new grads with strong portfolios) Location: San Francisco / Bay Area (Relocation assistance available) Job Type: Full-time The Role We're hiring Backend + Applied AI Engineers to build the core systems that power Within's multimodal agents in real enterprise environments. This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of distributed systems and applied AI: you'll design and ship backend services that ingest messy real-world data, orchestrate model/agent workflows, enforce enterprise-grade security and deliver reliable outcomes at scale.

You care deeply about craft and have strong frontend fundamentals, but you're early in your career and hungry to grow. You'll work directly with senior engineers and designers to build AI-native workflows that make complex enterprise tools feel intuitive. Note: We do not require a CS or Engineering degree. You'll navigate a nuanced dynamic: Within compresses the discovery and documentation work that consulting firms have historically billed for, while simultaneously making their engagements more profitable and their clients happier.

We're already on prompt v9 in our internal screening pipeline. We need someone who takes it to v50. title: Lead Software Engineer
description_html: We help companies get compensation right. What we get paid at work has a massive impact on our lives, and it’s one of the biggest factors in hiring and retaining talent - and yet so many companies struggle to get it right. They simply have no choice but to rely on poor data and unsophisticated tools for their pay decisions. That’s why we created Ravio. We help many of the world’s most innovative and ambitious companies build stronger teams and reach their goals through better compensation. Our real-time data platform brings compensation into the modern age, tracking the market across all compensation types from salary to equity and benefits. Ravio is growing fast, which means you can too.

title: Account Executive

You’ll become an expert in compensation, identify market trends, and share insights that help shape our product and marketing strategy—including how we bring an agentic layer to our compensation data and insights.
