This is your chance to help build a category-defining company at an exciting point in its evolution. You’ll develop new relationships with HR and Reward leaders and establish Ravio as the go-to compensation insights platform in your territory.

title: Member of Technical Staff (Frontend)
description_html: For four years, Footprint's frontend was the front door for developers: onboarding flows customers embed, SDKs they integrate, a dashboard where they configure verification. Percy changed who lives in the product. Over the past year, compliance teams and investigators moved from configuring Footprint to working inside it: reviewing what an agent found, editing the case narrative, signing off on decisions a regulator will read. The interface became the place our users do their job, and the bar for polish, speed, and clarity rose with it. The team that owns all of this is a small team of senior engineers. The design system, the SDKs, the monorepo tooling, the release pipeline - all of it runs through them, and they set the standards the rest of engineering ships frontend against.

title: Sales Development Representative
description_html: As a Sales Development Representative, you'll be on the forefront of driving Footprint's growth by generating new business opportunities through strategic outreach and engagement. This role is for someone hyper-focused on delivering results who understands that this often requires constant, independent process innovation. You'll work directly with our sales and growth team to build and execute top-of-funnel strategy, gaining deep exposure to the financial crime, compliance, and identity verification space. On a team this small, every contribution you make has a direct impact on the company's growth trajectory. You'll report directly to the Head of GTM Strategy.

title: Member of Technical Staff (Backend)
description_html: For four years, our backend systems helped answer one question: should this company onboard this user? The clear cases were automated; the ambiguous ones went to a human who worked each case by hand. That's where the fraud worth catching tends to be. Footprint's risk agent, Percy, goes after that queue: an agent that can do more in review than a person can, and faster. The identity verification platform underneath it was built for bounded request/response work, and now agent-shaped workloads ask different questions of it. There's little precedent to copy. You'd span both worlds: the platform financial services run on today, and the agentic products we're building on top of it. You'll report directly to the Head of Engineering - Elliott Forde. What You'll Own API and service design.

title: Member of Technical Staff (Infrastructure)
description_html: For four years, Footprint's infrastructure had one job: run identity verifications fast, correctly, and always. A verification is a bounded request. It arrives, it resolves, it returns. Percy changed the shape of the problem. An investigation is a long-running agent that reasons across dozens of data sources, spawns sub-agents, executes code in an isolated sandbox, and writes an audit record a regulator will eventually read. It takes minutes. It costs real money every time it runs. It fails in ways a request/response API never does. And it now sits on the critical path of our customers' financial-crime operations, on some of the most sensitive data on the internet. Our backend engineers built all of it while also shipping product, and they've kept it up.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description_html: Percy runs financial-crime investigations inside our customers' operations, against their own procedures, on their real data. Getting each new customer from the first technical conversation to production - connected, configured, proven against their own analysts, trusted - is a real engineering job, and today the engineers who build Percy are the ones doing it. Footprint is signing customers fast enough that this needs to be someone's whole job. That's this role. You'll embed with banks and fintechs to learn how they run investigations, then implement Percy and build the agents that do the work against their procedures. You configure and extend the product itself; per-account bespoke builds are out of scope.

title: Head of Partnerships
description_html: For four years, Footprint sold direct. Our AEs found the compliance and risk leaders drowning in investigations, and Percy did the rest. Banks and fintechs don't decide alone. When a compliance team is short-staffed, needs its procedures updated, or has to get a new tool implemented, it calls a consulting firm or an advisor. Increasingly, Percy is what those firms recommend. We have those partnerships in place today, we're expanding the roster deliberately, and partnerships already make up a substantial piece of our pipeline. The channel has no dedicated leader. Every partner relationship we have was built by someone doing it alongside another full-time job. That's this role, and it's a seat set up to win from day one.

description_html: CEST for at least 20 hours/week. Think “data plane” and “control plane” for enterprise code: the surfaces where intent becomes code changes across hundreds (or more!) of repositories. This is a team that builds products that use AI and products for AI. The roadmap, the architecture, and the day-to-day technical decisions all hinge on a solid experience with and a clear-eyed view of what AI models and agents are good at, where they fail, and how to design products around them.

description_html: クリエイティブチームは、顧客に対して独自性があり、関連性が高く、時代性を反映したビジュアルコンテンツを提供しています。消費者調査、独自データ、そして30年にわたるトレンドレポートの経験を組み合わせた業界でも類を見ないアプローチにより、顧客が消費者とのつながりを生み出すビジュアルコンテンツを見つけるための実践的なインサイトを提供しています。 また、世界中のフォトグラファー、映像クリエイター、イラストレーターからなるコントリビューターネットワークと密接に連携し、市場をリードする、本物志向で差別化されたコンテンツを開発しています。 求める人物像 あなたは日本語と英語に堪能で、視覚表現の仕組みに強い関心を持つ方です。あらゆる形のビジュアルコミュニケーションに自然と興味を持ち、日々目にするコンテンツについて語ることを楽しめます。 クリエイティブな感性と分析力を兼ね備え、リサーチ業務を楽しみながら、自身の知見を広く発信することに抵抗がありません。 高い組織力と細部への注意力を持ち、複数のプロジェクトや業務が同時進行する環境でも、期限を守りながら効率的に管理できます。また、問題を迅速に特定し、自ら適切な解決策を見出せる創造的な問題解決力を備えています。 さらに、アートやカルチャーの最新トレンドに敏感で、自身の洞察や視点を多様な専門性を持つクリエイティブチームに積極的に共有できる方を歓迎します。 本ポジションは契約期間1年間の有期雇用です。 主な業務内容 リサーチ・分析 自社コンテンツ管理システム内で、コンテンツ分析を支援するテーマ別ライトボックスを作成する 静止画・動画など複数フォーマットのクリエイティブコンテンツを定性的に分析し、テーマやパターンを特定してコンテンツニーズや機会を見出す 自社の検索データおよび販売データを分析し、顧客の関心やコンテンツニーズの変化を把握・予測する…

We’ve partnered with product to test, iterate, and share feedback on how our customers use the product. As we prepare for our next phase of growth, we’re hiring a team of operators to help build the engine that can craft a scalable customer experience and that can find, derisk and launch new parts of the business.

We prototype, ship, and learn from AI experiments that turn Ambrook's proprietary advantages into category-defining capabilities no horizontal tool can replicate. Ambrook customers span industries underserved by modern AI — the opportunity is to define what business tools look like when they're built with real operational context, data, and domain depth from the start. The team: Jeff Anders (co-founder, head of design), Henry Bridge (tech lead), plus 2-3 new engineers (you?). Read more at ambrook.com/labs .

description_html: The opportunity We're hiring a Talent Associate to help build the team behind Ambrook's next phase of growth. You'll work directly with our founding recruiter to own sourcing and coordination across both technical and commercial roles. You’ll spend your time finding strong candidates, keeping the process moving, and creating an exceptional candidate experience from first touch through onsite. Recruiting is changing. As you grow, there are real paths forward: full-cycle recruiting, RecOps & talent engineering, or deeper sourcing expertise, depending on your strengths, goals, and where the company needs you most. Our team is building automations using Claude, Zapier, and Ashby and we’ll get you set up on our team’s Github account as part of onboarding.

title: Product Specialist (Sales)
description_html: The opportunity Ambrook has grown from a farm-and-ranch accounting tool into an AI-native financial platform spanning accounting, banking, invoicing, and Full Service bookkeeping, and the job has grown with it. Product Specialists don't just close new business. They're product experts who guide owner-operators across many industries to the right plan and configuration and get them successfully up and running. Under our sales-assist model, you'll own the arc from first touch through activation and early expansion, deliver product feedback along the way, and make every interaction build our brand. While we value proven experience, we're also looking for people who identify with the communities we serve.

title: Product Manager, Fintech
description_html: The opportunity Ambrook is building a world-class team. As our fintech PM, you'll lead our work to build payments and banking capabilities that help Ambrook’s SMB operators run more sustainable and profitable businesses. You’ll report directly to Ambrook’s co-founder and Head of Product, Dan Schlosser . Own: Product direction and execution for neobanking products (Ambrook Wallet, Card, Bill Pay, Invoicing, and SMB payments network), driving customer acquisition (topline revenue), engagement, and retention. Teach: Best practices in product management, fintech industry best practices and trends, flow of funds design, risk and fraud mitigation, and go-to-market strategy.

title: Deployment Specialist, Finance
description_html: Ambrook has grown from 100 to 8,000+ customers in the last 18 months. As a Deployment Specialist on the Services team, you'll be building the infrastructure to help our most strategic users get even more value out of the product and their financial data, in a way that can scale with our next 12 months of growth. Your mission is to deeply understand our customers, and then build the tools, agents, and templates that will enable them to get real insight out of their financial data.

title: Software Engineer, Platform
description_html: The opportunity Ambrook's platform engineers build the foundational systems that let the rest of the company build Ambrook better. This is a broad mandate: you'll work across product infrastructure, including our PostgreSQL databases and GCP environment, and company infrastructure, including internal tooling, data platforms, and the systems that power internal AI workflows. Most of our stack is TypeScript, with some GCP scripting you'll pick up on the job. This role combines strong infrastructure judgment with a product mindset. You'll learn from the engineers and non-engineering teams who depend on the platform, iterate quickly for them, and defend the quality, security, and scalability standards that keep Ambrook dependable as we grow.

title: Talent Engineer
description_html: The opportunity Right now, recruiting teams are using AI to do the same work a little faster. This job starts from a different premise: the company is the product, and recruiting is its growth funnel. You will map the tech ecosystem to find the best technologists in the world to join Ambrook, and build the systems that actually do the work: sourcing, follow-ups, tracking, reporting, all running on their own. When the machine handles that, you get precious time back for the good stuff: the conversations, deciding who's really right for a team, and sharing the mission. A chance to use technology to make recruiting more human than it's been in a long time. If you want to start a company someday, this seat is one of the highest leverage ones to be in.

title: Quantitative Researcher, Early Career

Our role offers the opportunity to design, implement, and evaluate research systems components using rigorous statistical methodologies. As part of the team, you will gain exposure to diverse research areas, accelerating your expertise in quantitative finance. Requirements: A Bachelor’s degree (BS) in mathematics, statistics, machine learning, physics, computer science, or other scientific disciplines is required. Execution of the company's work lives with the functional and program management teams. This role makes sure those teams have the right direction, the right inputs, and the right forums to do it.

title: Assembly Process Engineer - Contract
description_html: an Assembly Process Engineer - Contract As a SPARC Assembly Process Engineer, you will help create, define, instruct, and assist in managing the process by which we assemble the SPARC tokamak device. This will include collaborating with the system design teams on the sequence and key steps, organizing and designating how the various sub-assemblies will come together to create the larger whole, identifying assembly methods and tools required, and then writing these steps into work instruction packets for use by the assembly technicians to use in the field. You will work closely and collaborate with the other SPARC teams to find the most efficient, creative, cost-effective, and safest way to assemble each part of the tokamak.

title: Control Software Engineer
description_html: a Control Software Engineer As a Control Software Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, implementation, and verification of software and controls for advanced R&D equipment and complex machinery. As a member of the Software Engineering team you will be a hands-on technical contributor, a champion of writing excellent quality, production-ready code for mission-critical real-time systems. You will collect functional requirements from customers and produce software solutions to meet these requirements. You will work with a variety of engineers to integrate your software into software testbeds, hardware testbeds, and the production tools. You will also contribute to the broader software ecosystem to improve tooling and processes used across the company.

title: Diagnostician
description_html: a Diagnostician Commonwealth Fusion Systems is assembling the high-field SPARC tokamak, which aims to be the first magnetic fusion device to achieve net fusion energy, and is predicted to be able to achieve high gain and fusion power up to 140MW. We are completing the design and beginning the assembly and installation of diagnostic systems that will be used to control the plasma and deliver the scientific data necessary to complete the design of ARC. These include approximately 40 sub-systems covering magnetics, interferometry, neutral pressure, x-ray to visible spectroscopy, camera imaging, bolometry, neutrons, Thomson scattering, electron cyclotron emission, reflectometry, Langmuir probes and structural temperature and strain sensing.

title: Director, Project Development
description_html: Director, Project Development We are a historic moment, with CFS on the cusp of proving the commercial viability of fusion power via our SPARC demonstration plant in Devens, MA. This role will play an instrumental part in taking the next step after this proof point by developing and delivering the first grid scale commercial fusion power plant. We are looking for an exceptional candidate, with the experience, tenacity, and drive to not only develop the site for the first ARC power plant near Richmond, VA, but establish the pipeline and the playbook to deliver the first set of ARC power plants. This is a unique opportunity to participate in the delivery of power plants that will mark a new era of commercial fusion power.

title: Facilities and Maintenance Electrician
description_html: a Maintenance Electrician The Maintenance Electrician will be responsible for installation of and preventive and corrective maintenance for various facilities and manufacturing electrical equipment. These responsibilities will be based at our campus in Devens Massachusetts but may periodically be asked to perform work in our Somerville, Massachusetts location. What you'll do: Perform preventive and corrective maintenance of complex manufacturing equipment such as CNC machining centers, process ovens and specialty manufacturing equipment Provide maintenance support for projects such as the installation, relocation, or modification of manufacturing equipment Utilize a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) for tracking the maintenance and repair of equipment and facilities…

title: Fiber Optic Specialist
description_html: a Fiber Optic Specialist The Fiber Optic Specialist on the SPARC Assembly Team is an exciting and evolving role with a responsibility for performing all aspects of optical fiber work such as fiber handling, splicing, testing, and incorporation of fibers into complex design features in the process of assembling our fusion machine. The technician will ensure functional installation, health, and operation of the fibers, as well as look for opportunities for continuous improvement. Responsibilities include close cooperation with Operations, Engineering, Quality, and other departments to ensure goals and objectives are met. This role will lead the way to making Earth sustainable for the future to come. This work is conducted within a multi-disciplinary team of technicians and engineers.

title: Field Mechanical Engineer - Assembly
description_html: a Field Mechanical Engineer - Assembly As the Field Mechanical Engineer on the Assembly Team at CFS, you will be the co-owner of the SPARC assembly process. You help guide technicians through any issues that arise along the way and come up with solutions that continue work and assembly moving forward. You will proactively ensure that they have all the tools required for the work, either procuring them off-the-shelf or quickly designing and building small tools and fixtures for use. This also includes the close collaboration with adjacent teams on the Assembly Team, such as creating and incorporating the new process changes with the Assembly Process team or providing the Metrology team with any assistance or tools needed for the precision alignment of coils and other key structures.

title: Lead Assembly Technician
description_html: Lead Assembly Technician As a Lead Technician on the Assembly Team at CFS, you will be responsible for overseeing and organizing the small technician teams to conduct all assembly activities to construct the SPARC Tokamak. This includes the handling, alignment, and mechanical integration of large electromagnetic coils, vacuum vessels, instrumentation systems, support structures, tooling and manipulation equipment, diagnostic systems, and superconducting cable bundles, all together into a tightly packed and highly integrated central device. You will use your extensive experience in building and handling large equipment, structures, or plant systems to facilitate the efficient and high-quality completion of SPARC.

title: Lead Assembly Technician - Second Shift
description_html: Lead Assembly Technician As a Lead Technician on the Assembly Team at CFS, you will be responsible for overseeing and organizing the small technician teams to conduct all assembly activities to construct the SPARC Tokamak. title: Account Executive
description_html: ABOUT THE TEAM Funding Options joined the Tide family in early 2023 to lead their Partner Credit Services offering. Through their panel of 100 leading lender partners, Funding Options supports UK SMEs to get the right finance in place so they can trade, plan and grow with confidence. Through their multi award-winning platform, Funding Cloud, they can effectively match customers to the right lender and finance product that best suits their needs in minutes with funding decisions in as little as 20 seconds, giving every customer a 5 Star experience whether successful or not, through our sheer professionalism and outstanding standard of customer service.

title: Account Executive – SME Credit
description_html: Über das Team Du wirst Teil eines engagierten Teams, das den Markterfolg von Tide in Deutschland ausbaut. Das Team bringt Expertise aus Finanzdienstleistungen, Technologie und lokalem Marktverständnis zusammen und gestaltet gemeinsam das Wachstum von Tide in Deutschland. Partner Credit Services ist der KMU-Kreditmarktplatz von Tide: In Zusammenarbeit mit Kreditpartnern vermitteln wir die passende Finanzierung für kleine und mittelgroße Unternehmen. Über die Rolle Als Sales Executive bist Du Teil unseres Vertriebsteams und berichtest direkt an den Team Lead Sales. Du betreust ein bereits qualifiziertes, warmes Pipeline aus unserem CRM – Dein Fokus liegt darauf, diese Kunden kompetent zu beraten und zum Abschluss zu bringen.

title: Business Development Executive - French Speaking
description_html: ABOUT THE TEAM: The Onboarding Team is a front-line team, looking to convert as many prospective/cold leads into becoming a Tide Member and taking advantage of many Tide products during their Onboarding period. We collaborate with marketing, product and the KYC Teams to ensure a seamless Onboarding experience for prospective members, providing key insights to all stakeholders. ABOUT THE ROLE: As an Business Development Executive you responsibilities will include: Driving market expansion – Engage with prospective SME members, address objections, and effectively communicate the benefits of using the Tide app for their business needs.

title: Business Development Specialist (Outbound- International)
description_html: ABOUT THE TEAM Funding Options joined the Tide family in early 2023 to lead their Partner Credit Services offering. Through their panel of 100 leading lender partners, Funding Options supports UK SMEs to get the right finance in place so they can trade, plan and grow with confidence. Through their multi award-winning platform, Funding Cloud, they can effectively match customers to the right lender and finance product that best suits their needs in minutes with funding decisions in as little as 20 seconds, giving every customer a 5 Star experience whether successful or not, through our sheer professionalism and outstanding standard of customer service.

title: Commercial Services - UK Country Commercial Lead
description_html: About the team The Commercial Services team is responsible for enabling our members to access Tide tools which allow them to both sell to their customers but also to buy effectively and save time and money. Our aim is to make their commerce and customer management seamless, and manageable fully via Tide. We work closely with Product, BI, CRM, Sales, and Operations teams to translate member and market insights into appealing product enhancements, effective positioning, go-to-market strategies, and campaigns that enhance engagement and retention.

title: Customer Support Executive with German (Onboarding)
description_html: About the team The Onboarding Team is a front-line team, looking to convert as many prospective/cold leads into becoming a Tide Member and taking advantage of many Tide products during their Onboarding period. We collaborate with marketing, product and the KYC Teams to ensure a seamless Onboarding experience for prospective members, providing key insights to all stakeholders. About the role As a Customer Support Executive with German (Onboarding), you will act as a key liaison between Tide and potential members, ensuring they see the value of joining a leading fintech company. Your role combines excellent customer service with strong sales skills to convert leads into full Tide members. Why? Tide is growing, and with that comes a high level of interest.

title: Director of Engineering
description_html: ABOUT THE TEAM You will lead the Client Engineering organisation, responsible for the core health and delivery of Tide’s mobile and web applications. This group comprises Core Architecture, Engineering Productivity, and Quality Engineering . Your mission is to ensure our frontend ecosystem is a competitive advantage, providing the standards and tools that allow our product teams to build with confidence and speed. You will lead a team of Engineering Managers and partner with a tenured community of Staff Engineers to solve our most complex technical challenges. ABOUT THE ROLE As Director of Engineering, you own the technical direction and standards for Tide’s frontend. We are looking for a leader who is deeply engaged in the architectural health of our applications.

title: Engineering Manager
description_html: ABOUT THE ROLE: As an Engineering Manager at Tide, you will be responsible for building and running the products your team owns, covering everything our members need to run their business, from banking and payments through to administration and operational tooling. This role offers an exceptional opportunity to make a real difference by taking ownership of engineering practices in a rapidly expanding company! We trust and empower our Engineering Managers to make real architectural decisions that affect their domain and shape the future of Tide’s Platform. We operate in domain-aligned, full-stack teams that own products end to end. Engineers self-organise, collaborate on technical challenges, and define shared standards through Communities of Practice.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description_html: HiveMQ’s Vision for this role The HiveMQ Dev team is dedicated to ensuring application resiliency and delivering the HiveMQ software platform in the highest quality. As a member of the HiveMQ development team, you will design, develop, and deliver solutions that enhance the scalability, availability, and efficiency of the HiveMQ software portfolio. We work with agile principles and believe ruthless automation and smart use of AI tools enables us to move fast while continuously meriting the trust that our customers place in us. You will… Architect, build, and maintain the HiveMQ platform software for massively-scalable global IoT deployments. Create self-healing software systems with state-of-the-art tools. Develop and implement concurrent, maintainable, and performant algorithms.

title: Senior AI Fullstack Engineer – Cloud Applications
description_html: HiveMQ’s Vision for this role We aren't just using AI to help us code; we are an AI-native engineering organization. Our next major milestone is architecting a swarm of autonomous coding bees - specialized agents designed to handle end-to-end feature delivery, from infra provisioning to self-correction. We need an engineer who can define the hive's architecture, the pollination patterns (data flow), and the rigorous guardrails that allow these agents to build - and run - at scale. You will… Design and evolve the architecture of our autonomous agent swarm — defining agent boundaries, data flows, and the feedback loops that allow bees to self-correct and deliver features end-to-end.

title: Director of Product Management - Data Streaming
description_html: The Opportunity We’re seeking an exceptional Director of Product Management to lead HiveMQ’s Data Streaming portfolio — the connectivity and transport foundation that every other layer of our Industrial AI Platform depends on. The core product is our flagship offering: HiveMQ Enterprise Broker, the high-performance MQTT server running at the core of industrial operations at companies mentioned above and more. A critical and differentiating element of the Enterprise Broker is its extensibility system — the mechanism by which new functionality is built in the field, validated against real customer needs, and reviewed, generalized, and graduated into the core product.

title: Customer Success Director - Healthcare (C1 - B2B)
description_html: Have you ever had that green-light feeling? When you hit every green light and the day just feels like magic. CLEAR's mission is to create frictionless experiences where every day has that feeling. With more than 30+ million passionate members and hundreds of partners around the world, CLEAR’s identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it’s at the airport, stadium, or right on your phone, CLEAR connects you to the things that make you, you - unlocking easier, more secure, and more seamless experiences - making them all feel like magic. The Customer Success Director – Healthcare will own and execute CLEAR’s healthcare customer success strategy, driving long-term value, adoption, and expansion across our partner ecosystem.
location: New York, New York, United States

title: Director, Engineering (Web & Mobile)
description_html: We are seeking a collaborative, strategic, and execution-focused engineering leader to shape the digital experiences that millions of people have with CLEAR. As a Director of Engineering, you will lead multiple engineering teams responsible for building and scaling our consumer products across the CLEAR mobile app, website, digital enrollment experiences, marketing technology, and Concierge platform. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Marketing, and business leaders to create intuitive, high-performing experiences that drive acquisition, engagement, conversion, and member satisfaction.

title: Engineering Manager
description_html: We are seeking a strategically-minded, technology-focused, and customer-centric software development leader to lead one of our digital engineering teams. This team powers CLEAR’s digital experience, enabling seamless, intuitive support for members and travelers in the moments that matter most. As an Engineering Leader, you will lead a team responsible for building the tools, systems, and platforms that support real-time, in-person experiences across airports and beyond. Your work will directly impact how Ambassadors assist members from identity verification to personalized service ensuring every interaction is fast, intuitive, and exceptional.
location: New York, New York, United States

title: Engineering Manager, CLEAR1 (B2B)
description_html: The Engineering Manager, CLEAR1 Strategic Partnerships Platform (StratP) is responsible for leading the engineering team that builds partner integrations, healthcare-related workflows, identity and authentication capabilities, and reusable platform improvements that strengthen CLEAR1’s customer offerings. In this role, you’ll drive execution, technical direction, and team development across a high-leverage platform area, turning strategic partner and market needs into scalable, reliable capabilities that improve delivery quality and create long-term business value.
location: New York, New York, United States

title: Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
description_html: We are seeking a strategically-minded, technology-focused, and customer-centric Engineering Manager to lead one of our Infrastructure teams here. You will lead a team responsible for building, operating, and scaling the cloud infrastructure and platform systems that underpin CLEAR’s services, ensuring reliability, performance, and security across our environments. A successful candidate brings strong experience in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and operational excellence, along with a solid foundation in software engineering. You are an effective communicator who can lead complex infrastructure initiatives from inception through delivery, and thrive in fast-paced environments.

title: Lead Product Manager, MarTech
description_html: We are seeking a technical, data-driven Product Management leader to own CLEAR's Marketing Technology platform. This role is responsible for the systems, data, and measurement capabilities that power member acquisition from first touch through enrollment. You will own CLEAR's MarTech ecosystem, including attribution and tracking, audience data infrastructure, CRM and lifecycle marketing platforms, and the integrations that connect marketing signals to actionable insights. Partnering closely with Marketing, Engineering, and Data teams, you'll ensure CLEAR has the tools and intelligence needed to scale growth across paid, organic, and partner channels.
location: New York, New York, United States

title: Machine Learning Engineer II
description_html: We’re looking for an experienced Machine Learning Engineer to help us build the next generation of products which will go beyond just ID and enable our members to leverage the power of a networked digital identity. As a Machine Learning Engineer at CLEAR, you will participate in the design, implementation, testing, and deployment of applications to build and enhance our platform - one that interconnects dozens of attributes and qualifications while keeping member privacy and security at the core. A brief highlight of our tech stack: Python / Postgres / Snowflake / dbt AWS SageMaker and MLflow What you'll do: Own and drive the foundational work of a ML system at CLEAR Design, build and deploy ML models for various applications, such as document and image processing, fraud detection.

title: Manager, Member Care - Premium Experience & CLEAR1
description_html: The Manager, Member Care - Premium Experience & CLEAR1 is responsible for leading the end-to-end digital member experience across CLEAR’s highest-touch support channels. This role oversees Team Leads and Specialists supporting Concierge, VIP, and CLEAR1 members while driving operational excellence, service quality, and continuous improvement across digital support experiences, member journeys, and service operations. What you'll do: Own the digital member support strategy and day-to-day operations for Premium Experience and CLEAR1 channels, ensuring exceptional service delivery and accountability for member and business outcomes Lead, coach, and develop Team Leads and Specialists through clear performance expectations, ongoing feedback, and career development planning Define, monitor, and…
location: New York, New York, United States

title: Director of Mechanical Engineering
description_html: About Mainspring Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

title: Director, Electrical Strategic Sourcing
description_html: Job Overview We are seeking a Director, Electrical Strategic Design Sourcing to build and lead the electrical commodity supply chain function. Reporting to the VP of Supply Chain, this role directs a team of commodity managers and program resources, owns the departmental budget, and participates with senior management to develop organizational sourcing policies and strategic plans. The Director is accountable for decisions with long-term, multi-department impact across three pillars: enabling Mainspring’s next-generation product architecture through engineering-embedded sourcing; building a best-total-cost supply chain for power conversion and electrical assemblies; and developing a fully FEOC-compliant, multi-source battery and BMS supply base.

title: Product Data Analyst
description_html: We're hiring a Product Data Analyst to help us figure out where the product goes next. Zello is push-to-talk for frontline workers - millions of people use it to do their jobs every day - and we want someone who can turn what we see in the data into clear calls about what to build. You'd join the Data & AI team here in Austin. This one's hands-on and heavily AI-leveraged. You'll dig into the data, form hypotheses, spec the telemetry for our web and mobile apps, run the experiments, and call what ships and what doesn't. You'll lean on AI agents to handle the routine work so your time goes to the thinking that actually moves things.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description_html: At Zello we’re looking for a dynamic Enterprise Account Executive with experience engaging, qualifying, and closing enterprise deals across a variety of industries. Joining now means you’ll spearhead an external-facing sales function in a largely untapped market that urgently needs modern, real-time voice communication—exactly what Zello delivers. You’ll enjoy first-mover advantage, shaping the playbook, influencing pricing, and owning relationships. The role offers uncapped earnings tied to clear, fast-ROI outcomes for customers and direct visibility with leadership. What You'll Do You’ll drive new business through targeting enterprise accounts. You’ll own the strategy around negotiating and closing prospects in complex sales cycles.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description_html: Zello is the push-to-talk platform that connects millions of frontline workers, and the AI & Data team builds the agent systems that run the business behind it. We have more high-value AI work than we have capacity to build, and we need someone who can both ship it and hold a real engineering standard around it. You would be the person who makes our agent work genuinely engineered - tested, reviewed, monitored - and who raises how everyone here builds. After a successful first year, you will Shipped and operated production agent systems that people across Zello use every day Made evals-driven development the team's default, so every agent ships with an eval suite and monitoring Owned the code review bar for agent work and raised the standard it is held to Measurably levelled up teammates'…

title: Escalation Engineer
description_html: As that base grows and the platform deepens, we need an Escalation Engineer who can own the hardest technical problems our customers hit, drive them to root cause with minimal Engineering involvement, and build the tooling and runbooks that make the whole support organization faster. You will report to the Product Advocate Manager and work shoulder to shoulder with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success. After a successful first year, you will have Owned every Tier-1 enterprise escalation that reached you, each closed with a reproducible, engineering-ready root-cause analysis. Read into code and mobile SDK internals to isolate defects yourself, and drafted the fix where scope allowed, instead of routing every code-level question to Engineering.

title: Analytics Intern
description_html: Our go-to-market team should be able to answer their own data questions without waiting on us, and right now they can't: dashboards are slow, definitions don't line up, and most numbers still need someone from the data team to explain them. You'd join the Data & AI team in Austin, reporting to our Head of Analytics, and spend the fall fixing that for the reports and topics people use most. This is real ownership, not shadowing. You'll take named surfaces that other people depend on and make them work, with review and support from the team.

title: Software Engineer, C++
description_html: The job You will be part of our core engineering team of world-class software engineers, building a product with no equivalent. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and advance professionally by working with various technologies, spanning from low-level system programming for all major platforms, through distributed and cloud computing, to web development. You must have a solid fundamental knowledge of software development. You must also have experience in software engineering best practices like agile development, automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration/continuous delivery, and test-driven development. You are fluent in C++ but are not religious about it and would have no trouble delving into TypeScript and other technologies as well.

title: Senior Motion Designer with AI
description_html: About the Role Hi, I'm Gabriela, Creative Design Lead at LucidLink. We're looking for a Senior Motion Designer with strong creative thinking, a research-informed approach and a clear focus on work that leads to better outcomes. This is a chance to help shape storytelling for a category-defining product. In our team, honesty, craft and real customer impact matter a lot. We’re looking for someone who’s comfortable working from brief to delivery, creating video content that impacts different audiences/personas across a variety of channels, aligned with the marketing goals. This work sits in a complex product space, with connected workflows, integrations and technical depth that make the design challenges especially interesting.

title: Technical Support Engineer, L2
description_html: Job description Joining LucidLink as a Technical Support Engineer (Level 2) you will be responsible for ensuring that all inbound support requests are promptly answered, triaged and internally escalated as required. You will be the primary point of contact for our customers through various channels - email, chat and phone. You will be troubleshooting customer issues related to our cloud networking product and answer technical enquiries about the product. Being part of a newly formed technical support team you’ll have the opportunity to grow within the team and take an active part in all decision-making and processes related to customer support. Working hours This position works during core US daytime hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM local time, with a 1-hour break).

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
description_html: The job You will be part of our core engineering team of world-class software engineers, building a product with no equivalent. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and advance professionally by working with various technologies, spanning from low-level system programming for all major platforms, through distributed and cloud computing, to web development. You must have a solid fundamental knowledge of software development. You must also have experience in software engineering best practices like agile development, automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration/continuous delivery, and test-driven development. You’ll thrive here if you’re someone who loves efficient code, values collaboration, and enjoys bringing complex ideas to life through great software design.

title: Senior Technical Product Marketing Manager
description_html: Role overview At LucidLink, we build a cloud-native file streaming platform that enables distributed teams to work with massive files in real time. Our technology sits close to the infrastructure layer and is used in performance-critical, workflow-heavy environments. As our Senior Product Marketing Manager you’ll be a technically fluent, hands-on product marketer responsible for translating LucidLink’s APIs, integrations, and platform capabilities into clear positioning, use cases, and go-to-market strategies that drive adoption and commercial impact. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Marketing , helping shape how LucidLink’s platform story is understood by developers, IT and platform teams, partners, and enterprise buyers.

description_html: What you’ll do We are looking for an AI Deployment Strategist to join our growing team. In this role, you will work directly with customers to design, build, and deploy AI-powered planning solutions using Pigment. This is a highly cross-functional role at the intersection of engineering, data, and business problem-solving. You will own the end-to-end implementation of Pigment’s AI capabilities for strategic customers — from translating business problems into models, to deploying agentic AI solutions in production. You will play a key role in shaping how organizations leverage Pigment to transform their planning processes, while acting as a critical feedback loop between customers and our Product and Engineering teams.

Driving Solution Design: Analyze, design, and implement planning and analytics solutions for financial, operational, or sales planning use cases. Optimizing Processes: Identify opportunities to improve planning workflows and deliver efficient, actionable solutions. Collaborating Across Teams: Work closely with project teams, including solution architects and business stakeholders, to ensure successful delivery of planning scenarios.

title: Business Development Manager DACH
description_html: What you'll do As Pigment continues its rapid global expansion, establishing a dedicated presence in the DACH region is one of our highest strategic priorities. In this context of hyper-growth, you will take over the management of an existing team of 5 reps (4 BDRs and 1 SDR) currently based between London and Paris, while building and scaling our local BDR footprint on the ground in Frankfurt. Working hand-in-hand with our DACH Sales Managers, you will play a pivotal role in driving our go-to-market execution and generating qualified pipeline across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. Lead and scale the team: Manage the existing BDRs across London and Paris while leading the recruitment, onboarding, and training of new hires in Frankfurt.

title: Business Transformation Advisory
description_html: What You'll Do: Strategic Deal Advisory : Support Sales Leaders and Account Executives on strategic deals as a Subject Matter Expert and trusted advisor. Provide perspectives on market / industry / functional trends, partner on deal strategy development and value-based discovery, and lead value analysis to create a compelling case for change. Business Transformation Advisory : Engage with senior business leaders to understand their challenges, goals, and requirements. Leverage your deep industry knowledge and expertise to provide strategic advice and consultative support, demonstrating how Pigment's solutions can address their specific needs and drive business outcomes.

description_html: As a Corporate Account Executive at Pigment, you'll drive business growth by managing the full sales cycle, from initial interest to closing deals while coordinating closely with customer success and technical teams. The position also requires building and maintaining strong relationships with C-suite and executive-level clients across various industries. description_html: What You'll Do: As a Corporate Account Executive, you’ll be on the front lines of how Pigment grows our business by leading the full sales cycle from initial interest to deal close and coordinate collaboration with customer success, technical teams, etc. You’ll also be responsible for building c-suite & executive level relationships with our clients across an array of industries. Consult with prospective and existing customers regarding business objectives & requirements.

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description_html: In the Engineering group, we are accelerating the product vision by building solutions in a fun, collaborative, efficient, and adaptive team. As an AI Evaluation Engineer, you will own the quality bar for Yes AI — defining what "correct" looks like when an AI answers a complex power market question, and building the frameworks to measure it at scale. This is a foundational role at the intersection of LLM engineering, domain expertise, and rigorous testing. You will also work directly on projects to integrate systems and serve energy data to customers. We are curious people who take pride in our work, value high-quality communication, and strive to improve continuously.

title: Business Development Representative
description_html: The Business Development Representative (BDR) is responsible for conducting market research, identifying and contacting prospects, qualifying opportunities, and connecting the Sales team with prospects at Senior levels. You will be responsible for driving top-funnel new business for the sales team in the Electric Power industry. Our sales and marketing teams are growing fast to meet our clients' demands. You will be the first person our prospects and customers interact with, meaning you can leave a lasting impression of the Yes Energy brand on our target accounts. You will follow up on and create qualified leads and learn to use account-based marketing techniques that help build rapport and nurture relationships.

title: Data Engineer II
description_html: : As a Data Engineer on the Bid-to-Bill Operations Engineers team, you will sit at the intersection of software engineering, customer operations, and market execution. You'll work directly with customers and internal teams to solve complex production challenges, investigate issues, improve system reliability, and build automation that eliminates repetitive work. Our customers depend on Yes Energy to run critical market operations involving settlements, billing, scheduling, and energy transactions worth millions of dollars each day. Success in this role is not measured by lines of code written. It is measured by making systems more reliable, reducing operational friction, improving customer outcomes, and creating leverage for the broader organization.

title: Data Scientist II
description_html: This role is on the Forecasting Data Science team and combines research with productized model delivery in a forecasting SaaS environment. Based in our Bucharest office, you will partner closely with Forecast Analysts in an operational capacity—managing daily model configurations, runtime monitoring, and exception handling—alongside Product and Engineering teams. You will ensure models are accurate, reliable, and usable in production-grade services, bridging the gap between data exploration and robust operational systems.

title: Engineering Manager
description_html: In the Engineering group, we are accelerating the product vision by building solutions in a fun, collaborative, efficient, and adaptive team. As an Engineering Manager on the Yes AI initiative, you will build and lead the Bucharest engineering team responsible for bringing this product to life. You will collaborate with leaders in technology, data, and energy to build and deliver solutions and tools for handling the highly complex problems posed by the evolving power grid. You will also work directly on projects to integrate systems and serve energy data to customers. We are curious people who take pride in our work, value high-quality communication, and strive to improve continuously.

title: Fullstack Engineer
description_html: We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer with a strong back-end focus to help build and scale our energy market platform. You'll develop services that power settlement processing, bid submission, market workflows, and platform APIs supporting customers participating in wholesale electricity markets. While this is a full-stack role, most work is on the back end. Front-end work is expected but is generally limited in scope. Modern AI-assisted development tools are part of our engineering workflow and are expected to improve productivity across both front-end and back-end development.

title: Implementation Specialist
description_html: The Implementation Specialist plays a key role in delivering successful customer implementations of Yes Energy's PowerCore platform. Working directly with customers, this role is responsible for gathering business requirements, configuring solutions, validating data, supporting testing, and guiding customers through implementation and adoption. You will collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales to ensure projects are delivered successfully while providing an exceptional customer experience.

title: Principal Analyst, Power Markets Modeler
description_html: As a Principal Analyst, Power Markets Modeler, you will serve as a high-level subject matter expert and strategic lead in the development of our asset-level forecasts. You will dive deep into North American power market fundamentals and regulatory trends to deliver sophisticated insights into renewable, thermal, and transmission assets. In this role, you will not only lead complex modeling projects but also shape the methodology and technical standards that drive our data platform forward.

title: Product Owner
description_html: : Yes Energy’s products help power market analysts, traders, and asset managers understand the North American electric grid in real time — pricing, congestion, transmission, generation, and the complex data flows that drive decisions worth billions of dollars. The Product Owner sits at the center of how we turn that data and customer insight into software that works. This role exists to ensure our engineering teams are always building the right things, in the right order, with enough clarity to execute. You will own the product backlog for one or more of Yes Energy’s product teams — managing a prioritized queue of work that reflects real customer needs, business strategy, and technical reality.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description_html: In the Engineering group, we are accelerating the product vision by building solutions in a fun, collaborative, efficient, and adaptive team. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will collaborate with leaders in technology, data, and energy to build solutions and tools for handling the highly complex problems posed by the evolving power grid. You will also work directly on projects to integrate systems and serve energy data to customers. We are curious people who take pride in our work, value high-quality communication, and strive to improve continuously.

title: Senior Product Manager
description_html: You will own the product strategy, roadmap, and commercial outcomes for Market Data — the ISO and public data (EIA, NWS, and others) Yes Energy collects, and the value we build on top of it across our UI, API, Snowflake, and data lake products. This role requires deep nodal power market fluency and genuine data fluency, because the value of this data is entirely contextual to how customers use it to make trading and investment decisions. The hard part of this job isn't collecting the data. It's deciding which derivative products are worth building, what customers will value, and how to define a roadmap that advances how energy market participants work, and helps move the industry forward.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description_html: We are hiring a Site Reliability Engineer to serve as a senior, hands-on reliability leader across all product lines. This role sits within the Systems Administration team, part of the Product Technology Services (PTS) group, and is focused squarely on operational excellence: incident response, systems availability, monitoring and alerting, release support, and reliability improvements across our production services. During your working hours, you will be expected to take ownership of active incidents: respond to pages, coordinate response across engineering teams, diagnose production issues, restore service quickly, and drive clear communication through resolution. Incident response and operational readiness are central to the role, not occasional side responsibilities.

title: Sr. Staff AI Engineer - Applied AI (Remote)
description_html: At Rula, this role owns the AI foundation that determines how, and how well, AI shows up across mental healthcare. The focus isn’t on prototypes or isolated features, but on building durable, production-grade generative AI systems that directly power patient engagement, provider workflows, and clinical operations at scale. You’ll operate where architecture, applied research, and real-world constraints meet. The work includes designing core AI platforms, setting technical standards for safety, reliability, and performance, and making principald decisions about how advanced AI is introduced into a regulated, high-stakes care environment. The goal is simple but hard: make AI genuinely useful in clinical contexts, without compromising trust or outcomes.

Our goal is to ensure that Rula has the right providers to meet patient demand. Access to care is fundamentally a supply problem, and our team is here to solve that by driving meaningful impact on how providers find Rula, onboard, and build sustainable and flexible practices on our platform. Our work sits at the intersection of provider experience and marketplace dynamics, increasing supply where it matters and reducing friction in how providers deliver care – so patients can find help quickly.

title: Staff AI Engineer - Foundation (Remote)
description_html: We’re hiring a Staff AI Engineer to lead some of Rula’s most important applied AI investments as we scale. You’ll own technical direction for high-impact AI products, work across teams to turn big ideas into shipped systems, and help raise the bar for how we build, evaluate, and operate AI in production. This role sits at the center of product innovation and engineering execution, with the chance to influence both what we build and how we build it. It’s a strong fit for someone who loves operating in fast-moving environments, wants to drive outsized impact, and is excited to help define the future of AI at Rula.

title: Sr. Product Manager - Core Experience (Remote)
description_html: We’re hiring a Senior/Staff Product Manager to lead the core experience at Rula; focused on making it easier for people to find, start, and stay engaged with high-quality mental health care. Day-to-day, you’ll dig into data to understand consumer pain points, and collaborate with user researchers, analysts, and data scientists to uncover what drives stronger engagement and better outcomes. You’ll lead a dedicated engineering team to design, launch, and measure improvements that make a real difference in patients’ lives. This role sits at the heart of our mission; your work will directly impact thousands of people by helping them access the care they need and stay with it long enough to truly get better.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer (Remote)

This role requires a unique combination of deep technical expertise, architectural foresight, and cross-functional leadership. Operating as a strategic partner to the Senior Director, the incumbent will be responsible for setting the technical roadmap, establishing engineering standards, and driving high-impact initiatives that span all teams within the Provider domain. Required Qualifications 10+ years of related professional experience.

You will apply advanced data-driven strategies and deploy MarTech architecture to ensure the team is tracking towards every marketing event being tagged, measured, and automated for scale.

title: Sr. Financial Operations Insights Associate (Remote)
description_html: At Rula, our Financial Operations team plays a key role in making sure providers can focus on care while we keep the business running smoothly. As a Sr. Financial Operations Insights Associate, you’ll focus on building the automated workflows and reporting that keep our day-to-day operations running efficiently. You’ll collaborate directly with team experts to spot bottlenecks, untangle manual processes, and design smarter, more reliable ways of working. If you love making complex workflows run smoothly and want your efforts to directly support our mission of expanding access to mental healthcare, this role will be especially rewarding. Scope of the Role You will develop deep foundational knowledge of our financial operations and apply it independently to assigned projects.

description_html: We are hiring a Sr. Revenue Strategy & Planning Manager to help bring clarity, structure, and insight to Rula’s B2B growth motions. In this role, you’ll work closely with Sales leaders and Revenue Operations to identify areas for improvement, build dashboards, analyze funnel performance, forecast revenue growth, and support planning cadences. You’ll spend your time in spreadsheets, CRM data, and business reviews.

description_html: London (hybrid, 3 days in office) CRM at Marshmallow CRM sits within the User Experience team, helping Marshmallow build more effective, joined-up communication with our customers across the business. CRM is a meaningful driver of impact for the organisation, with clear opportunities to improve how we engage customers and measure the value of that work. This role will help shape how CRM is used at Marshmallow by building strong foundations, enabling others to use the platform effectively, and creating the governance needed to make customer communications work better across multiple teams. We’re looking for someone who is excited by ownership, enjoys working cross-functionally, and wants to help scale CRM in a thoughtful, high-impact way.

title: Claims Fraud Team Lead
description_html: About the team We defend Marshmallow against fraudulent activity and help protect the company! Fraudulent claims can result in us losing money, which can drive up the premium prices for all of the other customers. We’re here to stop that, making sure Marshmallow remains affordable and accessible for everyone. What you'll be doing Leading, coaching and managing the performance of a team of Claims Fraud Investigators and Intel Analysts, supporting their progression. Acting as the final escalation point for the most complex, high-value and organised fraud investigations. Owning the Claims Fraud KPIs, setting and evolving the team’s investigation strategy. Running quality assurance across the team, using outcomes to drive consistency and improve decision-making.

title: Technical Accountant
description_html: About the role This is a senior individual contributor role and the Controllership team's primary technical accounting expert. You will own the most complex and judgement-intensive accounting areas across the Group — spanning the UK insurance broker, claims handling, car finance and its associated SPV structure, and the Group holding company — and act as the go-to resource for the team, business stakeholders, and external auditors on technical accounting matters. You will work with a high degree of autonomy, reporting directly to the Group Financial Controller.

title: Data Science Manager, Pricing
description_html: London (hybrid, 3 days in office) Pricing at Marshmallow The Pricing team shapes how we understand risk and make pricing decisions that support sustainable growth. It plays a critical role in Marshmallow’s ambition by protecting loss ratio performance and turning complex data into clear commercial action. We work closely with claims, finance, product and other teams, to build a holistic view of risk and keep our pricing approach effective as we scale. The team acts as a key bridge between technical analytics and business strategy, helping Marshmallow stay ahead of market conditions and make confident decisions, even where data is sparse or uncertain. The team works across modelling, business strategy and stakeholder communication.

description_html: 12m FTC - (London, hybrid 3 days a week) Data Science at Marshmallow Our data science team supports various business functions across our Product teams and within Pricing and Claims. Working across the full spectrum of data science problems, from traditional machine learning for risk-based decisioning through to generative AI and the automation of complex operational journeys, all within a regulated insurtech/fintech domain. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can bring a team together and ensure it delivers at pace while its foundations strengthen: leading and developing the people, personally holding the bar on technical quality, and partnering closely with engineering and product.

title: Large Loss Handler
description_html: About the team Our Large Loss Specialists handle Marshmallow’s most complex and high-value motor claims, often involving catastrophic injuries such as brain and spinal trauma, psychiatric injury, complex fractures and nerve damage. Beyond handling claims, the team acts as a centre of technical expertise, sharing insights and driving consistency across Claims. We work closely with Complex Personal Injury colleagues, reinsurers, panel solicitors and teams across Claims, Underwriting and Pricing to deliver fair, commercially sound outcomes. As a small, highly technical team, we offer broad exposure and the opportunity to grow your authority quickly. What you'll be doing Managing a portfolio of high-value motor claims, typically valued above £250,000, through pre- and post-litigation.

title: Software Engineer - Dedicated Inference
description_html: As an Engineer on the Dedicated Inference team, you'll shape the state-of-the-art developer experience for deploying and operating AI workloads in production. From the CLI and SDKs to APIs, observability, and debugging workflows, you'll build the tools customers rely on every day to manage mission-critical inference deployments. Few teams at Baseten have as much breadth and visibility as Dedicated Inference. The team is often at the forefront of new product development, giving engineers the opportunity to shape the experience of some of our most important customers.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and is eager to make significant contributions to the exciting field of LLM Inference. If you are a backend engineer who thrives on making things faster and is excited about open-source ML models, we look forward to your application.

description_html: As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Baseten, you will partner directly with customers to architect, build, and deploy high-scale production AI applications on Baseten’s platform. You’ll own the journey with customers from initial exploration to production deployment, translating ambiguous business goals into reliable, observable services with clear quality, latency, and cost outcomes. This role is a great fit for entrepreneurial engineers who want a front-row view into how modern companies adopt AI at scale and who enjoy working across product, software development, performance engineering, and customer-facing implementations.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description_html: As a Site Reliability Engineer at Baseten, you'll define and codify the gold standards of day 2 operations for our ML infrastructure platform. You'll envision and build robust systems, processes, automations, and observability tooling that keep our platform reliable at scale — and that empower the broader organization to operate confidently. You'll work closely with engineering, forward-deployed and product teams: learning from recurring failure patterns, turning tribal knowledge into automated mitigations, and raising the operational floor for the entire company. EXAMPLE INITIATIVES You'll work on projects like these as part of the SRE team: Improve Baseten SRE Practices, by instrumenting SLOs and SLIs, improving alerting and observability for all services.
