description_html: The Powder Bed Fusion Additive Manufacturing team is pushing the boundaries of what's possible in rocket propulsion hardware. Responsible for development, process, and production, the team oversees initial concept to final hardware with rigorous quality and precision. From developing print parameters on state-of-the-art 3D printers to enabling fast iteration for partner departments, the team plays a critical role in taking engine designs from concept to hot fire. The team was instrumental in producing Aeon 1 engines for Terran 1 launch and is now pioneering next-generation processes and designs for our Aeon R engines that will power Terran R. With flight hardware production scaling up rapidly, now is the time to join and make a direct impact.

title: Aerothermal Engineer II
description_html: Relativity’s Integrated Performance teams ensure that our products work across all systems and disciplines, from trajectory design to aerodynamics to reliability analysis and beyond. Our groups size the Terran R rocket, design its missions for customer success, reliability, and reusability, and ensure that every system on the rocket and ground is engineered correctly for the demanding environments of launch and entry. Recently, we completed the preliminary design and analysis of Terran R including Relativity’s first-ever work on launch vehicle reusability, spanning advanced trajectory simulations, wind tunnel testing, and structures analysis, among many other projects.

title: AI/ML Scientist, Planetary Science
description_html: The Interplanetary Sciences Program was established to expand access to scientific exploration across our Solar System, with the mission to push the boundaries of how planetary science is done, and make planetary research faster, more affordable, and more capable than ever before. We are rethinking how science missions are designed, built, and operated, and how the collected data is analyzed and used. We are transforming space science from an occasional event into a continuous process of discovery that accelerates knowledge, broadens participation, and inspires the next generation of explorers. About the Role: We are seeking an AI/ML Scientist to develop and deploy machine learning systems that unlock new science from our interplanetary mission.

title: Avionics Test Engineer II
description_html: The Avionics Test & Operations team is responsible for testing avionics hardware and systems across the entire product lifecycle of Terran R: component-, subsystem-, and vehicle-level. As an Avionics Test Engineer at Relativity Space, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing avionics testing strategies for our rocket systems. This includes working closely with the avionics design team to identify and troubleshoot any issues and developing automation and testing infrastructure to improve efficiency and effectiveness.

title: Benchwork Technician II, Second Shift
description_html: The engine manufacturing department's mission is to product high performing products & manufacturing systems by continuously innovating on cost, quality, and lead time. Through cross-functional collaboration, high levels of accountability, and a focus on safety we support the Terran R program. We are responsible for providing design feedback on new hardware iterations, developing new manufacturing methods and systems, and ultimately building engine and vehicle hardware for testing prior to our first launch. Our team's highlights from the last 6 months include the MDC of the first Aeon-R engine, completing thousands of hours of PBF printing, building and testing over 50 valves of 26 different iterations, and implementing large scale process improvements along the way.

title: Senior Autonomy Engineer, Data Curation
description_html: Role: As a Senior Engineer on the Autonomy Data Curation team, you’ll help build a data flywheel. You’ll collect the data that matters most from internal and external fleets of drones and turn it into high-quality, model-ready datasets that Autonomy teams can consume quickly and confidently for training and model development. Close peers will include the Deep Learning and Computer Vision teams. This role is an individual contributor who will report to the Director of Autonomy Data Curation. How you'll make an impact: Build and operate pipelines that transform raw autonomy logs & media into curated datasets with strong observability and clear ownership to make curated data more broadly reusable. Build tooling that makes data discovery and slicing fast and self-serve for Autonomy teams.

description_html: role: Skydio is built around deep technological investments in autonomy that lead to breakthrough products. We are looking for world-class engineering leaders to scale up the autonomy team to deliver Skydio’s vision. Our small team has incredible technical strength in solving complex algorithmic challenges, and needs help growing to meet the product opportunities ahead. You will be responsible for one or more areas of ownership across core drone platforms, SW architecture, simulation, SDK, object detection, map infrastructure, situational awareness, computational photography, and state estimation. You will manage the execution of the product + technology roadmap and be responsible for hiring, mentoring, and driving infrastructure investments that make us successful.

description_html: role: As a Skydio Technical Support team member, you will work in a small group of high-performing subject matter experts who provide UAS system and Cloud operational best practices advice and deep feature diagnostics to Skydio commercial, national security, state & local government and educational customers. You’ll combine your relevant enterprise application integration and infrastructure/WiFi/Cellular network operations experience to optimize system performance and keep Skydio engineering and marketing teams plugged into the customer experience.

description_html: role: We are seeking an experienced, up-and-coming Technical Recruiter to help propel Skydio’s growth via the relentless, hands-on recruitment of elite engineering and operations talent. You’ll own end-to-end hiring for one or more of our core engineering functions: Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Hardware Operations. While you’ll primarily own hiring within one of these areas, we’re looking for someone with the ability to flex across functions as hiring needs evolve. If you thrive on scaling industry-defining startup teams and are excited to help build the world’s first great flying robot company, we would love to hear from you. PLEASE NOTE: Skydio operates on a hybrid schedule, with employees working from the office three days per week.

Be the liaison between supply chain and engineering for supplier and component selection during NPI and sustaining projects. Identify new high potential suppliers on a global basis.

title: Autonomy System Test Engineer
description_html: Autonomous vehicles have some of the largest, most complex software ever shipped in a safety-critical environment. Solving that problem is one of the most exciting technical challenges of our lifetime. As an Autonomy Systems Test Engineer at Zoox, you will help accelerate our product development by helping our developers build the safest and most reliable autonomous driving software possible. As developers build new features, you will oversee the development of extensive test plans, develop standardized simulated test design tooling processes to execute many different scenarios and put together triage pipelines for analyzing issues seen during offline and on-vehicle testing.

title: AV Safety Data Reporting Engineer
description_html: The AV Safety Software Data Engineer will play a critical role in supporting Zoox’s safety data reporting and compliance efforts. In this position, you will work with large-scale fleet data to gather, analyze, and triage events for internal safety learnings and external compliance requirements. As an AV Safety Software Data Reporting Engineer, you will operationalize defined requirements through data-driven analyses, dashboards, and workflow automations. You will implement innovative processes that are rigorous, diligent, and systematic, as well as applicable and repeatable, as Zoox continues to scale, to ensure reliable and safe operations.

title: Contract Student Worker - Machine Learning Engineer - Data Mining & VLM (Full-time)
description_html: About Zoox Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets. About Our Part-Time Student Worker Program Zoox's part-time student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation.

title: Contract Student Worker Automation & Behavioral Science Engineer
description_html: About Zoox Zoox is transforming mobility with fully autonomous, electric vehicles designed from the ground up for a driverless future. Our mission is to make transportation safer, more sustainable, and accessible to everyone. At Zoox, innovation, collaboration, and a bold vision for the future drive everything we do. About Our Part Time Student Worker Program Zoox’s program offers hands-on experience with cutting-edge technology, mentorship from some of the industry’s brightest minds, and the opportunity to make meaningful contributions to real projects. We seek part time student workers who demonstrate strong academic performance, engagement beyond the classroom, intellectual curiosity, and a genuine interest in Zoox’s mission.

title: CRM Lead – Service Cloud, AI & Omnichannel

This role will serve as the CRM leader with strong depth in Service Cloud and ownership of AI/chatbot initiatives, while providing cross-functional leadership across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Data teams. You will shape CRM strategy, build scalable systems in a fast-evolving environment, and lead complex initiatives that transform customer support through automation and intelligence.

title: Director, Corporate Security
description_html: The Director, Corporate Security is a leadership role responsible for the development and implementation of physical security programs to help the company keep all Zoox personnel and property safe and secure. This leader will serve as the primary point of contact for all physical security programs for the company, including physical security operations, risk management, incident response, insider threat coordination, investigations, workplace violence prevention, event security, executive protection, and fleet security. In this role, you will: Lead the physical security team across all Zoox locations Oversee 24/7 security operations, including access control, GSOC, incident response, and emergency management across all sites.

title: Director, Perception
description_html: We’re reinventing personal transportation—making the future safer, cleaner, and more enjoyable. We’ve created our vehicle specifically for dense, complicated urban environments. Zoox is the only driving vehicle on the market with bidirectional driving capabilities and four-wheel steering, allowing us to maneuver through compact spaces and change directions without the need to reverse. The future is for riders! Our growing software engineering leadership team is searching for a Director of Perception. Our perception stack is responsible for building Zoox’s world-class 3D environment model from multi-modal sensor data. We create novel AI architectures that combine the latest academic results with many in-house innovations in creative ways.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description_html: Zoox is looking for an embedded software engineer to join our Firmware Platforms team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, extending, and maintaining support for multiple embedded platforms for the Zoox vehicle. You will work closely with electrical engineers, embedded software engineers, and validation engineers to enable support for new advanced platforms and accelerate application development across multiple projects. We are looking for people who are passionate about diving deep into the hardware and creating robust and reusable software.

title: Embedded Software Engineer - Battery Management Systems
description_html: Zoox is looking for an embedded software engineer to join our Firmware Power Systems team. Responsibilities include designing, building, and testing real-time embedded code in C/C++ for BMS (Battery Management Systems). Key responsibilities include implementing safety algorithms, managing board bring-up, and ensuring seamless hardware-software integration. The work includes Power management and efficiency, Charging control, a variety of operator controls, integration of supplier systems, coordination and control of all Power sub-systems, and low-level vehicle controls. This work requires collaboration with vehicle engineers, systems engineers, controls engineers, and suppliers to ensure the Zoox vehicle can drive safely and reliably.

title: Hardware Test Engineer
description_html: the Role: We're looking for a Hardware Test Engineer to join our Compute Hardware team. You’ll help validate our automotive-grade PCB designs by performing board-level testing, automating lab workflows, and supporting early prototype hardware characterization. This role is ideal for someone with a passion for hands-on validation, strong lab skills, and experience with OEM testing protocols. Motivation : a lot of learning opportunities since we design and test next generation boards/hardware solutions for customers in all verticals/industries.

This is a temporary role with flexibility for remote applicants that meet our role requirements.

This role emphasizes classical motion planning, predictable behavior, and large-scale evaluation, rather than deep learning–driven planning. In addition to your engineering contributions, by working in our dynamic and customer-focused team culture, you will contribute to and learn from best practices in the nascent autonomy industry. We move fast and we focus on excellence, for our products and for our business. If you are hands-on and looking for a place to have a multiplying effect on making autonomous systems a reality, Applied is the place for you!

title: Associate or Senior Associate
description_html: About Bessemer Venture Partners Bessemer Venture Partners helps entrepreneurs lay strong foundations to build and forge long-standing companies. With more than 145 IPOs and 300 portfolio companies in the enterprise, infrastructure, consumer, and healthcare spaces, Bessemer supports founders and CEOs from their early days through every stage of growth. Bessemer's global portfolio has included Anthropic, Pinterest, Shopify, Twilio, LinkedIn, PagerDuty, DocuSign, Fiverr, and Toast, and has more than $20 billion of assets under management. Bessemer has teams of investors and partners located in Tel Aviv, Silicon Valley, San Francisco, New York, London, Hong Kong, Boston, and Bangalore.

title: Associate or Senior Associate - AI
description_html: The Role: We are hiring an investment associate to focus on the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem. As a “full stack” investor, you will be responsible for engaging across the investment lifecycle. Responsibilities include: Thesis development - create and refine investment roadmaps to guide firm strategy, stay updated on industry developments. Sourcing - identify and build relationships with promising founders, teams, and startups. Embed yourself in the ecosystem. Due diligence - lead financial analysis and diligence on customers, products, technology, teams, and markets. Investment recommendations - form judgements and present analyses and opinions to help drive investment decisions. Portfolio Support - assist portfolio companies with introductions, strategy, hiring, resources, and more.

title: Senior Associate, Growth Investing
description_html: About Bessemer Venture Partners Bessemer Venture Partners is a global venture firm that partners with audacious founders from their earliest days through every stage of growth. The firm manages $20 billion in assets, with more than 145 IPOs and 300 portfolio companies across AI, enterprise, consumer, health, and frontier tech including Anthropic, Perplexity, Canva, Shopify, Twilio, LinkedIn, ClickHouse, Saronic, Legora, Abridge, and Toast. The Role We're hiring a Senior Associate to join Bessemer's growth investing team based in San Francisco. You will be focused on AI apps, infrastructure, defense, techbio, energy, and various other roadmaps.

title: DVM Student Externship/Preceptorship Program — Founders Green Animal Hospital
description_html: We're making an investment in the next generation of veterinary doctors! As part of the professional veterinary curriculum, colleges encourage off-campus educational experiences in practices outside of the teaching hospital. Practical experience in a well-run and contemporary practice can be a valuable component of your veterinary education, preparing you to deliver better care after graduation. Our program is dedicated to contributing to your practice-readiness and to help you hit the ground running after graduation. Our program structure: Our externships are flexible—they can range from two to eight weeks during the year, according to your college curriculum – but are typically two or three weeks in length. Your schedule will include days, evenings and weekends.

title: Senior Robotics Engineer
description_html: Position Overview As a Senior Robotics Engineer, you will design, develop, and deploy the core robotic control systems powering LightSpeed’s construction automation platforms. You will work hands-on with industrial robots, developing motion planning algorithms, real-time control software, and sensor integration systems that enable our BRUTE and DEX platforms to achieve sub-millimeter precision in demanding construction environments. This role demands deep robotics expertise, strong software skills, and the ability to bridge the gap between simulation and real-world deployment.

title: AI & Machine Learning Engineer
description_html: Position Overview As an AI & Machine Learning Engineer, you will design, build, and deploy the intelligent systems that make LightSpeed’s construction robots smarter, faster, and more autonomous. You will develop machine learning models for computer vision, predictive analytics, autonomous decision-making, and process optimization—all deployed in real-time production environments where precision and reliability are critical. This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and practical industrial application.

title: Robotics Integration/Controls Engineer (Full-Stack Capable)
description_html: We're an early-stage venture, building an automated physical system driven by robotic arms, live sensing, and a real-time software layer that ties the hardware to a customer- facing application and operator dashboard. We're past the idea stage and moving fast toward a working demo. We need an engineer who can own the seam between the hardware and the software bringing up robot arms and controls, wiring sensors, actuators, and telemetry into a real- time control plane, and writing the glue that lets the rest of the stack drive and observe the cell.

title: Director of Web and Digital Experience
description_html: This position is based in Mexico City, and only candidates within a commutable distance to our Mexico City office will be considered . We are seeking a leader to join our marketing team supporting all things Web and Digital Experience for across three distinct and dynamic brands: Sequoia, Transform and SemperVirens. In this role you will define and drive the strategy of compelling digital experiences that attract, inspire, engage, and convert prospective targets for each business. This role requires a high level of collaboration with teams across Marketing, Product, Web Engineering, and Creative to develop shared goals, translate business objectives into long-term roadmaps, and deliver cohesive customer experiences.

title: Platform Success Manager
description_html: HIRING IN NYC or TEMPE, AZ What You Get to Do: The Platform Success Manager will be responsible for guiding our clients on a day-to-day basis on all things Sequoia, including but not limited to: benefits, systems and HRIS. You will: Serve as the primary day-to-day guide for clients on all Sequoia-related topics, including benefits, systems, and HRIS. Educate clients on Sequoia’s programs and tools to help them maximize their offerings. Drive adoption of Sequoia’s Compensation Operating System (Comp OS) through seamless platform configuration and ongoing support. Provide consulting, training, and project management to ensure client success and engagement. Proactively identify and resolve issues to deliver an exceptional client experience.

title: Payroll Specialist
description_html: What You Get to Do: The Payroll Specialist is at the center of Sequoia One’s operations, and an ongoing point of contact for our clients. You will be working with multiple clients to process data and deliver accurate and timely payroll. Process accurate payrolls in accordance to specified deadlines Maintain payroll data (client and employee level) Interface with clients internally and externally to assist with inquires and resolve any issues Work with various vendors (time and attendance, payroll/HRIS) Maintain and create document process workflows Assist with quarter and year-end activities (returns and W-2 filing) Represent Sequoia’s client service commandments to come through for our clients at all times Report back to management team on program implementations, and status of defined…

title: Application Security Engineer
description_html: As an Application Security Engineer, you will be providing application security expertise throughout the Software Development LifeCycle (SDLC) as well as being responsible for managing and driving forward the Application Security Analytics practices. A key part of your role will also involve validating and testing web applications in order to ensure applications meet the requirements of the SDLC Policy and industry best practices. In addition, undertaking threat modelling and conducting periodic penetration testing using best of breed tools, a good understanding of the OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and maintaining documentation. You'll perform various day-to-day activities related to ensuring the security of Sequoias application environment.

title: 401k Compliance Client Service Manager
description_html: Client Service Manager (50%) · Own and nurture client relationships at both decision-maker and administrative levels across Sequoia’s key accounts. · Guide strategic analysis of retirement plans to support client goals and compliance. · Collaborate with MEP vendors and other third parties to ensure seamless service delivery. · Lead 401(k) participant education meetings to promote financial wellness and engagement. · Troubleshoot and resolve administrative issues, including payroll remittance challenges. · Provide timely, thoughtful support for participant questions and account concerns. Compliance Management (50%) · Assist in the execution and validation of annual compliance testing (e.g., ADP/ACP, top-heavy coverage) to maintain plan integrity.

title: IT Support Engineer

As an IT Support Engineer, you will help manage the ticket queue, perform IT operations, and systems administration for our growing company. You will have the opportunity to impact, learn, and develop through challenging projects and deployment of various technologies while also ensuring excellent service to our Sequoia team members. Work the IT support queue and provide Tier 1 - 2 support to both onsite and remote users. Own org-wide IT asset procurement, distribution, and logistics. Assist managing company spend for endpoints, hardware, and other equipment.

title: Product Engineer, Internal Tools
description_html: Y Combinator is run by a small team that is committed to helping founders start the next Airbnb, Stripe, Reddit, or Doordash. We work out of the same campus in San Francisco that we run the batch in. We also operate according to the same principles we teach our startups - so if you've read Paul Graham's essays or watched our videos on YouTube , you can already predict what it would be like to work here. Working at YC places you in the center of the startup world. About the role To manage our operations at scale, we write lots of software for YC itself. One aspect of this is building internal tools to help run YC itself more efficiently.

title: Product Engineer, Bookface
description_html: Y Combinator is run by a small team that is committed to helping founders start the next Airbnb, Stripe, Reddit, or Doordash. We work out of the same campus in San Francisco that we run the batch in. We also operate according to the same principles we teach our startups - so if you've read Paul Graham's essays or watched our videos on YouTube , you can already predict what it would be like to work here. Working at YC places you in the center of the startup world. About the role To manage the YC program at scale, we write lots of software. The Bookface team specifically focuses on building YC’s most critical tools to help founders through the batch – and well afterwards. Some projects we’re working on: Bookface.

title: Software Product Design Engineer
description_html: Build polished, thoughtful product experiences at YC Y Combinator builds the software that runs YC — internal tools used by partners and founders, public products used by the broader startup ecosystem, and AI-powered systems that automate complex workflows. Our team is small, the impact is large, and we ship real product to real users frequently. We’re looking for a Software Product Design Engineer — someone who lives at the intersection of design and engineering. You’ll design beautiful user experiences, translate high-fidelity mocks into production code, and proactively elevate existing interfaces with thoughtful detail and interactions. What you’ll do Design compelling, clear UI/UX and produce high-quality mocks that demonstrate strong product taste.

title: Investment Associate & Product Engineer
description_html: Y Combinator is looking for a full-stack product engineer who also wants to apply their skills to investing, diligence, and founder support. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and investing. You will spend much of your time writing production code — building internal and founder-facing tools — while also contributing directly to company evaluation and investment decisions. This is not two jobs stitched together. The core of the role is turning judgment into software: using code to improve how YC evaluates companies, supports founders, and scales its impact after the batch.

title: Product Engineer, Applications Operations
description_html: Y Combinator is hiring a full-stack product engineer to work at the center of how YC operates — from the application pipeline to events and internal tools. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and operations. You’ll spend most of your time building production software for both internal teams and founders, while also helping design and improve the processes those tools support. At its core, this role is about turning operational complexity into well-designed software. We don’t have traditional PMs or designers. Engineers own the product experience end-to-end — from understanding the problem to designing the UI to shipping the system. The right person is excited to create their own interfaces, workflows, and user experiences, not just implement someone else’s specs.

title: Product Engineer, New Products
description_html: About the role Y Combinator is building a new generation of products for the AI-native era — and we're hiring product engineers to build them. Some ship in the open to hundreds of thousands of developers (gstack, gbrain — already north of 130,000 GitHub stars between them). Some are proprietary products in their own right (Paxel). All of them start from the same belief: a single builder with the right tooling now ships like a team of twenty, and we intend to build the tools — and the platforms — that prove it. This is a rare seat. You won't be maintaining someone else's roadmap. You'll be taking new products from zero to one, owning them end-to-end, and putting them in front of real users fast.

title: Events Manager
description_html: We're hiring an experienced Event Manager to join our small team at Y Combinator. Our team produces a wide range of flagship events, including milestone celebrations, high-touch multi-day retreats, quarterly Demo Day showcases, and conferences for thousands of attendees. The majority of our events are produced in-house, which means this role goes far beyond managing vendors. You'll help shape the project management, production, logistics, and guest experience of events that bring together some of the most ambitious founders, builders, and investors in the world. Our hands-on approach rewards curiosity, creativity, and resourcefulness in how events are brought to life.

description_html: LEAD. STRATEGIZE. TRANSFORM. JOIN US AS A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES PRACTICE MANAGER! Are you ready to own your impact at the forefront of the data revolution ? As a Services Practice Manager , you’ll be a key driver in transforming businesses through cutting-edge cloud data solutions . You’ll collaborate with top-tier clients, strategize with elite sales teams, and lead groundbreaking professional service engagements —all while working with the best minds in the industry! This role is completely remote and can be based anywhere in the Pacific or Mountain Timezone. WHY THIS ROLE? Be a Market Leader: Own and execute a strategic vision for Professional Services. Drive Meaningful Change: Work with clients to unlock the power of data and fuel digital transformations.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Incident Response
description_html: 1Password is growing. We've surpassed $400M in ARR and we're continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we're building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world's most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to…

title: Counsel, Corporate
description_html: Hims & Hers is seeking a Corporate Counsel to join our growing, collaborative Legal team. You will have the opportunity to provide teams from across the company with actionable legal advice on various high-impact corporate transactions and on corporate and securities laws, rules, and regulations applicable to Hims & Hers. You will work on interesting issues that arise from the intersection of healthcare, technology, and e-commerce in the exciting, fast-paced environment of a growing public company.

title: Counsel, Product (Health-Tech)
description_html: Hims & Hers is seeking an enterprising and creative Product Counsel to join our growing and collaborative Legal team. As Product Counsel, you will provide teams across the company with practical legal advice supporting the development, launch, and promotion of Hims & Hers products and solutions. You will get to work on interesting and novel issues that arise from the intersection of healthcare, technology, and e-commerce. The successful candidate will be proactive and organized with a team-oriented mindset, a positive attitude, excellent time management skills, and the ability to thrive in a remote environment.

title: Counsel, Regulatory
description_html: About the Role: Hims & Hers is seeking an outstanding Regulatory Counsel to join our growing, collaborative Legal team. You will have the opportunity to provide teams from across the company with actionable legal advice on various healthcare laws, rules, and regulations impacting the products and services offered through Hims & Hers. You will get to work on interesting and novel issues that arise from the intersection of healthcare, technology, and e-commerce. You Will: Support multiple teams throughout the organization, including the care operations, medical affairs, and EMR product engineering teams, focusing on the laws, rules, and regulations impacting all aspects of care delivery via telehealth Advise cross-functional teams across the business on a broad variety of healthcare…

title: Director, Category Management, Hims
description_html: About the Role: We’re looking for a Director, Category Management to own the initiatives that decide whether a Hims category wins — the biggest levers on the P&L across acquisition, retention, and new-treatment launches. You’ll be the strategic lead on these end-to-end, with growth and ops partners behind you and a clear runway to grow into a GM running your own category . Hims isn’t a set of one-time transactions; it’s a healthcare platform where value compounds through retention and cross-category adoption. You’ll be measured on the long-term, multi-specialty value your customers generate on platform — not just on acquisition – and your ability to prioritize initiatives across all roadmaps.

title: Director, Engineering - Commerce
description_html: About the Role: Hims & Hers is on a mission to empower people to live healthier lives. Commerce is the engine that turns that mission into a seamless buying and subscription experience — the systems that power how customers discover products, see the right price, redeem promotions, pay, and check out across our platform. As we scale to serve millions of members, the reliability, flexibility, and intelligence of these systems directly shape revenue, conversion, and customer trust. As Director of Engineering for Commerce , you will be the single engineering DRI for the end-to-end commerce platform spanning catalog, pricing, promotions, payments, and checkout.

title: Director, Product & Marketing Analytics
description_html: About the Role: As Director of Product & Marketing Analytics, you will define how Hims & Hers measures and acts on the performance of its core products and marketing investments. You will lead a team of analysts embedded across product and marketing functions and partnering with GMs, PMs, growth leads, and finance to turn complex data into clear decisions. This role sits at the intersection of experimentation, attribution strategy, and retention analytics, and requires someone who can operate from executive alignment to hands-on methodology. Reports to the VP of Data, Analytics, and Data Science.

title: Director, Product Communications (Hers)
description_html: About the Role: The Communications team at Hims & Hers is responsible for shaping how the world understands our company’s role in advancing modern health. We develop strategies to raise awareness, increase brand love, build trust and loyalty, and drive adoption of our products and services. As Hers , our platform for women’s health, scales its product portfolio and enters new health categories, the Director, Product Communications, Hers will lead and develop strategies to raise awareness, increase brand love, build trust and loyalty, and drive adoption. You will shape how we position and communicate our products and care offerings across media, internal teams, influencer and editorial channels, and key external moments.

title: Director, Technical Services
description_html: About the Role: Hims & Hers is scaling a multi-site sterile and nonsterile manufacturing network spanning 503A compounding pharmacies, a 503B outsourcing facility, and a new peptide active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) manufacturing site. The Director, Technical Services is a newly created, cross-site leadership role responsible for technology transfer, cleaning validation, process validation, and hands-on process and equipment troubleshooting across all sites. This role partners closely with site Operations, Quality, R&D, and Engineering leaders to keep manufacturing processes running reliably and to resolve technical issues quickly as the network grows. This position will define and own the multi-site Technical Services strategy that supports the product lifecycle in our operations.

title: Financial Analyst, FP&A
description_html: About the Role: Hims & Hers is looking to hire a Financial Analyst to join our Strategic Finance organization. This role will report to a leader on the FP&A team. As a Financial Analyst, you will support consolidated planning and reporting deliverables, help build and maintain the company's core financial models, contribute to executive- and Board-facing materials, and partner across FP&A pillars to support the forecast cycle. You will work under regular guidance from experienced team members, with your work reviewed periodically as you develop your expertise and take on increasing ownership over time.

title: Lead Product Manager
description_html: About the Role: Hims & Hers is at an inflection point. We've built dozens of categories that people love, and we're great at the treatments themselves. But today those are dozens of separate, transactional relationships. The opportunity in front of us is to invert that: to move from point solutions to one deepening relationship with each customer, where we understand them holistically across all of their concerns, help them navigate what to do, and let the individual treatments become secondary to the relationship itself. That shift is what this role owns. It's a true 0-to-1 build, but not a cold start.

title: Lead Product Manager, Consumer Apps
description_html: About the Role: Hims and Hers is redefining wellness and healthcare with a fully integrated consumer, clinician, and pharmacy experience designed for the way patients want to be treated today. You will own the next generation of Hims and Hers mobile app experiences and the cross-category mobile app foundations that make our subscription products useful and coherent across weight loss, sexual health, and every category on the platform. The Hims and Hers apps are the primary surface for retention, human care, AI patient facing features and lifecycle engagement, making this one of the most impactful opportunities at the company. This role is ideal for someone who has significant experience building exceptional consumer mobile products at scale and wants to help redefine personalized care.

title: Learning Management System Administrator
description_html: About the Role: Hims & Hers is seeking a technically skilled and detail-oriented LMS Administrator to join our Learning & Development team. This role serves as the technical expert for our Docebo Learning Management System, overseeing system configuration, course and learning plan administration, automation, systems integrations, data integrity, and platform governance to support enterprise learning initiatives across multiple business units and locations. The LMS Administrator will design and maintain automated workflows, build integrations and custom reporting solutions, and evaluate new platform capabilities to keep the LMS scalable and reliable. Working closely with the Sr.

title: Manager, Legal Programs (Privacy & AI)
description_html: About the Role: Hims & Hers is looking for an outstanding Manager, Legal Programs (Privacy & AI) to join our growing Legal team. Splitting your time across our established privacy program and our developing AI governance program, you will partner closely with our Privacy Program Manager, Privacy and AI Counsels, and teams across the business to maintain our privacy commitments, build out responsible AI practices, and help solve complex legal and compliance problems at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and consumer products.

title: Manager, Material Scientist
description_html: About the Role: Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (better known as Hims & Hers) is looking for an experienced Manager, Material Scientist to support and scale our research and development capabilities. This role will partner closely with the VP of R&D and Innovation to help build and lead material science and pre-formulation efforts, while establishing the infrastructure needed to support continued product innovation and growth. The Manager will play a critical role in bridging early-stage drug concepts with final formulations, supporting the developability of new and existing products. This includes physicochemical characterization, excipient compatibility, and material risk assessment to ensure quality, stability, and scalability across our portfolio.

title: Manager, Strategic Finance - Planning Systems
description_html: About the Role Hims & Hers is looking to hire a Manager, Strategic Finance - Planning Systems lead to join our Strategic Finance organization. Reporting to the VP, FP&A, you will own the architecture behind the company's consolidated planning and reporting cycles, designing how inputs from across the FP&A pillars flow into a coherent, system-based corporate view that informs decisions made by senior leadership, the executive team, and the Board. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role for someone who pairs strong financial and business acumen with deep experience in planning tools and finance transformation. You will own end-to-end workstreams, set the standard for how planning and reporting scale, and act as a force multiplier for the brocader FP&A team.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description_html: About the Role: We're hiring a Principal Data Engineer to set the technical direction for data at Hims & Hers. This is the most senior individual contributor role in Data Platform Engineering (DPE), and the scope is deliberately larger than DPE: the architecture you define determines how Software Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Data Science build on data for millions of patients across our Telehealth, prescription, and wellness products. The platform runs on GCP BigQuery, Airflow on Astronomer/EKS, dbt, Confluent Kafka, Databricks Delta Lake, and Terraform/OpenTofu. Two foundational pieces are being built from scratch right now: a streaming platform and a lower environments strategy.

title: Principal Engineer, Applied AI (Fullstack/Backend)
description_html: About the Role AI is disrupting our stack from the inside, and we're looking for a Principal Engineer to architect that transformation from day one. Applied AI is a small, fast-moving team building a fresh take on how patient care should happen, from intake through ongoing care companionship. While much of the team is focused on research and rapid experimentation, this role is the productionization counterpart — the person who takes what's working and makes it robust, scalable, and reliable enough to run in production at the core of the patient experience. You'll be the key architect of the patient-facing experience end-to-end, owning how the services across the stack fit together.

title: Principal HR Business Partner
description_html: About the Role: As Hims & Hers continues to scale, the complexity of our business, leaders, and organization continues to grow. We're looking for a Principal HR Business Partner to help shape what's next. This is a highly strategic role that requires exceptional business acumen as much as HR expertise. The right person will develop a deep understanding of our business, operating model, and leadership priorities, then translate that understanding into building organizations, leadership teams, and talent strategies that enable the business to move faster and scale effectively. You'll serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, helping shape not only organizational decisions, but how leaders think about organization, leadership, and talent.

title: Principal HR Business Partner - Tech
description_html: About the Role: As Hims & Hers continues to scale, the complexity of our business, leaders, and organization continues to grow. We're looking for a Principal HR Business Partner to help shape what's next. This is a highly strategic role that requires exceptional business acumen as much as HR expertise. The right person will develop a deep understanding of our business, operating model, and leadership priorities, then translate that understanding into building organizations, leadership teams, and talent strategies that enable the business to move faster and scale effectively. You'll serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, helping shape not only organizational decisions, but how leaders think about organization, leadership, and talent.

title: Product Manager, AI
description_html: About the Role: Hims & Hers is redefining wellness and healthcare with a fully integrated consumer, clinician, and pharmacy experience designed for the way patients want to be treated today. We are hiring a Product Manager, AI to lead the next generation of AI-powered experiences across our patient experiences. You’ll drive the roadmap for how AI shows up in our consumer journeys - guidance, education, adherence, and ongoing health support. This role sits at the intersection of consumer experience, messaging, and provider workflows, requiring someone who can apply AI capabilities towards delightful, trustworthy and high-impact product experiences.

title: Quality Compliance Specialist , Post Market Surveillance
description_html: About the Role: We're looking for a detail-oriented Quality Compliance Specialist to manage the intake, investigation, and resolution of customer and partner complaints related to prescription products. This role sits at the intersection of quality, compliance, and customer experience, working closely with pharmacy partners, and medical teams, to ensure complaints are investigated thoroughly, documented accurately, and closed within regulatory and contractual timelines. This role requires a hands-on, detail-oriented and highly organized individual with a strong background in pharmaceutical and/or pharmacy customer complaint management, and trending of customer data in order to drive continuous improvement.

title: Regional Learning Manager, Learning Operations
description_html: About the Role: Hims & Hers is seeking a strategic, results-driven Regional Learning Manager (West Region) to lead learning and development across our Dispense & Fulfillment, Compounding, and Diagnostics operations. Reporting to the Director of Learning & Development, this role leads learning strategy and execution at scale — owning a regional portfolio of sites, building and developing a high-performing learning team, and driving network-wide programs and continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in regulated pharmaceutical or healthcare environments, a strong track record of leading learning teams across multiple locations, and the operational savvy to translate business priorities into measurable learning outcomes.

title: Senior Analyst, Care Operations
description_html: About the Role: We are looking for an experienced Senior Analyst to join the Care Operations team! Our analysts develop a deep understanding of the day-to-day performance of the Care Operations business, using data to identify opportunities, improve processes, and drive better outcomes. Reporting to the Director of Business Operations, you will surface insights that shape key initiatives and process improvements, helping deliver a world-class experience for both patients and providers. This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role that partners closely with teams across the organization. You Will: Lead complex analyses across Care Operations to identify trends, diagnose root causes, and translate ambiguous business problems into actionable strategies and recommendations.

title: Senior Financial Analyst, Ops Finance
description_html: About the Role: Hims & Hers is looking to hire a Senior Financial Analyst supporting Operations. This role will be the primary finance partner for pharmaceutical manufacturing costs, packaging, and R&D. They will work closely with Operations, Supply Chain, and R&D leadership to drive cost transparency, margin insights, and disciplined investment decisions. The business is scaling rapidly, creating constant opportunities to improve processes and rethink how work gets done. This is not a purely reporting-focused FP&A role, many of the problems this role will tackle will not have predefined frameworks or clean data. The right candidate is extremely curious, learns fast, collaborates well, and is energized by problem solving and driving decisions in a fast-moving environment.

title: Senior Financial Analyst, Strategic Finance - FP&A
description_html: About the Role: Hims & Hers is looking to hire a Senior Financial Analyst, Corporate FP&A to join our strategic finance organization. This role will report to the Director of FP&A. As a Senior Financial Analyst, you will own and be responsible for consolidated planning and reporting deliverables, building and maintaining the company's core financial models, supporting executive- and Board-facing materials, partnering across Strategic Finance pillars to drive the forecast cycle, and continuously raising the bar on the quality and efficiency of our planning infrastructure.

title: Senior Salesforce Administrator - Service Cloud
description_html: About the Role: We’re seeking a Senior Salesforce Administrator - Service Cloud to own the configuration, governance, and continuous improvement of our Service Cloud platform. This is a full-time, regular position on our Engineering & Technology team. You’ll be the platform owner for how our support and care teams work inside Salesforce — case management, Omni-Channel routing, the Service Console, and the automation that keeps agents productive and SLAs on track. You’ll partner closely with Support Operations and CX leaders to translate their process needs into scalable, well-governed Salesforce configuration, and you’ll mentor other admins as our Service Cloud footprint grows.

title: Software Engineer II, Patient Platform (Backend)
description_html: About the Role: Hims & Hers is on a mission to empower people to live healthier lives. Our Patient team plays a critical role in achieving this by building services for the Patient Health Data Platform, enabling both patient and provider experiences. As a Software Engineer II, you will design and implement moderately complex, scalable solutions across our back-end systems, working independently on well-scoped projects. You will contribute to design decisions within your squad, deepen your testing and operational practices, and help raise the quality bar through thoughtful code reviews and knowledge sharing.

title: Sr Product Manager
description_html: About the Role: Hims and Hers is redefining wellness and healthcare with a fully integrated consumer, clinician, and pharmacy experience designed for the way consumers want to be treated today. As a Product Lead, you will own the end-to-end consumer experience for a new experience we’re launching in proactive healthcare. This is a 0-to-1 opportunity to define and build a new product from the ground up — shaping how millions of consumers discover, adopt, and engage with a brand-new product area for the company. You will set the vision, build the foundation, and ship the experience that brings this vertical to life.

title: Sr. Counsel, Employment (APAC & EMEA)
description_html: We're looking for a senior employment attorney to help lead our Employment Legal function as we scale internationally. This role carries two connected mandates: building the global programs, policies, and infrastructure that let our Legal and People teams operate consistently and compliantly as we grow, and serving as the day-to-day legal partner for employment matters across our Asia-Pacific (APAC) and Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) regions. You’ll report into the Managing Counsel, Employment and partner closely with HR, People, Litigation, and business leaders on issues ranging from routine employee relations questions to cross-border reorganizations.

title: Sr. Manager, Category Strategy & Analysis
description_html: About the Role: We’re looking for a Sr. Manager, Category Strategy & Analysis to be the analytical engine behind the Hims categories — Sexual Health (ED/PE), Testosterone, and Hair . You’ll partner with the GM and Category Directors to shape, prioritize, and drive the initiatives that move the P&L, turning rich analytics and synthesized insight into decisions: what we build, what we launch, and in what order. This is a strategy seat with real leverage. The Hims portfolio runs on two roadmaps — the tech product roadmap and the treatment development pipeline — and your sizing, models, and prioritization frameworks are what keep both honest, aligned, and defensible in front of leadership. Reports to the General Manager, Hims.

title: Sr. Software Engineer, Patient Platform (Backend)
description_html: About the Role: Hims & Hers is on a mission to empower people to live healthier lives. Our Patient team plays a critical role in achieving this by building services for the Patient Health Data Platform, enabling both patient and provider experiences. As a Sr. Software Engineer, you will be a key technical leader responsible for designing and implementing scalable, high-performance solutions across back-end systems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and influence the direction of our platform.

title: Sr. Staff Engineer (Backend)
description_html: About the Role: We are seeking a visionary and technically exceptional Sr. Staff Engineer to lead architectural innovation and strategic technical direction. This individual will operate at the organizational level, shaping the long-term technical landscape, enabling cross-functional execution at scale, and aligning engineering efforts with product and business outcomes. You Will: Architectural Vision & Strategy Define and evolve the architectural vision for customer-facing systems in alignment with business strategy. Lead cross-org initiatives that address long-term scale, system boundaries, and foundational capabilities Technical Leadership & Governance Establish patterns and frameworks that ensure quality, resilience, and operational excellence across the organization.

title: Sr. Staff Engineer (Fullstack/Frontend)
description_html: About the Role: We are seeking a visionary and technically exceptional Sr. Staff Engineer to lead architectural innovation and strategic technical direction. This individual will operate at the organizational level, shaping the long-term technical landscape, enabling cross-functional execution at scale, and aligning engineering efforts with product and business outcomes. Key Responsibilities Architectural Vision & Strategy Define and evolve the architectural vision for customer-facing frontend systems in alignment with business strategy. Lead cross-org initiatives that address long-term scale, system boundaries, and foundational UI capabilities — from design systems to rendering architecture.

title: Sr. Staff Machine Learning Systems Engineer
description_html: About the Role: How do we make advanced AI/ML not just powerful but trustworthy enough to run in a regulated healthcare environment? We're looking for a Senior Staff engineer who can own that question end to end: the data pipelines that feed our models and evaluations, and the evaluation infrastructure — judges, scorers, statistical regression gates, red-team testing — that decides whether AI models are effective and safe to ship to patients. This is a leadership role for someone who works comfortably across disciplines. You'll set technical direction for how we build, version, and trust the data and judgments that our AI products are evaluated against.

title: Sr. Technical Recruiter
description_html: About the Role: We’re hiring a Senior Technical Recruiter (a full-time, six-month contract, salaried position) to scale Engineering at Hims & Hers. You’ll own full-cycle hiring for Senior to Staff+ ICs and identify and close force-multiplier talent while delivering an exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience. You’ll run structured, values‑aligned processes - adaptability, humble collaboration, ownership, and a bias for action, that improve talent density across the org. At Hims and Hers, we’re building on incredible momentum, focusing on launching new specialties that will transform our platform from reactive care to proactive, comprehensive health management, deeper personalization, and tech-enabled care, as well as expanding our international presence.

title: Staff Analyst, AI
description_html: About the Role: As a Staff Analyst, AI, you will serve as a strategic analytics partner to the teams building and operating Hims & Hers' AI products (e.g., patient-facing AI chat assistants, internal AI tools for care teams). You will work cross-functionally with engineers, product managers, clinical operations, and finance to measure product performance, quantify commercial and clinical impact, and shape the experimentation and measurement strategy for AI-driven experiences. This position will report to the Manager of AI Analytics.

title: Staff Analyst, Product & Marketing
description_html: About the Role: As a Staff Analyst, Product & Marketing, you will serve as a strategic analytics partner to both the Product and Marketing organizations, driving impact across the full customer journey from acquisition and conversion to retention and growth. You will work cross-functionally with product managers, growth leads, category managers, marketing channel owners, designers, engineers, and data scientists in a fast-paced collaborative environment. Your expertise in A/B testing, digital analytics, marketing measurement, experimental design, and predictive modeling will allow Hims and Hers to optimize the customer experience and marketing investments in equal measure. This position will report to the Director of Product and Marketing Analytics.

title: Staff Data Engineer
description_html: About the Role: We're looking for a Staff Data Engineer to join the Data Platform Engineering team at Hims & Hers as a key technical driver for our most critical platform initiatives. Your scope spans multiple squads: you will drive shared architectural decisions, enhance cross-team reliability, and improve the overall developer experience for a team of nine engineers building the infrastructure that powers patient care for millions of Hims & Hers subscribers. This is a hands-on execution role. You will own large, complex deliverables end-to-end - from design through production - across our full stack: BigQuery, dbt, Airflow on Astronomer, Confluent Kafka, Databricks, Fivetran, and Terraform/OpenTofu.

title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
description_html: About the Role: We’re looking for a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer who’s passionate about using AI to change how teams across the business get their work done. You’ll embed with a team, learn how they actually work, and build the AI-powered workflows that make them faster and more effective. You start by mapping how the function operates today, then decide together with the team where AI can create the most value and build it. This is not a support role, a solutions-engineering role, or staff augmentation. You are a full engineer who works at the boundary between our AI platform and a business domain. You ship production systems, and the best of what you build for one team becomes a reusable capability for the whole company. You Will: Embed with a team.

title: Staff Product Designer, Core Treatments
description_html: About the Role: This is one of the most consequential design roles on the team. Core treatments—sexual health, testosterone, hair loss, and labs—are categories where trust is everything, and where good design changes whether someone asks for help at all. We're looking for a Staff Product Designer who understands that and brings the skill, judgment, and range to act on it. You'll own the end-to-end experience across these categories: the intake flows, the treatment journeys, the moments of reassurance, and the points where someone decides to stay or leave. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Clinical, and Research—and you'll be expected to lead, not just execute.

title: Staff Software Engineer (Full-stack/Backend)
description_html: About the Role: Hims & Hers is on a mission to empower people to live healthier lives. We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Subscriptions and Membership Platform team. This team plays a critical role in achieving this by building cutting-edge web experiences that drive patient retention, engagement, and satisfaction. In this highly visible and impactful role, you'll directly influence key growth metrics and significantly shape how we activate and reactivate customers across our platform.

title: Staff Software Engineer, AI & Recommendations Platform
description_html: About the Role: How can we use vast amounts of proprietary and internet-scale healthcare data to build systems that enable access to significantly better healthcare? As a Staff Software Engineer on the AI team, you will play a key technical leadership role in evolving AI & Recommendations platform. You will help build the systems, infrastructure, and services that power treatment recommendations, provider decision support and experimentation across multiple healthcare verticals. This role is ideal for an engineer who is passionate about building scalable platforms and production systems while leveraging machine learning and AI technologies to solve complex healthcare problems.

title: Staff Technical Program Manager
description_html: About the Role: We’re seeking a Staff Technical Program Manager to own the design, execution, and strategic direction of complex, ambiguous programs at the group and organizational level. This is a full-time, regular position on our Engineering & Technology team. You’ll operate as a technical integrator across multiple domains — identifying architectural risk, aligning engineering, product, and business priorities, and building the execution frameworks that let the organization scale. You’ll partner closely with senior technical and business leaders to translate long-range strategy into roadmaps that hold up under ambiguity, and you’ll help shape how Hims & Hers builds and delivers technology at scale.

title: VP, Engineering & Facilities
description_html: About the Role We are seeking a Vice President of Engineering & Facilities to define and scale the engineering systems, infrastructure, and technical capabilities that power our compounding and pharmacy fulfillment network. This leader will own the design and evolution of our end-to-end engineering ecosystem, spanning facility design, cleanrooms, utilities, automation, manufacturing systems, and material flow from compounding through dispensing, packaging, and delivery. You will serve as the senior-most engineering partner to Pharmacy, Operations, and Quality leadership. The role requires strong engineering judgment, executive leadership, and enough experience in GMP- and USP-regulated environments to translate quality requirements into practical facility and system designs.

title: B2C Marketing (part-time) Intern
description_html: The Opportunity Clera is the AI talent agent. We don't wait for applications—we go find the best people and get them hired at companies like Luminai, Windsurf, and Mintlify. We're looking for a B2C Marketing Working Student / Intern to help us grow our consumer-facing talent side. You'll work directly with the founding team to build and execute marketing strategies that attract top talent to Clera's platform. This role is for you if You're currently enrolled at a US university (Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field) or a recent graduate You have a passion for B2C marketing and consumer growth You're comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment You think in experiments and want to see the impact of your work You have strong written communication skills in English…

title: Founding Account Executive (US)
description_html: About the Role This is the first commercial hire in the US for a YC-backed enterprise AI startup building agents that automate complex system implementations, including ERP rollouts, AI platform integrations, and customer onboarding. You will work directly with the founding team to open the American market, close the first wave of US customers, and establish the partner channel from the ground up. The motion you build becomes the playbook every future seller inherits. What You'll Do Own the full US sales cycle end to end: self-sourced outbound, discovery, demo, technical evaluation, procurement, and close. Sell both a direct enterprise motion (annual platform contracts) and a partner channel of systems integrators, VARs, and consultancies.

title: Founding GTM Lead
description_html: About the Role This is a founding go-to-market role at an early-stage generative AI startup building next-generation models for human-centered image and video creation. You will own end-to-end GTM execution across community, content, partnerships, and outreach, working directly with the founding team to build the repeatable commercial playbook from scratch. The role carries high ownership and autonomy, and will directly shape early customer relationships, positioning, and product feedback loops. What You'll Do Own early GTM execution across community, content, partnerships, and targeted outbound outreach. Build and manage relationships with design partners and early customers in creator, studio, and agency segments.

title: Resident Solution Architect (Databricks)
description_html: About the Role This is a senior, hands-on Solution Architect role focused on Databricks platform delivery for enterprise clients. You will sit at the intersection of data engineering, cloud architecture, and client consulting, helping complex organizations design and implement scalable data lakehouse solutions. The work is high-impact, requiring both deep technical expertise and strong consulting instincts. What You'll Do Lead end-to-end Databricks implementation projects from architecture design through production deployment. Design and optimize large-scale data platforms using the Databricks Lakehouse Platform and Apache Spark. Apply performance tuning and scalability best practices to distributed data systems.

title: Sales Development Representative
description_html: About the Role This is a front-line, phone-first SDR role at an early-stage advertising technology company focused on performance marketing and DTC e-commerce. You will be the first voice inbound prospects hear, qualifying leads quickly and booking demos for the sales team. Your conversations directly shape revenue strategy and inform how the company positions itself in the market. What You'll Do Call every inbound signup who leaves a phone number but has not booked a demo, prioritizing speed and responsiveness. Qualify prospects quickly by assessing their budget, current setup, and overall fit during discovery calls. Book qualified demos onto the sales team's calendar. Execute multi-touch outreach across phone, email, and SMS for prospects who do not respond on the first attempt.

title: Account Executive Director SLED (Midwest)
description_html: About the Role: Socure is seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented Account Executive Director to join our State, Local and Higher Education (SLED) team. This position will report directly to our Head of Public Sector Sales and will be responsible for driving revenue growth for the Midwest Region through direct pursuits and strategic partnerships. This position requires strong selling skills and an entrepreneurial spirit to bring value to SLED customers and technology partners and drive growth for the business. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record surpassing revenue targets in the SLED market, and be well versed in consultative sales processes for SaaS solutions.

title: Account Executive Director, Gaming
description_html: About the Role Socure is seeking a high-performing Account Executive Director, Gaming to drive strategic growth across our one of our fastest growing verticals. As an Account Executive, you’ll own and lead high-impact sales efforts for our AI-powered identity and fraud solutions. This is a rare opportunity to help shape market adoption in a category-defining company. What You’ll Do New Logo + Upsell: Lead growth across both new logo opportunities and existing accounts, developing expansion strategies that deepen product adoption and maximize account value. Lead Enterprise Sales: Manage full-cycle sales—from prospecting to close—targeting high-value SaaS deals with innovative, fast-growing companies.

title: Director of Financial Systems
description_html: About the role The Director of Financial Systems is a hands-on senior leader who owns the strategy and execution of Socure's finance technology stack — including ERP, billing, revenue, and adjacent financial applications. This is a role for someone who understands financial processes deeply, not just the tools that support them, and who can translate that understanding into scalable, automated solutions. Reporting to the VP of Business Operations, they sit at the intersection of Accounting, FP&A, Business Technology, and go-to-market operations, driving the roadmap for core financial platforms with a strong bias toward automation, AI adoption, and data quality. This is not a role defined by headcount.

title: L&D Program Manager
description_html: Builders wanted: design the systems that grow Socure’s people, from the ground up. About the role The L&D Program Manager owns the design, launch, and scale of Socure’s capability-building, growth, leadership development, and onboarding ecosystem - architecting from scratch, or elevating, rather than maintaining what’s already there. This role carries full ownership of five interconnected pillars: capability building at scale, growth (careers philosophy, career pathing, and internal mobility), High-Potential (HiPo) programming, leadership development programming, and the onboarding program. We think about growth and enablement as one system, not two — every program should make people measurably better at their current job while building a clear path to their next one.

title: Legal Counsel, Commercial Contracts
description_html: Job Summary Socure's legal team is seeking a Commercial Counsel. Reporting to our Head of Commercial Legal or a Senior Legal Counsel, you will have a chance to help shape the company's legal function, build processes and policies, and partner with Sales, Finance, Product, and Engineering teams, as well as other attorneys. We offer an exciting, fast-paced company environment, with a shared mission to eliminate identity fraud and lead the identity verification market. This is a great opportunity for someone who is passionate about their work, enjoys taking ownership of projects, and is skilled at identifying pragmatic solutions.

title: Post Sales Solution Consultant, Big Tech/AI
description_html: Socure is seeking a Post-Sales Solution Consultant, Big Tech/AI to lead complex customer solutioning across implementation and strategic post-sales engagements. In this role, you will partner closely with customers and internal cross-functional teams to design scalable solutions, guide proof-of-concept and delivery efforts, translate technical complexity into business value, and bring field insight back into product and go-to-market strategy. The ideal candidate brings deep consultative and technical credibility, strong customer presence, and experience navigating sophisticated enterprise environments—particularly in identity, fraud, fintech, risk, or related data- and AI-driven domains.

title: Pre-Sales Solution Consultant, Big Tech/AI
description_html: As a Pre-Sales Solution Consultant, Big Tech/AI, you will partner with Sales to demonstrate how Socure can solve complex identity, fraud, risk, and compliance challenges for strategic technology and AI customers. You will lead discovery, technical qualification, solution design, demonstrations, proof-of-concept initiatives, and executive presentations throughout the sales cycle. Your work will create customer confidence in Socure’s solution, establish a technically credible path to implementation, and support successful handoff to post-sales teams. What you’ll do Own pre-sales solution consulting for strategic Big Tech/AI customers from qualification through closed won.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Workforce Verification
description_html: Socure is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Workforce Verification Team. In this critical role, you will be a technical leader, driving the design, development, and deployment of innovative software solutions that help eliminate identity fraud. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, mentor junior engineers, and ensure the delivery of high-quality, scalable, and secure products. At Socure, we value teamwork, outcome-driven development, and a commitment to best-in-class technology experiences.

title: Senior Commercial Counsel, Data Acquisition & Licensing
description_html: The Senior Corporate Counsel, Data Acquisition & Licensing is a high-impact legal role focused on structuring, negotiating, and managing the agreements that give Socure access to the data and third-party services that help power our identity verification and fraud prevention solutions. Reporting to the Senior Director, Associate General Counsel, this position leads negotiations with data providers, credit bureaus, government and public-record sources, alternative-data vendors, and third-party service providers globally, and partners closely with the Data Acquisition team, Product, Engineering, Product Counsel, and Privacy to secure data rights and services on commercially and legally sound terms.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description_html: About the Role We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Automation team. You will play a critical role in designing and building scalable data platforms and pipelines that power Socure’s identity verification products and analytics. This role is ideal for someone who has a strong passion for solving real business problems with data, and combines deep hands-on data engineering expertise with strong ownership. What You'll Do • Design and build batch and streaming data pipelines to support automated data ingestion, ML feature engineering and analytics across multiple product domains. • Own end-to-end delivery of complex, ambiguous data initiatives, including architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and documentation.

title: Senior Manager, Financial Analysis
description_html: About the role: Socure is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Manager to support top-line performance, strategic planning, and executive decision-making in a high-growth SaaS environment. This position reports to the VP of FP&A and works closely with go-to-market leaders and cross-functional stakeholders across the company. You will own top-line budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning activities. You will play a crucial role in providing accurate and insightful analyses, supporting strategic decision-making processes, and optimizing financial performance. We are looking for an individual that thrives in fast-paced environments and is passionate about financial modeling, building a business, and driving continuous improvement.

title: Senior Solution Consultant, Fintech
description_html: As a Senior Pre-Sales Solution Consultant, Fintech , you will be the primary technical point-of-contact throughout the sales cycle for fintech and payments prospects in the Fintech pod. You will be responsible for understanding client requirements, designing end-to-end onboarding and transaction risk workflows, and demonstrating how Socure’s platform delivers measurable impact across conversion, fraud losses, and operational efficiency. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Data Science, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to run high-impact discovery, architect solutions, and lead proof-of-concepts that de-risk technical decisions and accelerate deal cycles.

title: Senior Tech Recruiter
description_html: Socure is expanding its Talent Acquisition team to include a technology-focused Senior Recruiter. In this high-impact role, you will be responsible for identifying and attracting world-class technical talent, including engineers, QA professionals, and designers. You will leverage the latest recruitment technologies and AI-driven tools to find top-tier talent and partner with hiring leaders to scale our technical organization. As a Senior Tech Recruiter, you will act as a storyteller and marketer, sourcing and engaging talent by painting a compelling picture of why Socure is the right career choice. You will be a data-driven partner to hiring managers, providing insights into funnel health and market trends while driving continuous improvement across the recruitment cycle.

title: Senior Technical Recruiter, Product
description_html: Socure continues to invest in new talent to join high performing teams across all parts of our organization, To support this growth, our Talent Acquisition team is expanding to include a Senior Recruiter. In this high impact and high visibility role, you will leverage your expertise as a full life cycle recruiter in a high growth tech organization to partner with managers and leaders to deliver against their talent needs. The Senior Recruiter will be prepared to recruit across our Product, Data Science and Fin/Ops teams. Socure’s Talent Acquisition team is part of the People Ops organization and we pride ourselves on teamwork, driving outcomes, our commitment to candidate experience, and contributing to Socure’s mission to eliminate identity fraud.

title: Sr. Strategic Customer Success Manager
description_html: The Senior Strategic Customer Success Manager is responsible for cultivating and maintaining strong relationships with Socure’s customers, ensuring high levels of satisfaction, retention, and measurable business outcomes.
