As a trusted advisor, the CSM partners with customers to drive adoption, maximize value, and proactively address risks. This role collaborates cross-functionally with sales, product, support, and executive teams to deliver a seamless customer experience and support Socure’s growth objectives. Job Responsibilities Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of customers, managing the post-sale relationship and ensuring a positive client experience.

title: Staff Backend Engineer
description_html: About the Role Socure is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Staff Backend Engineer to join our dynamic engineering team within the Technology Center of Excellence. In this critical role, you will be a technical leader, driving the design, development, and deployment of innovative software solutions that help eliminate identity fraud. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, mentor junior engineers, and ensure the delivery of high-quality, scalable, and secure products. At Socure, we value teamwork, outcome-driven development, and a commitment to best-in-class technology experiences.

title: Technical Product Marketing Manager
description_html: About the Role: We are looking for a Technical Product Marketing Manager (tPMM) to join our team and help drive our product marketing strategy by deeply understanding Socure’s technology, crafting compelling narratives, and enabling both internal and external stakeholders with clear, technical messaging. If you have a passion for AI-driven fraud prevention and identity verification, and enjoy distilling complex technical concepts into digestible stories, we want to hear from you! Location Requirements: We are currently only able to hire candidates located in one of our location hubs: New York City, NY; Washington, DC; Seattle, WA; Miami, FL; San Francisco, CA.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description_html: About the role The Technical Support Engineer is a customer-focused problem solver responsible for delivering timely, effective technical solutions and outstanding service. Reporting to the Manager of Technical Support, you will take full ownership of customer issues from initial triage through resolution, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless support experience. This role requires strong technical expertise, excellent communication skills, a commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence, and fluency with AI-powered tools and workflows that are transforming modern technical support.

title: Accounting Manager
description_html: We’re looking for a proactive and motivated Accounting Manager to join our growing finance team. In this role, you’ll play a key part in keeping our day-to-day accounting operations running smoothly, ensuring accurate financial reporting, and supporting compliance across the business. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. You will… 💻 We just implemented our new accounting ERP, Rillet! You will own it from here ensuring integrations continue to work properly, automatic system entries are correct, and ensure the overall cleanliness of the data. 💳 Own the processing of Ramp transactions and employee reimbursements, ensuring accurate coding and proper synchronization with the ERP system. 🧾 Own the AP process.

title: AI Marketing Engineer
description_html: We are looking for an AI Marketing Engineer to stand up and own the system underneath our entire marketing function – the data model, the dashboards, and the agentic workflows that make our marketing look like the AI company we are. You are the single point of accountability for whether the system is on, and a force multiplier for every other person. We buy the platforms and build the agentic glue. You will lock and integrate an opinionated stack across the intelligence, automation, CRM, and analytics layers, then build the internal agents – on Claude – that produce account briefs, objection prep, content drafts, and named-account monitoring. You will also build the weekly data dashboards that the CEO, the Head of Marketing and Head of Sales can read in under five minutes.

title: Chief of Staff to the Head of Sales
description_html: We are looking for a Chief of Staff to the Head of Sales to serve as the right hand to our sales leadership and act as a force multiplier across the go-to-market organization. This is a rare role that sits at the intersection of sales strategy and execution, putting you shoulder to shoulder with the Head of Sales on the decisions, deals, and operating rhythms that drive revenue. Assured’s sales motion increasingly includes a Forward Deployed Team (FDT) model. Our teams work alongside carrier executives and operators to identify high-value claims problems, understand the carrier’s data and workflows, co-create solutions, and move from discovery to measurable production value. You will not lead or own this motion.

title: Client Engagement Operations Manager
description_html: We're looking for a Client Engagement Operations Manager to lead our Client Engagement (CE) function into an AI-native operating environment. This is a builder's role for someone who sees operational friction as a problem to be solved with better systems, smarter tooling, and well-designed AI. You'll sit at the center of how our CE team works — reimagining processes from the ground up, embedding AI agents and automation into daily workflows, and raising the bar on both efficiency and quality across everything the team does. This role is ideal for a self-starter who thrives with ambiguity, moves fast, and knows how to turn a strategic vision into shipped outcomes by partnering across the organization. What You'll Do 🚀 Lead the AI-native transformation of Client Engagement.

title: Contract Technical Sourcer
description_html: Great engineering teams aren't built by waiting for exceptional talent to apply – they're built by finding it. As a Contract Technical Sourcer , you'll spend time identifying and engaging exceptional software engineering talent. You'll partner with recruiters and hiring leaders to understand what great looks like, translate hiring needs into creative sourcing strategies, and build high-quality pipelines for critical Staff+ engineering roles. This contract has the potential to extend based on business needs and performance. The best sourcers don't simply run the same searches as everyone else – they experiment, follow signals, uncover overlooked talent, and find outstanding engineers in unexpected places. They genuinely love the hunt.

title: Design Lead, Foundations
description_html: We’re looking for a strong design leader with an incredible attention to craft to help shape how we design and build products at Assured. You’ll create the systems, standards, and tools that give teams across Design, Product, and Engineering a strong foundation to bring ideas to life and build incredible experiences. You’ll own the future of our design system , but the opportunity goes well beyond components and libraries. You’ll help define the shared patterns, principles, tools, and infrastructure that allow us to raise the quality of our work while moving faster as we grow. We’re also excited about what design enablement can look like in an AI-oriented world.

title: Principal 3D Artist
description_html: As a Principal 3D Artist on our Brand Team, you will be the core engine for 3D illustration and motion designs. Working closely with brand designers, web designers, motion designers and creative developers, you will translate high-level creative concepts into technically sophisticated 3D visuals using Cinema 4D. This role requires a deep technical practitioner - someone who excels at complex dynamic simulations, procedural workflows, custom shader creation, and building hyper-efficient 3D asset handoffs for video production, digital marketing, and modern web environments.

title: Principal Product Manager
description_html: At Assured, we’re reimagining how insurance works, blending technology, data, and design to create smarter, simpler experiences. We’re looking for Principal Product Managers who thrive on ownership, love solving complex problems, and want to make a real impact. What You’ll Do 🧭 Lead Product Strategy: Define and drive the roadmap for new and existing products, shaping how Assured delivers value to customers. 🤝 Collaborate Deeply: Partner with customers, sales, and implementation teams to uncover insights and turn them into actionable strategies. ⚙️ Build with Purpose: Work closely with engineering and design to launch features that are innovative, scalable, and delightful.

title: Principal Product Manager, LOB
description_html: At Assured, we’re reimagining how insurance works — blending technology, data, and design to create smarter, simpler claims experiences. Our claims platform is a core strategic asset, and we’re expanding it to support additional Property & Casualty (P&C) Lines of Business . We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager who moves quickly while exercising strong judgment — someone who can take initiative in ambiguity, collaborate deeply across teams, and balance near-term momentum with long-term platform integrity. This role will shape how Assured’s claims platform evolves into a multi-LOB foundation for the business. What You’ll Do 🧭 Help define the product vision and roadmap for extending Assured’s claims platform across multiple P&C Lines of Business.

title: Principal Product Marketing Manager
description_html: We are looking for a founding Principal Product Marketing Manager – a senior individual contributor who owns the core narrative, use cases, and enablement assets that win and grow our largest accounts. You will be the hands-on craftsperson behind crafting and telling the story: the decks, the one-pagers, the battlecards, the demos, and the use-case maps that Sales takes into the best-of-the-best Insurance carriers in the US. This role spans both of our motions. On 🏁 Land, you own the “Buy vs. Build” narrative and the field-grade objection library that wins Assured against internal AI builds, BPOs, and incumbent core systems. On 📈 Expand, you own the use-case map and expansion playbook that grow claim-share and process penetration inside the logos we already serve.

title: Product Lead, Data & Integrations
description_html: At Assured, data and integrations aren’t support functions — they’re core to how our product delivers value. We’re looking for a Product Lead, Data & Integrations to own the strategy, execution, and evolution of our customer integrations, API ecosystem, and data exchange capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, and customers. You’ll define how Assured connects to the outside world, how data flows across systems, and how our platform scales to support enterprise customers and future growth. What You’ll Do 🎯 Own the Data & Integrations Vision Define and lead the vision, strategy, and roadmap for customer integrations, APIs, and data exchange capabilities — ensuring tight alignment with company goals and evolving customer needs.

title: Product SME - Commercial Property
description_html: You know Commercial Property claims from the inside: the incomplete information, the coverage questions, the contractor estimates that do not quite line up, the business owner waiting to reopen, and the judgment calls that do not fit neatly into a dropdown menu. Now imagine using that expertise to help build the technology that makes those decisions faster, clearer, and more consistent at scale. As a Product Subject Matter Expert for Commercial Property, you will be the bridge between the realities of claims handling and the teams building what comes next.

title: Product SME - Workers Compensation
description_html: Workers’ Compensation claims are never just a workflow. They sit at the intersection of an injured person’s recovery, an employer’s operations, medical care, wage replacement, and a patchwork of state-specific rules. The work demands judgment: knowing what information matters, when a claim needs escalation, and how to move it forward without losing sight of the person behind it. This role is an opportunity to bring that judgment into technology. As a Product Subject Matter Expert for Workers’ Compensation, you’ll partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Claims Operations to turn the realities of claims handling into better products: clearer workflows, more useful data, and thoughtfully designed automation that helps claims teams make stronger decisions at scale.

title: Product SME – Auto Claims
description_html: Assured Insurance Technologies is seeking a Product SME to lead a comprehensive evaluation of the end-to-end auto claims process. This role will focus on understanding how claims move from First Notice of Loss (FNOL) through resolution, how decisions are made and documented, how data flows across systems, and where operational and product improvements can meaningfully impact cycle time, accuracy, customer experience, and financial performance. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering and Analytics and is expected to drive meaningful, company-wide impact.

title: Senior Copywriter, AI & Category Narrative
description_html: We are looking for a Senior Copywriter, AI & Category Narrative – a writer who is genuinely expert in AI and can make agentic AI, frontier models, and LLM-powered systems legible, credible, and compelling to the people who run claims at the largest US carriers. Assured sells to the top P&C carriers that own roughly 98% of the nation's claims volume. The capability and the proof are real; the writing that carries it to the market is the multiplier. You are the hands-on maker of that writing. This is a craft-and-substance role that complements our Content Strategist: the strategist sets the plan and the calendar; you go deep on the subject matter and write the words.

title: Senior IT Support Engineer
description_html: We're looking for a Senior IT Support Engineer to help drive IT operations forward at Assured. Reporting to the IT Manager, you'll own day-to-day support and systems for a fully remote team, lead employee onboarding and offboarding, and partner across IT and Security to keep our environment reliable, compliant, and easy to work in. You'll bring depth in identity, endpoint, and SaaS administration — and just as importantly, an AI-forward mindset : we're building an IT function where AI and automation absorb toil so the team can focus on higher-leverage work. You will… 👨‍💻 User Support & IT Operations – Serve as a senior escalation point for a fully remote, distributed workforce .

title: Senior Manager of Special Projects
description_html: We’re looking for a Senior Manager of Special Projects to work at the heart of our most important strategic and operational work. This role is for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves fast and takes pride in delivering exceptional output across a wide range of problems. You will report to the Head of Strategy & Ops, focusing on delivering high-priority, cross-functional projects across strategy, operations and GTM. After an initial stint in the Special Projects role, there will be opportunities to shift to other functional areas, all with a focus on driving the most important work within the business. What you'll do Drive strategic initiatives 📈 Support end-to-end execution of company priorities, from initial problem framing and analysis through to implementation and accountability.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description_html: As a Senior Product Analyst , you'll turn product data into insights that define how we measure and evaluate our expanding AI and agent-powered capabilities — telling Product and Engineering not just what happened, but what to do next. Some of the problems you’ll solve: 🤖 How do we measure the success of AI-powered experiences? Help define the metrics and evaluation frameworks that tell us whether our agentic capabilities are delivering meaningful value to customers. 🧪 Which product changes actually create value for our customers? Design and analyze experiments that help Product teams separate signal from noise and make confident roadmap decisions. 📊 How do we know if our products are healthy?

title: Senior Product Manager
description_html: We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of product strategy, customer engagement, and execution. In this role, you’ll collaborate directly with customers during onboarding and implementation to make sure our solutions deliver measurable value, fast. You’ll turn real-world insights into product improvements, shaping a platform that grows with our users. What You’ll Do 🤝 Partner with customers during implementation to uncover workflows, pain points, and opportunities that guide product direction. 🧠 Transform insights into clear product requirements, user stories, and a thoughtfully prioritized backlog. 👩‍💻 Collaborate with engineering and design to deliver features that boost adoption, satisfaction, and long-term success.

title: Senior/Principal Engagement Manager
description_html: We’re looking for an experienced Senior/Principal Engagement Manager to join our growing team. As a trusted partner to our customers, you’ll lead large-scale enterprise engagements, evolve delivery frameworks, and ensure seamless implementations from kickoff to long-term success. We’re especially excited about candidates who bring experience working in or alongside the P&C insurance industry — whether through insurtech, carrier partnerships, claims technology, or prior insurance operations experience — and can combine strong customer engagement skills with industry credibility.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description_html: We’re looking for a Software Engineering Manager to lead a talented team as we scale our platform and shape the next phase of our growth. You’ll help define how we build, collaborate, and deliver, driving technical excellence and empowering people to do their best work. What You’ll Do 🧭 Lead and develop exceptional engineers through mentorship, regular feedback, and career growth conversations. 🤝 Collaborate cross-functionally with product and design to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable features that make a real impact for users. ⚙️ Drive engineering excellence by guiding architectural decisions, promoting best practices, and ensuring performance and reliability. 🌱 Scale the team and organization by refining processes, supporting hiring, and improving team velocity and execution.

title: Staff Application Platform Engineer
description_html: Join us in shaping the future of developer experience at Assured! We’re looking for a Staff Application Platform Engineer who’s passionate about building scalable, secure, and elegant systems that empower teams to move fast with confidence. What You’ll Do 🧩 Elevate developer productivity by abstracting common patterns and creating tools that make building delightful. ⚙️ Design, develop, and optimize our platform to be secure, reliable, and effortlessly scalable. 🧠 Diagnose and resolve bottlenecks across the stack to ensure smooth, high-performance systems. 🔒 Champion security and reliability, ensuring sensitive data stays protected at all times. 📈 Continuously improve resilience and efficiency, especially under rapid product growth.

title: Staff Backend Engineer
description_html: As a Staff Backend Engineer , you’ll build reliable backend systems that enable AI agents to handle complex insurance workflows safely and at scale. Some of the Problems You'll Solve: 🤖 Develop autonomous agents that complete meaningful work. Create AI agents that inspect data, resolve conflicting accounts, identify next steps, communicate with users, gather missing information, and suggest decisions across complex, ambiguous real-world workflows through the entire claims lifecycle. 🎙️ Build real-time, conversational AI systems. Develop multi-modal text and voice agents that maintain context, handle interruptions, route requests to specialized capabilities, and adapt dynamically rather than follow rigid scripts. 🚗 Transform unstructured information into interactive experiences.

title: Staff Brand Designer
description_html: We’re looking for a creative and strategic Staff Brand Designer with a strong background in digital and web experience to help shape and evolve our brand across every touchpoint. From high-impact marketing campaigns to seamless digital experiences, you’ll partner with marketing to bring our brand to life in ways that inspire, inform, and delight. You're equally at home designing a pixel-perfect web experience as you are crafting a sales deck or brand asset — and you know how to flex between the two without missing a beat. Please submit a portfolio with your application. What You'll Do 🎨 Showcase a deep understanding of typography, color theory, grids, and more.

title: Staff Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description_html: At Assured, we’re building technology that makes insurance infrastructure more efficient, secure, and scalable. We’re looking for a Staff Cloud Infrastructure Engineer who’s passionate about automation, reliability, and empowering developers through world-class platform engineering. If you thrive in a dynamic startup environment and want to shape the future of large-scale cloud infrastructure, this role is for you. What You’ll Do 🏗️ Design and scale the core infrastructure that powers the Assured platform, supporting both the growth of existing systems and the launch of entirely new product lines. ⚙️ Automate everything using Terraform and Terragrunt, building reliable, repeatable environments that make infrastructure effortless to manage.

title: Staff Cloud Security Engineer
description_html: Join us as a Staff Cloud Security Engineer and play a pivotal role in securing and scaling the cloud foundation that powers everything we do. You’ll design resilient architectures, drive automation, and champion security-by-design across our platform. Your work will help protect our data, earn customer trust, and strengthen our compliance posture as we grow. What You’ll Do 🔒 Design, implement, and scale secure AWS environments that balance innovation and compliance. ⚙️ Build and maintain Terraform modules and infrastructure-as-code pipelines to ensure consistent, auditable, and secure deployments. 🕵️ Lead regular security assessments, perform vulnerability testing, and drive incident response efforts.

title: Staff Data Analyst
description_html: Great decisions aren't built on intuition alone – they're built on data. As a Staff Data Analyst , you'll partner with teams across the organization to transform data into meaningful insights that drive smarter decisions. You'll help leaders understand business performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and measure the impact of strategic initiatives. The best analysts don't just report what happened – they help teams understand why it happened and what to do next. That's the kind of impact we're looking for in this role. Some of the Problems You'll Solve: 🧪 Which initiatives create the greatest impact? Design and analyze experiments, pilots, and performance evaluations that separate signal from noise and support confident decision-making. 📈 How healthy is the business?

title: Staff Database Reliability Engineer, DBRE
description_html: We’re looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer (Database) to help shape and scale the backbone of our growing platform. You’ll lead the design, automation, and optimization of our database infrastructure, ensuring it’s reliable, secure, and built for scale. If you thrive in fast-moving environments and enjoy solving complex performance challenges, we’d love to talk. What You’ll Do 🌎 Scale and optimize our database infrastructure for performance and reliability, starting with PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora. 👩‍💻 Design and implement robust monitoring, tuning, and scaling strategies to support our expanding SaaS platform. 🛠️ Build automation and tooling to streamline database management, focusing on consistency and repeatability.

title: Staff Frontend Engineer
description_html: We’re looking for a Staff Frontend Engineer to help define the future of our B2B SaaS platform through exceptional user experiences, scalable frontend architecture, and AI-native product development workflows. This is a highly hands-on, high-impact role for an engineer who operates at the intersection of design, engineering, and product thinking. You’ll own critical areas of our frontend platform, shape interaction and UI standards, and help establish how modern AI-assisted engineering accelerates both product quality and development velocity. We’re looking for someone who obsesses over usability and polish, thinks in systems, and uses AI tooling as a core part of how they prototype, build, refine, and ship software. What You’ll Do...

title: Staff Full Stack Engineer
description_html: We’re looking for a Staff Full Stack Engineer to help define the future of our B2B SaaS platform, not just by building software, but by fundamentally improving how software gets built through AI-assisted engineering. This is a highly technical, high-ownership role for someone who operates comfortably across the stack, moves quickly from idea to production, and embraces modern AI tooling as a force multiplier for engineering velocity, product quality, and decision-making. You’ll architect systems, ship customer-facing experiences, mentor engineers, and help shape a culture where AI-native development workflows are the standard, not the exception.

title: Staff Product Analyst
description_html: We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Staff Product Analyst to join our growing team. You will… 🔍 Conduct in-depth analysis of product performance metrics, user behavior, and other key data points to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement. 📊 Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that track product KPIs, providing clear and actionable insights to stakeholders. 🎯 Design, implement, and analyze A/B tests to measure the impact of new features, product changes, and other experiments. 🤝 Work closely with product managers, engineers, and marketing teams to ensure that data-driven insights are integrated into product development and strategy.

title: Staff Product Manager
description_html: We’re looking for a strategic and driven Staff Product Manager to shape the vision, roadmap, and execution of our next-generation products. In this role, you’ll partner cross-functionally with design, engineering, and business stakeholders to bring impactful ideas to life, from concept to launch and beyond. What You’ll Do 📈 Define and own the product strategy and roadmap , aligning with company goals, customer insights, and market opportunities. 🔄 Lead the full product lifecycle from discovery and definition through delivery, iteration, and scale. 🤝 Collaborate closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to ensure smooth execution and alignment on priorities.

title: Staff Security Engineer
description_html: We’re looking for a Staff Security Engineer to help scale and mature security across our platform, infrastructure, and development workflows. This role will partner closely with engineering, infrastructure, and product teams to embed security into how we build and operate software. You’ll combine deep technical expertise with strategic thinking—identifying risk, designing scalable security solutions, and building programs that improve both security posture and engineering efficiency. You Will… 🛡️ Lead security architecture and design reviews across applications, infrastructure, and integrations to ensure secure patterns are embedded early in the development lifecycle.

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
description_html: As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer , you'll define the standards, patterns, and platforms that let every engineering team at Assured run their services reliably — and partner directly with the teams adopting them. Some of the Problems You'll Solve: 🎯 Define what reliability means across a growing engineering organization. Set the standards, patterns, and reference implementations teams adopt for SLOs, error budgets, instrumentation, alerting, and incident practice — and make them easy enough to adopt that teams actually do. 📊 Measure reliability the way customers experience it.

title: Staff Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
description_html: As a Staff SDET , you’ll be embedded within a product engineering pod, working day to day alongside its engineers and product partners. You’ll build automated testing and evaluation systems for traditional software and AI-powered products using TypeScript, modern test automation, and emerging AI evaluation techniques. Some of the Problems You'll Solve: 🤖 Evaluate AI systems that don’t produce the same result twice. Build evaluation frameworks for LLM and agentic applications using statistical QA, LLM-as-a-judge techniques, trace evaluations, and human-in-the-loop annotations. 🧠 Create test suites that become smarter over time. Explore self-healing automation and use LLMs to generate, execute, diagnose, and maintain tests as applications evolve.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Platform
description_html: As a Staff Software Engineer, Platform , you will play a critical role owning and evolving the strategy, architecture, and governance of our release and configuration systems across all environments. You’ll be a senior individual contributor on the Platform Engineering team, focused on the critical layer between CI systems and production. You’ll build the tooling, workflows, and safeguards that make releases reliable, scalable, and easy for every engineering team. This is a role for engineers who like to solve real-world complexity with well-designed systems—and who measure success by how much easier they make it for others to ship software.

title: Technical Program Manager
description_html: Some of the Problems You'll Solve: 🔗 Bridge the gap between what Sales promised and what Eng can build. Sit between Client Engagement and Engineering to translate carrier requirements into scoped, sequenced work — surfacing conflicts early instead of letting them surface in a status meeting three weeks before launch. 🚀 Drive new carrier launches from kickoff to go-live. Own the cross-functional plan for onboarding a new carrier — dependencies, timelines, risk, and the dozens of small decisions that determine whether launch day is calm or chaotic. 📋 Build the product ops muscle that doesn't exist yet.

title: VP, Integrated Marketing
description_html: We are looking for a Vice President, Integrated Marketing to build the system and run the always-on growth engine in the named-account program in top US P&C carriers. You own how we get the story in front of the right people – at the company level and at the person level – and you own the relationship between marketing and sales. This is a hands-on leadership role with two complementary motions under it: Person-Based Marketing (winning the specific buyers and users – CCOs, CIOs, CAIOs, claims VPs, transformation leads, and key influencers – at the individual level) and Web / Digital / Events (building category gravity and multi-touch presence across the moments that matter).

title: VP, Product Marketing
description_html: We are looking for a Vice President, Product Marketing to own the story and our GTM strategy. Assured is the leading Agentic Claims Orchestration platform selling to the biggest P&C carriers that own roughly 98% of the nation’s claims volume. Your job is to make our value proposition legible, credible, and unmistakable to a Chief Claims Officer and appealing to the CIO/Chief AI Officer who is contemplating “build vs. buy”. Equally, you will be tasked with building the GTM plan that compounds that advantage across new logos and deeper penetration of existing ones while collaborating with our Product organization on what our “better together” AI roadmap looks like. This is a builder’s role.

title: Account Director, Media
description_html: About the Team OpenAI's Go-To-Market team helps organizations understand, adopt, and scale the use of advanced AI across their businesses. Our team brings together Sales, Solutions, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships, and other cross-functional leaders to support customers in deploying AI responsibly and delivering meaningful business outcomes. About the Role As an Account Director focused on Media, you will lead relationships with a select portfolio of the largest and most strategically important media, entertainment, publishing, streaming, and digital content companies.

title: Art Director
description_html: About the Team OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood, as it leaves the lab and meets the world. This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told, in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning.

title: B2B Marketing Lead, India
description_html: About the Role We are seeking an experienced and versatile India Business Marketing Lead to drive OpenAI’s enterprise and B2B marketing strategy in India. This is a critical leadership role for a full-stack B2B marketer with strong India market judgment—someone who can operate across enterprise, startup, developer, and partner audiences, build foundational capabilities, and deliver high-impact programs that support revenue growth and long-term trust. This role will be responsible for shaping and executing integrated B2B marketing initiatives that support enterprise adoption, partner-led growth, startups, and developer-adjacent business audiences in India.

title: Clean Energy and New Technology Lead
description_html: About the Team OpenAI, in close collaboration with our capital partners, is embarking on a journey to build the world’s most advanced AI infrastructure ecosystem. The Industrial Compute team is central to this mission, setting the core infra strategy and implementing this vision. From site selection to the buildout process, this team sits at the intersection of commercial, technical, strategy, and operations, interacting with teams and executives inside and outside of OpenAI. About the Role The Clean Energy and New Technology Lead will own infrastructure clean energy and emerging energy technology strategy and execution, identifying and deploying scalable solutions that enable resilient, low-carbon compute and data center growth.

title: Client Partner - Media & Entertainment, Ads Solutions (Los Angeles, CA)
description_html: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the Sales team partners closely with customers to deeply understand their businesses and needs, helping inform the development of products and solutions that drive meaningful revenue growth and long-term success on the platform—while maintaining strong standards for user trust and platform integrity. About the Role As a Client Partner, Media & Entertainment , you will be responsible for driving new and expanded advertising revenue across some of the world's leading media, streaming, entertainment, gaming, and content companies.

title: Community Engagement Lead - Ohio
description_html: About the Team OpenAI, in close collaboration with our capital partners, is embarking on a journey to build the world’s most advanced AI infrastructure ecosystem. The Industrial Compute team is central to this mission, setting the core infra strategy and implementing this vision. About the Role The Community Engagement Lead will be the primary bridge between OpenAI and the communities in Ohio.

title: Data Center Compute, OpenHouse Savannah 2026
description_html: About the Team OpenAI’s Compute organization turns ambitious AI research into real-world capability by delivering the compute infrastructure behind our most advanced models. The team works across software, hardware, facilities, operations, and engineering disciplines to make enormous amounts of compute available, reliable, and efficient. As the demand for frontier AI grows, so does the complexity of the systems required to support it. Scaling this infrastructure means solving problems that cut across distributed systems, ML infrastructure, GPU fleets, power, cooling, networking, manufacturing, supply chain, and data center delivery.

title: Data Scientist, Cybersecurity
description_html: About the Team OpenAI’s Agentic Data Science team helps shape how AI agents are built, deployed, and improved across our products. We partner with product, engineering, research, and security teams to define meaningful measures of success, understand how our systems behave in the real world, and translate evidence into better decisions. As AI agents become more capable, they can write and execute code, access sensitive systems, and complete increasingly complex tasks with greater autonomy. These capabilities create powerful opportunities to improve cybersecurity, but they also introduce risks that traditional security tools and processes were not designed to address.
location: US - Remote · New York City · San Francisco

title: Hardware Platform Security Architect
description_html: About the Team Security is at the foundation of OpenAI’s mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Security team protects OpenAI’s technology, people, and products. We are technical in what we build but are operational in how we do our work, and are committed to supporting all products and research at OpenAI. Our Security team tenets include: prioritizing for impact, enabling researchers, preparing for future transformative technologies, and engaging a robust security culture. About the Role Trusted Computing and Cryptography is a core security team at OpenAI focused on deploying high-performance cryptography at scale, secure key management, and trusted hardware enclaves—from boot measurements to GPU confidential computation.

The Site Readiness & Development team owns the upstream diligence and development work required to convert powered-land opportunities into executable infrastructure options. About the Role Responsible for validating that proposed sites are buildable, compliant, and cost-effective. You will lead diligence across civil, geotechnical, environmental, and entitlement dimensions, identifying risks and driving mitigation strategies. Key Responsibilities Lead all technical diligence: geotech, soils, title/ALTA surveys, mineral rights, and access. Oversee permitting/entitlement path and schedule governance with agencies. Evaluate generator air permits, wetlands, floodplain, and stormwater constraints.

title: Partner AI Deployment Engineer - AWS
description_html: About the team The AI Deployment Engineering team ensures the safe and effective deployment of Generative AI applications for developers and enterprises. We serve as trusted technical advisors, helping customers and partners move from early experimentation to production-scale AI systems. As a Partner AI Deployment Engineer focused on AWS, you will operate at the center of one of our most strategic partnerships, driving joint customer success and enabling AWS and partner ecosystems to scale adoption of OpenAI-powered solutions. About the role We are looking for a highly experienced technical leader to serve as the primary technical counterpart to AWS field leadership (Solutions Architects, Specialists, and Partner teams).

title: Policy and Partnerships Lead CEE and Baltics, Global Affairs
description_html: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. Achieving this requires effective engagement with policymakers and the broader communities impacted by AI. Our Global Affairs team builds authentic, collaborative relationships with public officials and the wider AI policymaking community. We work to ensure that insights from policymakers and external stakeholders inform OpenAI’s work and, in collaboration with colleagues across the organization, support the development of thoughtful regulation, industry standards, and the safe and beneficial development of AI.

title: Power Trading Lead
description_html: About the Team OpenAI, in close collaboration with our capital partners, is building the world’s most advanced AI infrastructure ecosystem. The Power & Land team owns the energy strategy required to secure reliable, scalable, and economically resilient power for OpenAI’s global data center portfolio. About the Role The Power Trading Lead will own commodity hedging strategy and execution across OpenAI’s data center power portfolio. This role will translate large, dynamic electricity and fuel exposures into practical hedging, procurement, and risk-management strategies that protect infrastructure economics while preserving flexibility for growth. This is an individual contributor lead role and does not have direct reports initially.

title: Powered Land Developer, Development & Power Projects

The team partners closely with product, engineering, research, marketing, finance, legal, and operations to design and deliver partnerships that scale OpenAI’s presence and relevance across diverse markets. Our focus is on establishing long-term strategic partners and driving sustainable growth through integrated, high-impact product experiences across consumer and B2B offerings in the region.

title: Senior Support Specialist, Ads
description_html: About the Team OpenAI’s User Operations team ensures that our customers' experience is nothing short of exceptional. We resolve complex issues, provide guidance, and support customers in maximizing value with our products. Within User Operations, Ads Safety Operations helps OpenAI grow advertising in a way that is safe, trusted, and sustainable for advertisers, users and the business. The Ads Safety Support team sits within Ads Safety Operations and owns the advertiser-facing support journey: helping advertisers navigate ads products, policies, reviews, and enforcement decisions while turning frontline insights into better guidance, tooling, and product experiences.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Security
description_html: About the Team OpenAI builds powerful AI systems like ChatGPT, the OpenAI API, and enterprise products that serve millions of users across the globe. As we scale, securing our infrastructure, protecting sensitive data, and meeting global compliance standards are essential to our success and societal impact. Security at OpenAI is a cross-cutting function that spans infrastructure, applied engineering, legal, policy, and product. Technical Program Managers (TPMs) play a critical leadership role in aligning teams and delivering execution at scale and this role will be foundational in shaping how we secure OpenAI’s systems, users, and commitments.
location: US - Remote · New York City · Seattle · Washington, DC · San Francisco

title: Technical Threat Investigator, Threat Intel Engineering
description_html: About the Team Security is at the foundation of OpenAI’s mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Threat Intelligence team protects OpenAI’s technology, people, research, and infrastructure by proactively identifying and disrupting adversaries who seek to compromise our systems or misuse our models. We investigate sophisticated threats, build tooling to scale and augment analysis, and deliver intelligence that shapes security strategy and equips leadership with timely, risk-aware insights. We combine technical depth, investigative rigor, and strong cross-functional partnerships to uncover threats and drive impact across OpenAI’s security and research organizations.
location: San Francisco · New York City · US - Remote

title: Chief of Staff, Engineering (Remote)
description_html: As Rula enters a pivotal phase of growth, our Engineering organization is expanding and scaling rapidly this year. To guide this evolution, we are hiring a Chief of Staff to serve as a senior organizational leader and strategic partner to the Head of Engineering and the Engineering Leadership Team. In this role, you will help shape how Engineering operates, makes decisions, and executes against our most critical goals. Rather than leading through formal authority, you will drive impact through influence, collaboration, and sharp organizational insight. You will own key operational rhythms, while tackling ambiguous challenges, diagnosing friction, and designing actionable plans for cross-functional execution.

title: Compliance Manager (Remote)
description_html: We are seeking a collaborative, detail-oriented compliance professional to strengthen our Compliance program through oversight of medical records operations and external audit coordination. Reporting to the Director of Compliance, the Compliance Manager will lead day-to-day medical records activities, oversee vendor and team performance, and manage external audits from intake through findings and remediation closure. This role will partner closely with Legal, Privacy, Clinical, Financial Operations, Partnerships, and other business stakeholders to ensure regulatory requirements are translated into practical, sustainable processes. The ideal candidate is analytical, solutions-oriented, and experienced in healthcare compliance, privacy, records management, and audit oversight.

title: Director of B2B Employer Marketing (Remote)
description_html: We are seeking a Director of B2B Employer Marketing to lead Rula’s Activation Marketing team from a content-production focus to an intelligence-gathering and multiplier engine. This dynamic leader will be responsible for driving patient starts from commercial referral channels by building scalable systems and repeatable playbooks. You will apply advanced data-driven strategies and deploy MarTech architecture to ensure the team is tracking towards every marketing event being tagged, measured, and automated for scale.

title: Director of Data Science - Patient Experience (Remote)
description_html: Day-to-day, you will lead analyses to help develop product features that address key consumer pain points, working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers and Data Engineers. You will lead a dedicated data science team tasked with analyzing business and product performance, as well as designing and conducting experiments, and contributing to product planning. This role sits at the heart of our mission; your work will directly impact hundreds of thousands of people by helping them access the care they need and stay with it long enough to truly get better. This is a player-coach role, where we expect you to both guide analysts’ work as well as drive your own projects Required Qualifications 10+ years of related professional experience.

title: Director of Organic Growth - SEO | AEO | CRO (Remote)
description_html: Rula is fundamentally transforming mental healthcare access by seamlessly bridging the gap between quality care and insurance coverage. As Director of Organic Growth, you will steward the primary gateway to our ecosystem: our organic channels. Reporting to the Head of Brand & Integrated Marketing and serving as a key member of the Brand Leadership Team, you will architect the vision, multi-year roadmap, and bottom-line revenue impact across organic search, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) as a cohesive growth engine. We are navigating a generational paradigm shift from legacy SEO to AI-mediated discovery—including LLMs, AI Overviews, and conversational search environments.

title: Director of Partnerships - Consultants & Health Plans (Remote)
description_html: As the Director of Partnerships - Consultants & Health Plans, you are the engine behind Rula’s B2B growth. You’ll build high-trust partnerships across top benefit consultants and health plan sales teams to fuel our Middle Market and National Accounts pipeline. Leading discussions end-to-end, you will navigate self-funded and fully insured dynamics to challenge status-quo thinking and position Rula as the premier behavioral health solution. We’re seeking a high-energy, consultative seller with a background in healthcare sales and high-growth digital mental health. You excel at translating complex value propositions, from quick elevator pitches to deep dives on claims economics, backed by strong CRM discipline and a West Coast presence (or deep regional network).

title: Director of Revenue Strategy & Planning (Remote)
description_html: We’re hiring a Director of Revenue Strategy & Planning to own the operating model for one of Rula’s core B2B business units. This role sits within Revenue Operations and partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Finance. You’ll design how we grow: building the plan, modeling targets and capacity, defining the sales funnel, and turning performance data into clear decisions about where to focus. In practice, that means helping us move a promising B2B motion from “growth” to “scale” by sharpening ICP, improving economics, and making sure the team has a plan they trust and can execute against.

title: People Operations Specialist (Remote)
description_html: We are seeking a People Operations Associate to enable Rula’s People team by delivering a seamless, organized experience across operational elements of the employee lifecycle. Powered by AI and other tools in our tech stack, this role will execute essential workflows, including onboarding, HRIS data management, and front-line employee support. Our team works to make processes clear, compliant, and efficient through scalable operations and actionable data insights. The People Ops Associate will help eliminate friction while supporting high-impact operations in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Required Qualifications 2+ years of related experience in an HR, people operations, or operations function.

title: Principal AI Engineer - Personalization and Recommendation (Remote)
description_html: At Rula, this role owns the applied AI and ML solutions that determine what, how, and how well AI shows up across mental healthcare. The focus isn’t on isolated prototypes, but on building production-grade AI systems that directly power patient-provider matching, clinical workflows, and patient engagement. While your immediate focus will be driving search ranking, relevance, and patient-provider matching, your broader scope encompasses our overarching personalization and recommendation strategies, alongside directing the foundational ML platforms that support them at scale. You’ll operate where applied research, system architecture, and real-world clinical constraints meet.

title: Psychiatric Quality Specialist (Remote)
description_html: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) with a passion for clinical excellence, provider coaching, and quality improvement. In this role, you’ll balance direct patient care with cultivating strong, supportive relationships across our 1099 psychiatric network. The ideal candidate brings exceptional organizational skills, clear communication, sound clinical judgment, and an enthusiastic approach to peer outreach. This is a full-time W-2 position (5 days/8 hrs per week) reporting directly to the Associate National Medical Director. Required Qualifications Active, unrestricted PMHNP license in California with an active CA DEA registration. Current Board Certification as a PMHNP (ANCC or AANP).

title: Salesforce Architect (Remote)
description_html: We are hiring a Salesforce Architect to support the team that builds the systems behind how Rula connects people to mental health care. You will design how information about patients, clinicians, and insurance moves between Salesforce and the tools our operations teams rely on — working directly with the people who use those systems, and building some of the hardest parts yourself. The team is small enough that your decisions are visible and lasting, and the work is close to the outcome: patients matched to a therapist sooner, clinicians licensed and seeing patients faster, and care teams spending their time on people rather than on software.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer (Remote)
description_html: The Provider group is embarking on a critical phase of growth and technical modernization. To guide this evolution, we are hiring a Sr. Staff Software Engineer to serve as the overarching Technical Individual Contributor Leader for the entire Provider organization. This role requires a unique combination of deep technical expertise, architectural foresight, and cross-functional leadership. Operating as a strategic partner to the Senior Director, the incumbent will be responsible for setting the technical roadmap, establishing engineering standards, and driving high-impact initiatives that span all teams within the Provider domain. Required Qualifications 10+ years of related professional experience.

title: Software Engineer 2 - RCM (Remote)
description_html: We are hiring a Software Engineer to enable Rula’s Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) team through the development of scalable platforms, services, and internal tooling that power critical business operations. This person will be responsible for building and maintaining systems that support payments, claims submission, and operational workflows across the revenue cycle. This person will apply strong software engineering fundamentals, product thinking, and a continuous improvement mindset to solve complex operational challenges. You will be working closely with engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to improve efficiency, reliability, and cost effectiveness across one of Rula’s most important business functions.

title: Sr. Account Management Associate (Remote)
description_html: We're seeking a Sr. Account Management Associate to own the onboarding and ongoing success of employers with fewer than 3,000 employees. In this role, you'll help employers launch quickly, navigate our Employer Portal, and access the tools and resources they need to successfully promote their Rula benefit. You'll serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of employers, ensuring they have a seamless experience from onboarding through long-term engagement. You'll partner closely with Broker Partnerships, Marketing, Product, and Operations to deliver customized communications, support employer campaigns, answer questions, and identify opportunities to increase awareness and utilization of the Rula benefit.

title: Sr. Brand Media Manager (Remote)
description_html: As the Sr. Brand Media Manager, you will own the strategic roadmap for our brand media allocation, audience targeting, and measurement framework. Reporting directly to the Director of Patient Marketing, you will bridge the gap between upper-funnel brand building and lower-funnel action, ensuring our investment drives both top-of-mind Awareness and tangible Patient Starts. This is a high-visibility role requiring a blend of top-tier media planning expertise, sharp analytical acumen, and the communication skills necessary to interface regularly with our C-suite. You will act as the key connective tissue between our external agency partners and our internal Brand, Analytics, Performance Marketing, and Finance teams.

title: Sr. Clinic Launch Associate (West Coast)
description_html: Rula is seeking a Sr. Clinic Launch Associate to help open and operate physical clinics where therapists can meet patients in person. As part of our In-Person Therapy team, you will spend most of your time in the field preparing new spaces, supporting therapists, coordinating vendors, and resolving day-to-day operational issues. You will work with a collaborative team that values practical problem-solving, clear communication, and learning from each new launch. This is an opportunity to shape how Rula’s clinics operate and build repeatable processes that support expansion across the country.

title: Sr. Data Engineer (Remote)
description_html: This role will enable analytics teams at Rula to leverage AI against internal data in a secure and compliant manner. As an individual contributor, you will partner with analytics, marketing, and product teams to understand their data needs and build the systems that allow AI applications to access trusted data at scale. You will help define the standards, infrastructure, and governance that power AI-driven experiences across the company, ensuring data remains reliable, secure, and easy to use. This role will have a direct impact on how Rula uses AI to improve decision-making and operational efficiency. Required Qualifications 4+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or a related field, including ownership of production data pipelines and systems.

title: Sr. EAP Operations Associate (Remote)
description_html: Rula is seeking a Sr. EAP Operations Associate to join our Financial Operations team. Reporting to the Payment Application and Credit Manager, this role partners with internal teams and external EAP partners to support accurate billing, payment processing, and reconciliation. You will independently manage partner billing cycles, prepare and submit billing files, review remittances and payment feedback, investigate discrepancies, and collaborate across teams to resolve billing and payment issues. You will also identify opportunities to improve workflows, support automation and process initiatives, and help scale billing processes as new EAP partners are onboarded.

title: Sr. Finance Manager - Deal Desk (Remote)
description_html: We’re seeking a Sr. Finance Manager - Deal Desk to guide how Rula grows. As an individual contributor, you’ll partner closely with our Sales, Marketing, and Revenue Operations teams to shape growth strategy, evaluate trade-offs, and develop strategic forecasting of complex deals. You’ll be responsible to turn complex financial data into clear, actionable insights, while balancing short-term efficiency with long-term impact. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, navigating ambiguity, and shaping strategic decisions.

title: Sr. Financial Operations Insights Associate (Remote)
description_html: At Rula, our Financial Operations team plays a key role in making sure providers can focus on care while we keep the business running smoothly. As a Sr. Financial Operations Insights Associate, you’ll focus on building the automated workflows and reporting that keep our day-to-day operations running efficiently. You’ll collaborate directly with team experts to spot bottlenecks, untangle manual processes, and design smarter, more reliable ways of working. If you love making complex workflows run smoothly and want your efforts to directly support our mission of expanding access to mental healthcare, this role will be especially rewarding. Scope of the Role You will develop deep foundational knowledge of our financial operations and apply it independently to assigned projects.

title: Sr. Healthcare Partnerships Associate (Mid-Atlantic)
description_html: We are seeking a Sr. Healthcare Partnerships Associate who thrives in ambiguity and draws energy from building the relationships that drive our mission forward. In this role, you are directly responsible for the growth of “sold” providers and the subsequent patient demand and starts within your territory. This is a high-velocity, "boots-on-the-ground" sales position requiring you to be in the field at least three days per week. You will own the full sales cycle—utilizing provided lead lists to drive aggressive outbound sourcing, consulting, and closing providers.

title: Sr. Legal Counsel (Remote)
description_html: We are seeking a Senior Legal Counsel to help Rula navigate the complex intersection of healthcare regulation and commercial growth. In this role, you will support our payor and clinical contracting efforts, serving as a trusted partner to our business teams as we build scalable, compliant partnerships and ensure quality services are delivered. You will also tackle nuanced regulatory challenges—such as corporate practice of medicine; fraud and abuse; telehealth; scope of practice; state AI laws—transforming complexity into clear, actionable advice that proactively mitigates risks to the business, supports our daily operations, and achieves business objectives and goals.

title: Sr. Mobile Engineer (Remote)
description_html: We are hiring a Senior Mobile Engineer to help build and scale Rula’s patient-facing mobile applications. You'll own the end-to-end delivery of impactful features across iOS and Android using React Native, partnering closely with Product, Design, and backend engineers to create intuitive, reliable experiences that make mental health care more accessible. You'll help evolve our mobile architecture, improve engineering quality through testing and performance optimizations, and mentor teammates while contributing to the long-term success of our mobile platform. Required Qualifications 5+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years building production mobile applications. 3+ years of experience with React Native, TypeScript, and modern React development.

title: Sr. Paid Search Specialist (Remote)
description_html: We are hiring a Sr. Paid Search Specialist to support the day-to-day execution of Rula's Paid Search program - One of the largest in the mental health space, across our Therapy and Psychiatry service lines. Reporting to the Director of Patient Performance Marketing and working alongside the Sr. Paid Search Manager, you will be a key operator of a program that optimizes for patient Starts and lifetime value, and your work will directly determine how many people can access mental health care through Rula. You will partner closely with Analytics, Finance, and Brand to build a program that is both technically sophisticated and deeply mission-aligned.

title: Sr. Product Designer (Remote)
description_html: We're seeking a Sr. Product Designer to join Rula's Provider Team—a group dedicated to helping providers deliver exceptional mental health care. You'll design the tools therapists use every day, streamlining administrative work and building intelligent experiences that help them make informed clinical decisions, focusing on what matters most: their patients. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys taking 0→1 products from concept to execution, and brings a high level of ownership to every stage of the design process.

title: Sr. Product Manager - Core Experience (Remote)
description_html: We’re hiring a Senior/Staff Product Manager to lead the core experience at Rula; focused on making it easier for people to find, start, and stay engaged with high-quality mental health care. Day-to-day, you’ll dig into data to understand consumer pain points, and collaborate with user researchers, analysts, and data scientists to uncover what drives stronger engagement and better outcomes. You’ll lead a dedicated engineering team to design, launch, and measure improvements that make a real difference in patients’ lives. This role sits at the heart of our mission; your work will directly impact thousands of people by helping them access the care they need and stay with it long enough to truly get better.

title: Sr. Product Manager - Provider Experience (Remote)
description_html: We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Provider Experience team at Rula. Our goal is simple: help therapists succeed so they can run a healthy practice and give great care to their patients. In this role, your focus is to help therapists focus entirely on their patients by building and improving the tools they use every day. You will lead initiatives around automating day-to-day administrative workflows using AI (like clinical note writing, client scheduling, and paperwork) and developing real-time clinical guidance tools during sessions. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Product (Provider) and working cross-functionally with design, engineering, and clinical teams, you will make a direct impact by giving therapists hours of their week back.

title: Sr. Revenue Strategy & Planning Manager (Remote)
description_html: We are hiring a Sr. Revenue Strategy & Planning Manager to help bring clarity, structure, and insight to Rula’s B2B growth motions. In this role, you’ll work closely with Sales leaders and Revenue Operations to identify areas for improvement, build dashboards, analyze funnel performance, forecast revenue growth, and support planning cadences. You’ll spend your time in spreadsheets, CRM data, and business reviews.

title: Sr. Software Engineer - Patient Services (Remote)
description_html: At Rula, exceptional patient outcomes are powered by world-class engineering. As a Senior Software Engineer on our Patient Services team, you won’t just maintain existing systems—you will architect the high-throughput, distributed platform that serves as the single source of truth for all patient data across Rula. We are currently undergoing a period of hyper-scale, and you will lead the technical strategy for one of our highest-impact initiatives: re-engineering our core backend data systems to be massively scalable, resilient, and fault-tolerant. In this critical role, you will tackle complex distributed systems challenges where system performance, uptime, and data integrity directly impact real human lives seeking mental healthcare.

title: Sr. Software Engineer - Provider Access (Remote)
description_html: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join Rula’s Provider Growth, Acquisition & Supply Management team. Our goal is to ensure that Rula has the right providers to meet patient demand. Access to care is fundamentally a supply problem, and our team is here to solve that by driving meaningful impact on how providers find Rula, onboard, and build sustainable and flexible practices on our platform. Our work sits at the intersection of provider experience and marketplace dynamics, increasing supply where it matters and reducing friction in how providers deliver care – so patients can find help quickly.

title: Sr. Staff AI Engineer - Applied AI (Remote)
description_html: At Rula, this role owns the AI foundation that determines how, and how well, AI shows up across mental healthcare. The focus isn’t on prototypes or isolated features, but on building durable, production-grade generative AI systems that directly power patient engagement, provider workflows, and clinical operations at scale. You’ll operate where architecture, applied research, and real-world constraints meet. The work includes designing core AI platforms, setting technical standards for safety, reliability, and performance, and making principald decisions about how advanced AI is introduced into a regulated, high-stakes care environment. The goal is simple but hard: make AI genuinely useful in clinical contexts, without compromising trust or outcomes.

You'll be responsible for turning complex financial data into clear, actionable insights, while balancing short-term efficiency with long-term impact. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, navigating ambiguity, and shaping strategic decisions.

Some example projects may include: define the path to 5x’ing the business over the next 3 years; research, scope, and pilot new service launches or business lines; deep-dive into patient and payor LTVs to improve the businesses unit economics.

They will define where AI can create the greatest patient value, identify the needs and moments it should address, and ensure these experiences are trustworthy, clinically appropriate, and complementary to provider-led care.

title: Senior Manager, FP&A
description_html: About the Role: We are looking for a Senior Manager, FP&A to be the finance business partner to our Corporate or GTM organization. You will own the overall or GTM P&Ls and build the driver-based models behind some of the most consequential questions in SaaS finance today: what is the right plan, where we should invest, and make course corrections. You will partner directly with our Senior Leadership Team on investment decisions, headcount, and unit economics, and manage and develop a Senior Financial Analyst. You will join our global Finance team, report to the VP of FP&A, and work alongside the other FP&A leads - with scope that will grow as Camunda does.

title: Senior Manager, QA Engineering
description_html: About the Role: Camunda is hiring a Senior Manager, QA Engineering to lead the end-to-end QA strategy for Camunda 8 — elevating quality governance with rigorous quality gates, outcome-driven automation, and strategic reporting that guides roadmap and release decisions. They will manage two teams (functional and reliability) comprising 12 ICs, a principal engineer, and a manager; evolve the structure for scale; and ensure comprehensive coverage across business users, developers, and admins/operators in Kubernetes, cloud, and bare-metal environments. This first-of-its-kind role reports directly to the VP of Engineering. What you'll be doing: Own and drive the end-to-end QA strategy for Camunda 8, establishing quality gates and cross-team accountability.

This is a high-ownership role inside our Products organization for someone who can independently take a vague problem, define what success looks like, and turn it into a shipped outcome - working directly with customers and forward deployed engineers, and building in an AI-first environment. The role will start with a strong focus on the web app experience in Hub and Canvas (Web Modeler & Desktop Modeler), while also offering the opportunity over time to contribute across the stack where that enables faster end-to-end product delivery.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
description_html: About the role: If you’re passionate about pushing the limits of reliability, fault-tolerance, and operational excellence in complex distributed systems, Camunda offers the perfect stage. As a Senior Software Engineer, Backend, you’ll take ownership of automated reliability testing and chaos engineering at the core of Camunda 8. This role thrives on curiosity, experimentation, and relentless improvement—you’ll break things (on purpose!) in safe environments to strengthen our platform before customers ever feel the impact. Here, you’ll make a measurable impact and guide product direction, all while learning new technologies and collaborating with talented, friendly colleagues who live our FAITH values (Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent, and Humor).

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Core/API & Process Automation
description_html: About the role: Backend engineering rarely gets this consequential. As a Senior Software Engineer on Camunda's Core / API & Process Automation team, you'll work on the beating heart of Camunda 8 — the event-sourced, distributed workflow engine that executes business-critical processes for thousands of customers and, through them, millions of people worldwide. Because you sit at the core, one well-made improvement propagates outward through every integration and product built on top of it: a small change here is felt everywhere. Few systems demand this. You'll squeeze the last drops of performance out of the hot paths. You'll design maintainability and versioning strategies for an engine that must faithfully replay every event it has ever written — forever.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Data Layer
description_html: About the role: As a Backend Senior Software Engineer on the Data Layer team, you'll help build and evolve the storage and query layer that keeps Camunda 8's process data fast, accurate, and available at scale. Spanning both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, the data layer and its data pipelines power everything from process monitoring to the new agent-driven automation capabilities we're rolling out. As part of the Data Layer team, you will work on both technically challenging and rewarding projects, such as reshaping how we store and retain process data, streaming data to external systems, and evolving our secondary storage systems to perform at ever greater scale. At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Data Streaming
description_html: About the role: As a Senior Software Engineer on Camunda's new Data Streaming team, you'll help build a foundational new piece of architecture that changes how customers and internal products access process data. Today, customers have no first-class way to stream their own process data out of Camunda into their own systems. You'll be part of a greenfield team building a durable, continuously-written streaming layer that decouples data consumption entirely from the live engine. You'll be part of a small team from day one, responsible not only for the streaming architecture itself, but also the analytics product and other data consumers built on top of it - with real room to shape both the architecture and the team's scope as it matures.

title: Software Engineer - Infrastructure
description_html: About the role: At Camunda, our CI/CD infrastructure platform is treated as an internal product. Our mission is to build a platform that offers a Golden Path, enabling 150+ engineers across 20+ teams to deliver with world-class velocity and uncompromising quality at scale, that will allow Camunda engineers to focus on building the agentic technologies that will define our market leadership. We are approaching a pivotal phase: an upcoming quality surge that will significantly increase testing volume and engineering throughput. Our platform must scale seamlessly, without increasing developer toil. As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will be at the core of this transformation: designing, implementing, and running the CI/CD and artifact delivery systems.

title: Technical Writer
description_html: About the role: As a Technical Writer at Camunda, you'll be embedded within product teams, taking full ownership of documentation for key areas of our platform. You'll work side-by-side with engineers, product managers, and designers to ensure our documentation is clear, accurate, and closely aligned with the product experience. This is a hands-on role where you'll become a subject matter expert, directly shaping the developer journey through high-impact content across the Camunda platform. Beyond content, you'll help maintain and configure the infrastructure that keeps our documentation running smoothly. We're looking for someone who can unblock themselves and the team when something breaks.

title: AI Enablement Engineer
description_html: Coder is looking for an AI Enablement Engineer to help execute our Smart AI roadmap and make AI and vibe coding easier across the company. You’ll work directly with employees to understand what they’re trying to build, answer questions about Smart AI best practices, and remove the technical or process barriers getting in their way. You’ll also turn those needs into shipped improvements. That means building and refining Smart AI journeys, reusable skills, paved paths, and infrastructure enhancements, while partnering closely with the Smart AI Program lead on roadmap execution. You’ll also teach through office hours and sessions, but most of your time will be spent listening, building, troubleshooting, and improving the system around our internal AI community.

title: Senior Partner Deployed Engineer
description_html: The Role We are looking for a Senior Partner Deployed Engineer to join the Customer Solutions team, focused on building Coder’s partner ecosystem across EMEA. This is a new function at Coder, modeled on the Forward Deployed Engineer role pioneered by companies like Palantir and now the fastest-growing technical role at frontier AI companies. The difference: instead of embedding with a single customer to deploy a platform, you embed with strategic partners to help them understand, position, and deliver Coder’s platform across their entire customer base. You are part Field CTO, part Industry Strategist, part Technical Specialist, and part Partner Relations Lead.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Agentic Engineering, Europe)
description_html: As a Senior Software Engineer on Coder’s Engineering team, you’ll build and evolve the systems behind our agentic development experience. You’ll work across the agent harness, integrations, and workflows that connect agents with real development environments. You’ll stay hands-on, solve complex technical problems, and work closely with Product, Design, and other engineers to ship reliable agentic experiences. What you’ll do here Design and build production systems in Go, with work across React and TypeScript where needed. Improve agent execution, tool use, context management, streaming, and long-running workflows. Extend our provider-agnostic architecture as models and capabilities change. Build reliable integrations between agents, workspaces, tools, and developer infrastructure.

title: Staff Software Engineer (AI Governance)
description_html: We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help shape AI governance for developer tooling at Coder. This role sits on our AI Governance team, which builds and maintains two enterprise-grade components of Coder's AI governance stack. AI Gateway is a centralized LLM gateway that sits between coding agents and providers such as OpenAI or Anthropic, providing organizations with audit trails, token tracking, cost control, and centralized authentication. Agent Firewall wraps those agents with default-deny network policies, controlling which domains and methods they can reach inside workspaces. This team works across the full stack - from Go backend and React frontend to integrating with LLM provider APIs.
