description_html: The Opportunity: Compliance Analyst As a Compliance Analyst at Tilt, you’ll be integral to ensuring our products, processes, and customer interactions meet the highest regulatory and compliance standards. This role involves collaborating across teams and contributing to key compliance functions, including UDAAP program management, complaints management, marketing reviews, audit requests, and more. Your attention to detail, proactive approach, and analytical mind will help Tilt build trust with our customers and partners while fostering an innovative culture of compliance. Tilt is a remote-first company. We drive connectivity through regular company offsites. Travel for company offsites is expected at a minimum 2 times per year.

title: Controller
description_html: The Opportunity: Controller Tilt is looking for a Controller to lead our accounting operations and build the infrastructure to support public company readiness. Reporting to the Head of Accounting, you'll lead a team of accountants and be the operational backbone of our finance function, partnering closely with FP&A, Legal, and other stakeholders to ensure our financial house is built to last. This is a role for a hands-on leader who thrives on building — someone who wants their fingerprints on how a company scales. How You'll Make an Impact Own the Close: Lead all aspects of US accounting operations and consolidation, delivering accurate, timely financial statements in accordance with GAAP.

title: Data Science Lead, LATAM
description_html: The Opportunity: Data Science Lead, LATAM We're looking for a Lead Data Scientist to own data science across our two LATAM markets, Mexico and Brazil. Both are fast-growing businesses operating with the speed and autonomy of a startup, backed by the scale and stability of an established group. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll lead a small team of data scientists across both markets while remaining an active contributor yourself — building models, shaping technical direction, and setting the standard for how the work gets done. The two markets sit at different stages of maturity, and the role spans both. In one, you'll be establishing foundations — infrastructure, modelling standards, and a roadmap to bring capability up to the level of our other markets.
location: Remote - Americas · Remote - Brazil · Remote - Mexico

title: Finance Systems & Automation Analyst
description_html: The opportunity: Finance Systems & Automation Analyst Tilt is hiring a Finance Systems & Automation Analyst to automate the manual work in our accounting close and reporting. This role is for someone who understands accounting but would rather write the query than update the spreadsheet. You'll take recurring workflows — reconciliations, variance analysis, close schedules, audit pulls — and rebuild them as automated, documented, repeatable processes using SQL, Python, and our BI stack. You'll spend most of your time hands-on: writing queries, cleaning ERP and subledger data, building dashboards, and fixing the reports that break. Tilt is a remote-first company that fosters connectivity through regular offsites. Travel for company offsites is required at least twice per year.

title: Head of Business Intelligence
description_html: The Opportunity: Head of Business Intelligence We're hiring a leader to run Business Intelligence at Tilt end to end. BI at Tilt is a data modeling, metadata, and context-building function. We sit with teams across the business, learn how they approach their metrics and the questions they're trying to answer, look for commonality across teams, and build models that accurately describe our business. A growing part of the mandate is metadata management: every model and metric gets an AI- and human-readable description, and we maintain a living library of key metrics with reference SQL implementations the rest of the company can trust and build on. BI here is focused on models and tools, not on charts and dashboards.

title: Head of Credit, Brazil
description_html: The Opportunity: Head of Credit - Brazil Tilt is looking for an experienced analytics leader to own the Credit function for our expanding presence in Brazil. As part of our International Credit team, you will develop and iterate on risk models and credit policies that drive underwriting as a competitive advantage — and help launch innovative products that solve real customer problems. This individual will lead teams and workstreams focused on consumer behavior and needs, building solutions that ensure Tilt resiliently offers the right products. The right candidate thrives on complex challenges and leverages a diverse technical toolkit to drive impactful outcomes. This role reports to Tilt's Head of International Credit.

title: Lead Product Manager, Growth
description_html: The Opportunity: Lead Product Manager, Growth We're looking for a Lead PM to own product-led growth across our consumer app. This is not a channel-optimization or referral-tuning seat: you'll own how new and existing users discover value, move through the product, graduate to higher-value products, and adopt more of what we offer across the entire product ecosystem, not a single feature. A core part of this role is building the frameworks that decide where we route users. You'll prioritize journeys for graduation and for the highest enterprise value, and turn that into a clear, shared view of where growth effort should go.

title: Product Manager, Cash
description_html: The Opportunity: Product Manager, Cash We're hiring a Product Manager for our cash products, the fast, high-volume liquidity products at the center of the business. You'll own meaningful surfaces of products used by millions, with the room and expectation to run big pieces yourself. This is a builder's seat on a highly analytical team. You'll live in the data, work comfortably with analysis, design and read experiments, and move fast on a product where small changes compound across huge volume. We want someone self-directed enough to take an ambiguous problem, frame it, and drive it to a shipped result without a lot of hand-holding. The people who thrive here set their own direction and don't wait to be told what to work on. Analytical horsepower is the baseline.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Blipay
description_html: About Blipay Blipay is Tilt's Brazilian business unit. In Brazil, credit is still decided by a score that summarizes someone's past and ignores their present. We do it differently — using Open Finance and real-time financial signals, we look at people's actual financial lives and say yes to people the traditional market writes off too quickly. Over 1 million customers. Salary advance, FGTS, consignado. Products that put money in people's hands when they need it. The Opportunity: Senior Software Engineer, Backend You'll work close to the product here — no intermediary layer between you and the problem. You're part of the conversation about what to build, you build it, and you watch it reach production.

title: Senior Copywriter, Brand
description_html: The opportunity: Senior Copywriter, Brand This role is for a writer with a genuinely distinctive voice — someone who captures the spirit of a brand so naturally it feels like they've always been the one talking. You'll be the creative authority behind how Tilt speaks: writing brand and campaign copy across every surface, building long-form narratives that move people, and setting the standard for what great writing looks like in everything we make. You'll sit within the Creative team (part of Marketing), working closely with designers, marketers, and product partners to define, protect, and expand how Tilt shows up in language. The brand foundation is in place. Now we need the writer who makes it come alive at scale.

title: Senior Credit Manager, US Card
description_html: The Opportunity: Senior Credit Manager, US Card Tilt is looking for a Senior Credit Manager to join our Card Customer Management team, focused on Line Management. Our existing line increase programs are healthy, but there's significant untapped opportunity beyond them: recovering spend, unlocking underutilized usage, and building the next generation of line management programs. This role exists to find and build that opportunity. You'll work at the intersection of credit policy, quantitative analysis, and program design, partnering closely with Data Science and Product while independently owning the analytical work behind new program ideas — from identifying the opportunity, to designing and testing a policy, to scaling what works.

title: Senior Finance Lead, Credit Card
description_html: The Opportunity: Senior Finance Lead, Credit Card Tilt's Strategic Finance (StratFin) team is hiring a Senior Finance Lead dedicated to the Credit Card business unit. You'll be the embedded finance lead for Credit Card, owning the P&L, driving forecasting and unit economics, and acting as the primary financial thought partner to Credit Card product, credit/risk, and marketing leadership. This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to BU and executive leadership, and regular input into board-level reporting. Given the seniority of the role, you'll be expected to operate with significant autonomy and to shape strategic direction for the business, not just execute against it.

title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager, Upper Funnel
description_html: The opportunity: Senior Growth Marketing Manager, Upper Funnel As Tilt's Senior Growth Marketer focused on Upper Funnel acquisition, you will establish and lead the brand response marketing function - a strategic priority as the company prepares to make significant investment in upper-funnel channels. You will own the media strategy and execution across connected TV (CTV), YouTube, and additional top-funnel platforms, while developing robust measurement frameworks that clearly link brand investments to tangible business outcomes. This role offers a unique opportunity to define a new capability within a rapidly growing fintech company and influence how millions of people engage with Tilt. How You'll Make an Impact Own upper-funnel go-to-market media strategy.

title: Senior Manager, Strategy & Business Operations
description_html: The Opportunity: Senior Manager, Strategy & Business Operations We're looking for a Senior Manager, Strategy & Business Operations to take on Tilt's highest-stakes, least-defined problems and drive them to outcomes. You'll sit at the center of our Strategy & BizOps team and move fluidly across corporate strategy, M&A, investor relations, and cross-market business operations — going wherever the company most needs a sharp operator to find the right answer and then make it happen. This is a senior, high-autonomy role for someone who does their best work without a playbook.

title: Senior Product Designer
description_html: The Opportunity: Senior Product Designer We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to help shape the future of Tilt products. You’ll own complex, high-impact product experiences across areas such as cash management, financial wellness, transaction-related tools, and others. This is an individual contributor role for a designer who combines strong product thinking and UX fundamentals with exceptional visual and UI craft. You’ll join a collaborative design team and work closely with product managers, engineers, and other partners to turn ambiguous opportunities into thoughtful, intuitive experiences. How You'll Make an Impact Lead end-to-end design for a meaningful portion of our product ecosystem, from early exploration through launch and iteration.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
description_html: The Opportunity: Senior Software Engineer, Backend We’re looking for Senior Backend Engineers who care about building scalable, reliable systems - and who thrive in a collaborative environment. You’ll join one of several product or infrastructure teams, each tackling challenges from decisioning to payments to APIs. Wherever you land, you’ll work on projects that are high-impact, technically challenging, and deeply rewarding. Tilt is a remote-first company. We drive connectivity through regular company offsites. Travel for company offsites is expected at a minimum 2 times a year. How You’ll Make an Impact Design and scale backend systems that power our consumer facing products Build and refine APIs that deliver instant, seamless experiences.

title: Support Operations Specialist, Mexico
description_html: The Opportunity: Support Operations Specialist, MX This role sits at the center of Tilt Mexico's operations — investigating fraud and risk cases, resolving escalations frontline agents can't handle, keeping content and quality standards current, and fixing problems at the source using our backend tools. The work is deliberately broad: fraud queue in the morning, a sensitive escalation in the afternoon, a job aid update in between. We hire at two levels — Specialist owns a defined slice end-to-end with guidance; Senior Specialist takes the harder, more ambiguous cases and mentors peers. Either way, this isn't a queue-clearing role. We want someone who asks why a case landed here and does something about it.

title: AI Product Designer
description_html: Why This Role Exists We're hiring a Senior AI Product Designer who can independently own the user experience for a product area and contribute quickly. This role is built for someone who can ramp fast and start shipping without heavy onboarding. You'll own the definition of what users need and how they interact with Onebrief: partnering with Product to translate essential user goals into the interface elements and behavior that support them, and making the quality-vs-speed trade-offs that keep releases moving. You'll be the one who articulates those trade-offs clearly enough, and presents solutions confidently enough, to move the team forward.

title: Contract Manager (Strategic Contract Initiatives)
description_html: Why This Role Exist Onebrief's strategic government initiatives require experienced contract professionals who can help ensure complex contractual commitments are executed effectively throughout the life of each program. As our portfolio continues to grow, we are expanding our contracts organization to provide dedicated support to the programs that have the greatest strategic importance to the company. This role partners closely with the Senior Manager of Strategic Contract Initiatives to administer a portfolio of complex government contracts while working alongside Program Management, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and government stakeholders.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description_html: About the Role Onebrief's infrastructure team owns the platform that delivers our software to military staffs. Our charter spans Kubernetes clusters in commercial and government cloud, application streaming for thin-client users on classified networks, a unified artifact pipeline that signs and ships the same builds to every environment we operate, and air-gapped appliances at forward sites. We're hiring an Infrastructure Engineer who builds security into the systems they operate rather than treating it as a separate workstream. You'll architect, build, and run the platform end to end. This includes RFCs, PRDs, and reviewing and writing production code alongside Product and Engineering teammates.

title: Outcome Engineer - Early in Career Professional
description_html: We are also defining the future of software development. We believe the era of "human bandwidth" as the primary constraint on software delivery is ending. We are building a dedicated team to transition our organization from Software Engineering to Outcome Engineering. About The Role You’re an AI-native engineer who is living the future of software development now. You start your day checking Hugging Face, and have 3 side hustles running based on agentic apps you’ve shipped. You’re ready to bring your curiosity and willingness to quickly embrace new technologies to a team that is collectively creating Onebrief’s AI Engineering Platform.

title: Outcome Engineer - Experienced Professional
description_html: We are also defining the future of software development. We believe the era of "human bandwidth" as the primary constraint on software delivery is ending. We are building a dedicated team to transition our organization from Software Engineering to Outcome Engineering. About The Role You’re a world-class software engineer who excelled at the “old version” of software development, and are reinventing yourself right here, right now. You see the promise and pitfalls of a world unconstrained by human bandwidth, and are ready to fully embrace the super-powered creation that AI unlocks. As an Outcome Engineer at Onebrief, you’ll join the team inventing our AI Engineering Platform . This is neither just prompt building nor model development.

title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
description_html: About the Role Onebrief's infrastructure team owns the platform that delivers our software to military staffs. Our charter spans Kubernetes clusters in commercial and government cloud, application streaming for thin-client users on classified networks, a unified artifact pipeline that signs and ships the same builds to every environment we operate, and air-gapped appliances at forward sites. We're hiring an Infrastructure Engineer who builds security into the systems they operate rather than treating it as a separate workstream. You'll architect, build, and run the platform end to end. This includes RFCs, PRDs, and reviewing and writing production code alongside Product and Engineering teammates.

title: Procurement Specialist
description_html: About the Role Reporting to the Financial Operations Manager, the Procurement Specialist will support Onebrief's day-to-day procurement operations, with a first-priority mandate to clean up and standardize vendor contracts and records so Zip becomes our single source of truth. You'll operate our procurement tool and maintain accurate data flow with NetSuite. You'll also work closely with business units to keep enterprise vendor records, renewals, and compliance documentation current, and help the broader organization understand and follow procurement policy. This role is the operational backbone that keeps procurement data, process, and systems clean and reliable. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.

title: Senior Corporate Security Systems Engineer
description_html: Why This Role Exists Onebrief is growing, and the systems our employees rely on need to remain secure, resilient, and audit-ready as the company scales. We’re hiring a Corporate Systems Security Engineer to help build and operate the technical security foundations that protect our corporate environment. This is a hands-on security engineering role focused on owning and improving security across endpoints, identity, SaaS applications, browsers, Zero Trust infrastructure, and the broader corporate security stack. You’ll work at the intersection of security engineering, systems configuration, and automation—turning security requirements into technical controls that are measurable, repeatable, and difficult to drift away from. A major focus of this role is reducing manual security operations.

title: Senior Manager, Strategic Contract Initiatives
description_html: Why This Role Exist Onebrief's most strategic government initiatives require more than strong contract administration. They require experienced leadership capable of navigating complex contractual obligations while partnering closely with program managers, customer success, product, finance, and customer stakeholders to ensure successful execution. This role exists to provide contract leadership across a portfolio of the company's highest-priority initiatives, where effective communication, thoughtful risk management, and disciplined execution directly influence customer success and long-term strategic growth.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description_html: About the Role We’re looking for a Software Developer in Test to partner with our Quality Engineering team in shaping how we define and deliver quality across the organization. In this role, you’ll help enhance our release process and release integrity, software development to drive automation-first initiatives, and establish quality metrics and standards that raise the bar for how we build, test, and deliver software. You’ll think beyond traditional testing, focusing on CI/CD quality improvements, internal tooling, performance testing, and enablement initiatives that empower teams to move faster with confidence.

title: Staff Infrastructure Engineer
description_html: About the Role Onebrief's infrastructure team owns the platform that delivers our software to military staffs. Our charter spans Kubernetes clusters in commercial and government cloud, application streaming for thin-client users on classified networks, a unified artifact pipeline that signs and ships the same builds to every environment we operate, and air-gapped appliances at forward sites. We're hiring an Infrastructure Engineer who builds security into the systems they operate rather than treating it as a separate workstream. You'll architect, build, and run the platform end to end. This includes RFCs, PRDs, and reviewing and writing production code alongside Product and Engineering teammates.

title: Staff Modeling and Simulation Lead
description_html: The role Military planners need to understand what a simulation can tell them, where its assumptions hold, and where they do not. At Onebrief, you will own the models and data that make those answers defensible in AtomEngine, our cloud-based simulation engine for military planning. You will lead the technical standards and production workflows behind AtomEngine's entity catalog: how military platforms and capabilities are represented, which sources and formulas support their performance, and how that work is tested. Your judgment will shape the catalog that scenarios run on and the methods other analysts use to build it. As a Staff-level individual contributor, you will set standards and mentor other analysts.

title: Staff Outcome Designer
description_html: Design at Onebrief is capacity-constrained in a way engineering increasingly isn't. Agents have changed what's possible for production velocity, but the design team doesn't yet have the systems to ship at that same speed and scale. This role exists to build those systems. Your job isn't to design faster yourself. It's to build the platform that removes capacity as the constraint for the rest of the design team: the agentic design system platform, the tools and utilities designers rely on day to day, and the services that support design needs across the company at scale, including automated intake and evaluation, release QA, and telemetry from production environments. You're building the engine that drives the design flywheel.

title: Staff Product Manager
description_html: About the Role This is an impactful position, working closely with planners around the world, conducting thorough research to elicit requirements and translate them into effective solutions. About You You’re a “product person” who knows how to build software products. You speak the language of engineers and designers, yet you don’t rely too heavily on them to devise and evaluate solutions. Intellectual honesty, personal integrity, curiosity, and EQ shape how you work with end users and elicit non-obvious requirements. Async or IRL, you style-flex to meet your audience where they’re at, distill complexity to simplicity, and have an “owner’s mentality.” What You’ll Do You will lead product initiatives that make military staffs superhuman and bring people home safely.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Full-stack
description_html: Engineering at Onebrief Engineering at Onebrief means building systems that must perform reliably in complex, high-stakes environments where operational outcomes matter more than activity, output, or elegant theory alone. This is work for engineers who care about reliability, adaptability, observability, and building systems that succeed under real-world conditions. As AI transforms how software is built, engineering here is increasingly focused on verification, judgment, and helping teams operate more effectively at scale. You’ll likely feel energized here if you care about: meaningful technical challenges systems that operate under real-world constraints outcomes over activity and grounded teams focused on solving important problems well.

title: Account Executive
description_html: Remote, work from anywhere on a North American timezone. Competitive base plus uncapped commission. The short version We are hiring our first Account Executive. This is a foundational sales role, not a seat in a machine. You would own inbound from senior marketers around the world, close deals, and help build our outbound motion from the ground up. Uncapped commission. Real ownership from day one. Direct access to the founders. If you perform, you grow fast. About InBeat (Part of Fieldtrip) Most brands work with a handful of agencies. One for paid media, one for content, one for influencer, one for SEO. The problem is they never talk to each other. Learnings get lost. Budget gets wasted. The brand ends up doing all the coordinating. Fieldtrip fixes that.

title: Account Manager (Strategy & Client Growth)
description_html: About Us Creative Milkshake (part of Fieldtrip) is a performance creative agency working with the world's coolest DTC brands. We create social thumb-stopping ads that are designed to convert - that's our jam. About the Role We are seeking an experienced, growth-minded Account Manager to lead client relationships, drive creative strategy, and transform transactional client projects into predictable, long-term monthly retainers. Please note that only applicants from the EMEA region will be considered. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Relationship Management (45%): Owning the day-to-day client relationship. Act as the primary strategic advisor for a portfolio of clients through understanding the client’s business goals.

title: Creative Lead (Social & UGC)
description_html: Who we are Creative Milkshake is a remote-first performance creative agency. We make scroll-stopping short-form ads for some of the world’s most exciting DTC brands on Meta and TikTok - high-volume, fast-moving, and built to convert. We’re a close-knit team of ~34 people spread across the Netherlands, the Philippines, South Africa, Spain, and beyond. We’ve recently joined the Fieldtrip group alongside inBeat, which means we’re growing - in ambition, in capability, and in the complexity of clients we work with. Our Amsterdam studio is the creative heart of our production operation. Over the next 1–2 years, we’re expanding from UGC-first content toward elevated branded formats, this role is central to holding the quality bar as we scale. The role We make a lot of content.

title: Head of Creative Operations
description_html: About us inBeat is a performance creative agency. We sit inside the Fieldtrip portfolio alongside Content Allies, Creative Milkshake, and AAG, and we build campaigns that move numbers for consumer and B2B brands across Canada and the US. We are growing fast. The delivery org is scaling hard. And operations need someone who can build the systems that hold all of that together without breaking The role We're looking for a Head of Creative Ops to build and run the operational backbone of inBeat's entire delivery function.

title: Head Of Organic Social
description_html: About us inBeat is a creative growth agency, now part of the Fieldtrip group. We make creator content at serious volume for brands like Bumble, Miro, Hurom, and NielsenIQ, and we tie every piece of it back to performance data. Small autonomous teams, fast pace, no layers of approval between you and the work. Why this role exists This is a full-time, fully remote position that allows work from anywhere/everywhere in the world. Organic social keeps landing on our plate. Clients hire us for UGC and paid, then ask us to run their organic channels too. Without really trying, it's grown into a business line closing in on seven figures. No dedicated lead, no playbook, no team behind it yet. That's the job. You'd be employee one of this department. Nothing to inherit.

title: Junior Creative Strategist
description_html: About the Role We’re a tight-knit team of creative and analytical thinkers, building performance-first creative systems and partnering with some of the world’s largest brands. We value great work with talented, innovative, and driven people while building meaningful connections with like-minded creatives along the way. We're looking for a Junior Creative Strategist who is excited to learn the fundamentals of performance creative. In this role, you'll work alongside experienced Creative Strategists, helping develop high-performing paid social concepts through research, writing, and creative thinking. You'll gain hands-on experience turning data and insights into ideas that drive results while building a strong foundation in performance creative.

title: Performance Creative Strategist
description_html: About us We’re a tight-knit team of creative, data-driven people, continuously building services & partnering with the world’s largest brands. We value great work with talented, innovative & driven people, making meaningful connections with like-minded creatives along the way! Role We’re looking for a Performance Creative Strategist (all seniorities, from junior to senior) with performance creative experience to own the creative direction and performance strategy across client accounts. What You’ll Do Lead the creative strategy and messaging across multiple paid social accounts — from brief through execution.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description_html: About inBeat (Fieldtrip) Most brands work with multiple agencies: one for paid media, one for content, one for influencer, one for SEO. The problem is they never talk to each other. Learnings get lost, budgets get wasted, and the brand ends up doing all the coordinating. Fieldtrip fixes that. We're four specialist agencies, influencer marketing, performance creative, paid media, and SEO, operating as one team. One point of contact. One shared dashboard. Role overview We're building our outbound motion from the ground up, and this is a genuine opportunity to help build that foundation from day one. You'll generate qualified pipeline across every outbound channel we're building, not a single lane role.

title: Senior Performance Creative Strategist
description_html: About the role We’re looking for a Senior Creative Strategist with performance creative experience to own the creative direction and performance strategy across client accounts. What You’ll Do Lead the creative strategy and messaging across multiple paid social accounts: from brief through execution. Conduct performance-driven research, and continuously optimize messaging and briefing based on data from the ad platforms & competitor monitoring Develop high-converting creative concepts grounded in consumer insight and platform behavior. Write (and guide) strong copy and frameworks that influence perception and drive performance. Collaborate across design, editing, and media buying to ensure end-to-end creative alignment.

title: Agentforce Developer
description_html: ABOUT THE ROLE Mariner is seeking an innovative Agentforce and AI Developer to lead the design and implementation of AI-powered automation within our Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC) ecosystem. In this pivotal role, you will architect and deploy Agentforce agents, autonomous workflows, and AI-enhanced advisor tools that elevate efficiency, personalization, and intelligence across our advisor platform. As a core contributor to our expanding AI initiatives, you will directly shape the future of advisor and client experiences at Mariner.

title: Analyst, Manager Research
description_html: Job Title: Manager Research Analyst Job Summary: As a Manager Research Analyst at Mariner, you will be responsible for evaluating a variety of public markets asset classes and categories. The analyst will develop and maintain a focus list of recommended investment strategies within these asset classes and categories for use by clients. In this role, you will present investment recommendations to the Mariner Enterprise Investment Policy Committee (EIPC), and collaborate with advisors on asset class education, manager interviews, and strategy placements. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Source and conduct due diligence on assigned asset classes and categories. Contribute to the production of the quarterly Manager Monitor for EIPC meetings.

title: Director, Cyber GRC
description_html: Reports to: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) Position Overview Join Mariner as the Director, Cyber GRC, where you will play a mission-critical role protecting the organization by shaping and executing our cybersecurity governance, vendor risk, and security awareness strategies. You’ll lead high-impact teams, collaborate across business units, and drive enterprise-wide initiatives to ensure we are not only compliant but ahead of the curve in protecting our people, assets, and stakeholders. If you thrive in dynamic environments and want to make a visible difference at a leading financial firm where innovation meets stewardship, this is your opportunity.

title: Performance Reporting Analyst
description_html: The Reporting Analyst will be an integral member of the Advisory Analytics team providing support to Mariner Wealth Advisors Ultra High net worth clientele ensuring data integrity, timely client billing, and effective trading processes and management. The Reporting Analyst will have responsibilities across a full range of functions including onboarding client data, generating performance reports, ensuring data is updated correctly, and assisting with investment management & billing inside Black Diamond performance reporting software. If you love learning new skills, building relationships, managing a diversity of tasks, have a strong attention to detail, and want to be an important part of a growing team, then this opportunity is for you.

title: Salesforce Developer
description_html: Job Title: Salesforce Developer Job Summary: Mariner is seeking a skilled Salesforce Developer to drive the ongoing development, optimization, and support of our Salesforce environment. This role is integral to advancing our firm’s operational and strategic goals by delivering scalable, efficient, and secure Salesforce solutions. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will help enhance our platform’s capabilities, provide user support, and ensure the system meets the evolving needs of the business. Key Responsibilities: Salesforce Administration Serve as the primary administrator for a ~100-user Salesforce org utilizing Financial Services Cloud and Einstein 1 licenses. Oversee user setup, profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, queues, and security controls.

title: Senior Instructor, Mariner Academy - Technology & Analytics
description_html: Senior Instructor, Mariner Academy – Technology & Analytics Position Summary The Technology & Analytics Manager serves a pivotal role in ensuring Mariner Academy’s advisors are empowered to harness AI, technology, and data to enhance—not replace—the advisor-client relationship. This position prepares our enterprise for the next decade of wealth management by serving as a dedicated bridge between the Innovation and IT teams and financial professionals. You will stay at the forefront of the rapidly evolving technology landscape, partnering with IT and Innovation to monitor tools, updates, and protocols, then translating that knowledge into practical learning delivered during each certification track’s monthly cohort check-in.

title: Senior Manager, Growth & Enablement
description_html: Job Summary The Senior Manager, Growth & Enablement drives scalable organic growth by improving the end-to-end prospect journey, increasing engagement, and optimizing conversion across digital and advisor-assisted experiences. This role owns the strategy and execution of initiatives designed to create more relevant, connected, and effective prospect experiences, from initial interest through conversion to client. The position partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Digital, Product, Operations, and Analytics teams to develop and implement growth strategies in Prospect Engagement & Journey Optimization, Growth Enablement, and Conversion Strategy.

title: Senior Vice President, Compliance
description_html: Position Summary The Senior Vice President, Head of Compliance, leads and advances the firm’s enterprise-wide compliance program. As a direct report to the Chief Risk Officer, this executive is accountable for ensuring compliance policies, procedures, monitoring, testing, training, and governance activities are effective and aligned across the organization. The SVP, Head of Compliance provides strategic direction to the compliance function and may serve as the designated Chief Compliance Officer for affiliated entities. This leader partners closely with business, risk, legal, and operational teams to identify, assess, and manage compliance risks while enabling the firm’s strategic priorities and ongoing growth.

title: Vice President, HR Tech Strategy & Operations
description_html: Vice President, HR Technology Strategy & Operations The Vice President, HR Technology Strategy & Operations is a senior HR leadership role responsible for developing and executing the organization’s HR technology strategy, operational excellence, compliance framework, and employee administration functions. We are seeking a leader with deep Oracle HCM Cloud experience who can guide the continued evolution of Oracle as the organization’s primary system of record for HR and workforce data. This role provides strategic and operational leadership across HR technology and systems, benefits, payroll, onboarding and offboarding, acquisitions and divestitures, HR operations, compliance, workforce data governance, analytics, and HR service delivery.

title: Data Scientist
description_html: We’re a U.S.-based tech company with a high bar for talent, ownership, and execution — and we’re intentional about building a strong, globally distributed team from the start. We need a Data Scientist to help design and build the algorithms that power insights, pre-label data, and reduce the need for manual configuration by users. This role sits at the intersection of machine learning, product, and data, turning complex data into clear, actionable value for our customers. What you’ll do Design and build algorithms that power Reflow’s core intelligence and analytics capabilities. Develop models to pre-label, classify, and structure data, reducing the need for manual setup by users. Collaborate with machine learning engineers to productionize models and integrate them into scalable systems.

title: Founding Recruiter
description_html: We’re a U.S.-based tech company with a high bar for talent, ownership, and execution — and we’re intentional about building a strong, globally distributed team from the start. We’re looking for a Founding Recruiter to own full-cycle recruiting for technical roles and non-technical roles, with a particular focus on the US, Europe, and Latin America. This is a hands-on role for someone who has hired senior technical talent internationally, thrives in early-stage environments, and cares deeply about hiring quality, speed, and candidate experience. What you’ll do Own full-cycle technical recruiting: Own searches end-to-end, from role kickoff through offer and close. Partner closely with hiring managers to define role requirements, success profiles, and hiring plans.

description_html: We’re a U.S.-based tech company with a high bar for talent, ownership, and execution — and we’re intentional about building a strong, globally distributed team from the start. What you’ll do Problem: The founder is managing the Customer Success team today, but needs to free up his time and better set up this team for success. Specifically, you'll: Manage our two CSMs Start super hands-on to learn the product, but then quickly focus on team management and performance Build out the CS team, including interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and 30/60/90 day performance Shadow relevant customer conversations Own the full customer lifecycle from pilot through expansion Act as the founder's single point of contact for Customer Success ‍ Who you are Been VP of CS or Head of CS for other VC-backed B2B…

title: Lead Mac Developer
description_html: Our Mac app is at the center of it all: capturing rich data, delivering coaching, and powering insights. We’re looking for a senior Mac developer to take ownership of our macOS app, drive technical excellence, and help shape the foundation of our platform. What you’ll do Lead macOS app development, architecture, performance, deployment, and long-term scalability. Own the quality bar: profiling, debugging, optimizing for speed and stability. Ensure compatibility across managed environments, including MDM and restricted setups. Collaborate closely with backend and data teams to integrate APIs and improve system reliability. Guide and mentor team members and other developers, helping elevate the overall engineering craft.

title: Product Counsel
description_html: As Product Counsel, you'll be a trusted legal partner for the Product organization. This isn't a role for someone who wants to review finished specs from the sidelines. Reporting to the Head of Commercial Legal, you'll counsel teams from the earliest design conversations through launch, implement privacy-by-design across the company, and give practical, real-time advice that balances legal risk against the speed the business needs. The role is remote but requires occasional travel, including to Solace's headquarters in Redwood City, California.

title: Product Operator
description_html: Product Operators work directly with Product leadership to drive the highest-leverage initiatives across the organization. While Product Managers own their product areas and roadmaps, Product Operators own the critical work that spans multiple teams, functions, and priorities. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, operations, execution, and organizational effectiveness. You'll partner closely with the Chief Product Officer and leaders across Product, Engineering, Design, Operations, Clinical, and Growth to identify opportunities, create alignment, and ensure our most important initiatives move forward. We're looking for someone early in their career but operating at an exceptional level.

title: Registered Nurse Healthcare Advocate (Remote 1099) - RN
description_html: As a Registered Nurse (RN) Healthcare Advocate with Solace, you'll work with patients throughout their healthcare journey. In the RN Advocate role, you will guide patients through difficult and complex health concerns and help them achieve their health and wellness goals while also addressing their Social Determinants of Health (SDOH). You’ll be an empathetic listener and an action-oriented guide who will work to actually resolve patient's problems. PLEASE NOTE: this is a 1099 contract position. You will set your own hours and can work part-time, full-time, or anything in between. This role is 100% remote. All patient interactions are performed via video or phone call.

title: Technical Product Manager
description_html: As a Technical Product Manager at Solace, you’ll take ownership of building and optimizing the systems that power our user experience and internal operations. You’ll operate at the intersection of data, product, and operations—diving deep into the funnel, asking hard questions, and translating complexity into clarity. You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, growth, care teams, and leadership to define, build, and launch features that drive measurable results. This is an ideal role for someone who loves building clean systems, thrives on details, and has the ambition to do their best work in a fast-moving startup environment.

title: Account Executive - Remote/US
description_html: What we're building Jiga is on a mission to help engineers build physical products faster. The problem: engineers designing physical products waste weeks chasing quotes, vetting suppliers, and managing procurement instead of actually engineering. Jiga fixes this by connecting engineers directly with vetted manufacturers (CNC, sheet metal, injection molding, 3D printing). We're a small, fully-funded, cashflow-positive team serving top-tier hardware startups and customers like NASA and Siemens. The role We’re looking for an Account Executive to join our sales team and help us transform the way hardware companies build their supply chains.

title: Account Executive Defense - Israel
description_html: We’re looking for an Account Executive based in Israel to join our sales team and play a key role in growing Jiga’s defense and aerospace business. The opportunity in Israel Manufacturing capacity is at the centre of the conversation in defense. Demand is surging across defense systems, drones, aerospace, and space, while critical programs still lose valuable time waiting for custom parts. The capacity exists across Israel and the global supply base. What’s missing is the coordination layer that finds and qualifies the right capacity, removes friction, and moves work across it with the speed, traceability, and accountability these programs require. Jiga is building that layer.

title: Content and Communications Manager, Aerospace and Defense
description_html: The problem The defense industrial base is at a historic inflection point. Manufacturing capacity is at the center of conversation. Jiga is building that layer. We route demand using AI to the right US manufacturers, operate as supplier of record with full traceability, and turn into a production arm for custom mechanical parts. We work with the hottest defense startups and traditional Primes. VC-backed, growing 4x year over year. The role You'll own how Jiga shows up in aerospace and defense. Positioning, messaging, content, media relations, events, podcasts, speaking slots, news placements. You write, pitch and place.

title: Full Stack Product Engineer - Remote/Europe
description_html: What we're building Jiga is on a mission to help engineers build physical products faster. Think npm install for mechanical engineers - we're building the infrastructure that makes hardware development as fast as software. How we actually work We’re a small remote team made up of the best of the best. Our team members are distributed around the globe. While most of our product and engineering talent is located in Europe and Israel, you’ll also work with people from the US and Asia. Most of our work is made async, which is the secret sauce of our success. High trust, low bullshit: We don't count hours or peek over your shoulder on Slack. We trust you to get your work done and tell us when something's wrong.

description_html: What we're building Jiga is on a mission to help the best hardware companies build faster. The problem: engineers designing physical products waste weeks chasing quotes, vetting suppliers, and managing procurement instead of actually engineering. Jiga fixes this by connecting engineers directly with vetted manufacturers (CNC, sheet metal, injection molding, 3D printing). We're a small, fully-funded, cashflow-positive team serving customers like NASA, Google, and Siemens. The role Mechanical engineers hate sourcing. They hate portals, sales calls, and waiting five days for a quote. We built the thing they actually want. They tell their college friends about it, they bring us along when they change companies and they send pizzas to our suppliers at 11PM.

title: Head of Supplier Growth
description_html: The mission The US needs to reindustrialize. Defense programs and hardware startups run on custom mechanical parts, and most of those parts come from small machine shops. The industrial base everyone talks about rebuilding is thousands of these small businesses. A 15-person shop has the owner answering the phone, programming the machines, and chasing payments before lunch. Quoting RFQs that never convert, compliance flowdowns, net-60 terms - all of it lands on the owner. Of course the best shops guard their time, it's a rational response to how the industry is built. They have more choice than ever, and they decide who they pick up the phone for. We believe the key to rebuilding American manufacturing is to make these shops win.

title: Logistics Manager - Remote/Anywhere
description_html: What we're building Jiga is on a mission to help engineers build physical products faster. The problem: engineers designing physical products waste weeks chasing quotes, vetting suppliers, managing freight, fighting with customs, and recovering from late shipments. Jiga fixes this by connecting engineers directly with vetted manufacturers (CNC, sheet metal, injection molding, 3D printing) and running the entire supply chain on their behalf - from RFQ to the loading dock. We're a small, fully-funded, cashflow-positive team serving enterprise customers like NASA, Google, Tesla, and Apple.

title: Manufacturing / NPI Engineer
description_html: What we're building Jiga is on a mission to help engineers build physical products faster. The problem: engineers designing physical products waste weeks chasing quotes, vetting suppliers, managing freight, and recovering from bad parts. Jiga fixes this by connecting engineers directly with vetted manufacturers (CNC, sheet metal, injection molding, 3D printing, castings) and running the entire supply chain on their behalf — from RFQ to the loading dock. We're a small, fully-funded, cashflow-positive team serving enterprise customers across hardware, industrial, robotics, defense, and aerospace. The role Our customers are increasingly bringing us production work — not just one-off prototypes.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) - Remote
description_html: The Company Jiga is a diverse team of people who work hard to build the world’s best way to produce physical products. Jiga is a remote-friendly company, backed by Y Combinator and other amazing investors. We value diversity, freedom of creativity, and work flexibility. We don’t care about your race, religion, or location— as long as you are committed to our mission, you’ll receive a warm welcome at Jiga. The Job We are looking for a sales development representative (SDR) to help our future customers understand how Jiga can benefit their engineering, supply chain, and procurement teams. As Jiga’s Sales Development Representative, you’ll play a key role in helping the company grow by shaping and executing our outreach and prospecting strategies that drive the acquisition of new business.

title: Senior Account Executive - Defense
description_html: This is a senior sales role leading Jiga's expansion into defense manufacturing. You'll own the full sales cycle with Tier 2/3 suppliers and defense startups - companies under real pressure to fix broken supply chains and turn them into long-term production relationships. About Jiga Jiga is the professional manufacturing platform that helps the world's best companies make their products. Companies source the mission-critical parts that help them launch satellites, build robotics, and strengthen national security. We're a fast-growing Series A, Y Combinator backed company transforming how hardware companies build their supply chains. We have strong and proven product market fit, growing exponentially YoY.

As Harvey's first Support Operations Data Analyst, you'll own the analytics function for the Customer Experience org. You'll build and maintain the dashboards, reports, and feedback loops that tell us whether we're hitting our north stars — cSAT, TTR, QA scores, escalation rates — and surface the signal underneath the numbers so we can act on it. You'll sit within the Support Operations team, reporting to the Support Operations Manager, and work closely with Customer Experience leadership and Harvey's central data team to ensure the org is equipped with the right instrumentation as we scale.

title: CX Operations Engineer
description_html: Harvey's support org is growing fast, and keeping our specialists equipped to handle an increasingly complex product requires more than good processes, it requires smart tooling. Reporting to the CX Operations Manager, you'll own the automation infrastructure, AI-assisted workflows, and reporting systems that make our specialists faster and more effective. Working alongside the Support Systems Administrator (platform infrastructure and config) and the CX Operations Lead (Zendesk-native features including Copilot and Chatbot), your lane is everything built on top of or extending beyond that foundation, custom integrations, cross-stack automation, and the technical layer that connects it…

You'll set the philosophy and stay close enough to the work to know whether a plan design holds up in practice. This is a player/coach role for someone who has built and run a global benefits function before, ideally in a fast-scaling environment.

title: Law School Student Ambassador

This role sits within the Law School Partnerships team, whose mission is to make Harvey an indispensable part of legal education by embedding the platform into how students learn and work. By building peer-to-peer awareness and hosting hands-on programming, the Ambassador accelerates student adoption and generates insights that shape Harvey's academic go-to-market strategy. They partner with faculty, student organizations, and Harvey's internal partnerships and marketing teams to tailor campus engagement to their school's unique culture.

title: Sales Manager, Public Sector
description_html: Harvey's Sales Manager, Public Sector leads our go-to-market into United States federal, state, and local government legal organizations. This is a build role. You will recruit and lead a team of Enterprise Account Executives covering federal agencies and state and local government, and you will own the number for the segment — quota, pipeline, forecast, and execution. Harvey already has active engagements at government agencies; your job is to turn early momentum into a durable, repeatable government sales motion. What You'll Do Recruit, coach, and lead a team of Enterprise AEs across Federal and State & Local, including sourcing and closing the founding hires. Own quota attainment, pipeline generation, and forecast accuracy for the Public Sector segment.

title: Account Manager
description_html: an Account Manager We're hiring a proactive, revenue-driven Account Manager to own and scale relationships with our highest-value accounts. Managing a dedicated portfolio of ~40 enterprise clients ($1M+ revenue organizations on annual subscriptions), you will serve as a strategic partner to ensure delivery goals are met while driving aggressive account expansion. This role is ideal for a strong consultative seller with a talent for customer development who can translate client feedback into new product offerings like impact reporting. As Account Manager, your mission will be to: Own the end-to-end relationships for a portfolio of 40 high-value, annual subscription clients ($1M+ annual revenue).

title: Business Development Representative, Enterprise

This is not a standard SDR seat. You will work on our most mature products, the ones with the strongest market position and the clearest track record. They already work. What we are doing now is unlocking new avenues on top of them, and that means identifying new personas, testing new angles, and opening opportunities the business has not gone after before. That is where you come in. You will be at the forefront of that work, in a fast-paced and fast-moving environment where the picture changes as we learn.

title: Customer Success Manager

You will ensure clients maximize value from our AI tools while coordinating with our grant delivery team to drive NPS, account retention, and growth. As Customer Success Manager, your mission will be to: Onboard new accounts, lead product enablement sessions, and drive feature adoption so clients regularly use AgentPro's self-serve AI capabilities. Act as the primary interface between clients and internal grant delivery specialists to ensure deadlines, quality benchmarks, and service agreements are consistently met.

title: Customer Success Manager (North America)

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager to own the post-launch relationship with our enterprise customers and ensure they adopt, scale, and renew year after year. You will become the primary day-to-day partner once the customer is live. You’ll drive adoption and engagement, manage operational requests and escalations, and ensure customers consistently realize value from Goodstack. You will also own renewals and upsells within the existing product footprint – including improving commercial terms, expanding usage, and growing geographic coverage. When there is whitespace for new products, you’ll qualify the opportunity and bring in the Account Executive to run the cross-sell process.

In this role, you'll be responsible for setting up grant calendars, extracting application questions from funder portals for writers, compiling application materials, and reviewing final submissions for accuracy, completeness, and overall visual and textual coherence before hitting submit. We welcome candidates from a variety of adjacent administrative backgrounds. You are a great fit for this role if you have experience as a Proposal or RFP Coordinator, Bid or Tender Administrator, Loan Processing Assistant, Admissions/Intake Coordinator, or Junior Operations Coordinator.

You’ll help nonprofits access more funding, faster – identifying relevant opportunities, shaping strong applications and making sure every draft is accurate, compelling and genuinely useful. If you have a strong grant writing background, enjoy turning complex programme information into clear funding narratives, and want your work to support organisations doing meaningful social impact work, this could be the perfect role for you.

title: Nonprofit Success Manager
description_html: a Nonprofit Success Manager to help nonprofits access technology and funding opportunities! We’re looking for a proactive, empathetic, and process-driven Nonprofit Success Manager to connect and support nonprofits with the tools they need to run their missions. In this role, you’ll be the first point of contact for nonprofit leaders exploring Goodstack. You’ll reach out to inbound leads, guide them through our platform, and help them understand how Goodstack can transform their tech stack and funding workflows. If you thrive on meaningful conversations, love solving problems, and want to make a tangible social impact — this could be the perfect role for you!

title: Sales Representative
description_html: a Sales Representative to help Nonprofits discover better funding opportunities! We’re looking for a proactive, empathetic, and commercially curious Sales Representative to help nonprofits discover Goodstack GrantPilot. Goodstack GrantPilot is built to give nonprofits access to the kind of fundraising support many teams could never normally afford. GrantPilot is the first step in that mission: combining smart technology, targeted funding research, and a concierge-led experience to help nonprofits find and pursue more relevant funding opportunities. This is a brilliant role for someone who loves speaking with people, solving practical problems and helping mission-driven teams access opportunities they may never have found alone.

You’ll collaborate with a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and product leads to deliver seamless, high-performance applications that power modern product teams. Key Responsibilities Support Agent+ customers by building custom components, features, and workflows tailored to their product needs. Design and implement robust front-end solutions using our visual IDE, optimizing for performance and scalability. Work closely with UX/UI designers to translate design concepts into functional code.
